title: 資深量化策略分析師（期貨／期權方向）Senior Quantitative Analyst ( Futures & Options)
location: Tsim Sha Tsui, Yau Tsim Mong District
teaser:
我們是一家位於香港的量化交易公司，專注於商品期貨、股指期貨及衍生品市場。目前，團隊已完成交易執行系統與風控系統的搭建，並擁有成熟的技術、風控及基礎策略研究團隊。
現誠聘一位在商品期貨、股指期貨多策略領域具有深厚積累的資深策略分析師，主導核心策略的設計與迭代，並前瞻性地布局期權策略。
jd:
團隊與背景
我們是一家位於香港的量化交易公司，專注於商品期貨、股指期貨及衍生品市場。目前，團隊已完成交易執行系統與風控系統的搭建，並擁有成熟的技術、風控及基礎策略研究團隊。
為進一步提升策略的盈利能力與多樣性，現誠聘一位在商品期貨、股指期貨多策略領域 具有深厚積累的資深策略分析師，主導核心策略的設計與迭代，並前瞻性地布局期權策略。
崗位職責
1. 核心策略研發與設計
主導商品期貨與股指期貨的中高頻、日內及跨期套利策略 研發，獨立完成從數據清洗、因子挖掘、模型構建到歷史回測的全流程。
結合市場微觀結構與宏觀波動率變化，設計具有低相關性的多策略組合，提升策略在複雜市場環境下的穩健性。
2. 期權策略儲備與落地
基於現有期貨策略優勢，研究並開發期權波動率策略，例如做空波動率、備兌策略、價差策略等，為未來實盤交易做好儲備。
利用期權非線性收益特徵，設計針對極端風險的尾部風險對沖方案。
3. 策略工程化與協作
與技術開發團隊緊密配合，將策略邏輯轉化為可實盤執行的程式碼（Python/C++），確保策略具備低延遲執行與穩定運維能力。
與風控人員協同制定策略層面的風控參數，例如 VaR、止損線、倉位管理邏輯，確保策略符合公司整體風險預算。
任職要求
1. 硬性條件
經驗背景：具備 5 年以上 於知名量化對沖基金、自營交易公司或投行量化部門的策略研究經驗，其中需包含至少 2 年商品期貨或股指期貨實盤策略管理經驗 。有期權波動率實盤交易經驗者優先。
學歷背景：數學、物理、統計學、金融工程、計算機科學等量化相關專業之碩士或博士學歷，畢業於海內外頂尖高校者優先。
編程能力：熟練使用 Python 進行數據處理與建模（Pandas / NumPy），熟悉 C++ 者優先；熟悉 Linux 環境及資料庫操作。
2. 核心能力
策略深度：對統計套利、趨勢跟蹤、均值回歸、訂單簿微觀結構等至少一類策略有獨到見解，並具備可驗證的實盤或模擬交易績效。
市場認知：深刻理解商品期貨（如黑色、有色、能源化工）與股指期貨（如恒指、A 股股指）的品種特性、交易規則及跨市場聯動邏輯，例如商品尾部風險對股指的傳導。
風險意識：具備優秀的回撤控制意識，能在追求收益的同時兼顧策略的夏普比率與卡瑪比率。
3. 軟性素質
具備團隊協作精神，能適應扁平化、快節奏的量化研發氛圍，並可與技術、風控團隊高效溝通。
對交易事業充滿熱情，具備極強的自驅力與抗壓能力，能在市場逆風期保持理性並持續優化策略。
>
優先考慮條件
具備香港或海外衍生品市場（如 SGX、CME、HKEX）交易經驗。
曾於頂級量化期刊發表研究成果，或在 Kaggle 等資料科學競賽中取得優異成績。
熟悉機器學習方法（如 XGBoost、LSTM）在時間序列預測中的應用。
>
歡迎合資格人士申請，公司將會協助符合條件者辦理香港工作簽證申請/續簽 （如適用）。
>

jd:
Quant Analyst – Quantamental Research
Dark Ice Research is a boutique quant research firm based in Hong Kong, focusing on US and APAC equities. We are hiring a Quant Analyst to join our quantamental research effort — the work of turning genuine fundamental insight into systematic, machine-driven signals. You'll work closely with senior practitioners who'll mentor you, and take real ownership of your work as you grow into the role.
Quantamental research — this is the core of how Dark Ice generates edge: deploying fundamental understanding systematically, at a scale and consistency discretionary analysis can't reach.
Help translate fundamental theses into systematic, testable factors — turning the kind of judgment a seasoned equity analyst makes into signals that can be ranked, backtested, and traded across a broad universe
Financial-statement analysis at scale: quality of earnings, accruals, cash conversion, balance-sheet strength, capital allocation — applied cross-sectionally rather than name-by-name
Contribute to fundamental factor libraries (value, quality, growth, profitability) grounded in real accounting understanding
Support development of sector- and market-specific fundamental models across US and APAC equities, accounting for local accounting standards and market structure
Research corporate-event and catalyst signals — placements, buybacks, ownership changes, governance-driven re-ratings — where a fundamental read drives the systematic response
Machine learning
Build, train, and validate ML and deep-learning models that turn fundamental, market, and alternative data into predictive signals
Rigorous feature engineering and out-of-sample discipline in a low-signal, non-stationary domain
Apply modern techniques with growing judgment about when simpler methods win
Extract signals from unstructured text — news, filings, transcripts — using LLM and NLP techniques,
Foundation
Analysis of large financial and market datasets in Python and SQL, with rigorous point-in-time correctness and data quality
Sourcing, curating, and analysing alternative datasets to uncover new edge
Building bias-aware backtesting tools for multi-factor and cross-sectional models
Automating and optimising research and data workflows
What we're looking for
Hands-on experience building ML / deep-learning models on real prediction problems — through study, projects, competitions, internships, or early professional work you can walk us through and explain the choices behind
Solid grounding in financial-statement analysis and fundamental valuation, or clear aptitude and appetite to build it fast
Fluent in Python and the modern ML stack; disciplined about validation and wary of overfitting
Strong quantitative degree (or equivalent self-taught evidence) and genuine curiosity about markets
Exposure to a quant, systematic, or quantamental environment is a plus, not a requirement — we invest in the right person
What you get. Direct work on the models that drive the firm's live strategies, close mentorship from senior practitioners, and real ownership as you grow. Market base plus discretionary annual bonus and long-term incentive.

我們是一家位於香港的量化交易公司，專注於商品期貨、股指期貨及期權策略的研發。本崗位將直接向策略負責人匯報，深度參與由策略構思、回測驗證到績效分析的完整流程，是團隊重點培養的核心儲備人才崗位。
主要職責
策略實現與回測
根據策略負責人提供的研究思路，獨立編寫 Python 代碼進行數據清洗、因子計算、策略回測及績效歸因分析。
維護並優化現有回測框架，確保結果準確、可重現。
數據與因子研究
收集、整理及預處理期貨與衍生品市場數據（包括 Tick、分鐘及日頻數據）。
協助挖掘新阿爾法因子或交易信號，並進行統計顯著性與穩定性測試。
研究文檔與匯報
系統記錄回測結果、參數敏感性分析及邏輯推導過程，撰寫清晰研究報告。
定期向策略負責人匯報進展，並根據反饋快速迭代優化。
任職要求
學歷背景
數學、物理、統計、金融工程、電腦科學等相關專業，碩士或以上學歷。
畢業於海內外優秀高校（QS 前 100 或同等水平）。
技術能力
熟練使用 Python 進行數據處理與建模，精通 Pandas、NumPy，熟悉 Matplotlib／Seaborn 可視化。
熟練使用 Jupyter Notebook 或 VS Code 進行研究與代碼管理。
了解基本版本控制工具（如 Git）。
熟悉概率論、数理統計、時間序列分析等量化基礎方法。
了解金融基本概念（如收益率、波動率、夏普比率、最大回撤）。
加分項（非必須）
有量化競賽經驗（如 WorldQuant、Kaggle 金融類）並獲獎。
熟悉期貨／期權交易規則，或有模擬交易經驗。
熟練使用 SQL 進行數據庫查詢與管理。
軟性素質
執行力強，能高效將策略想法轉化為可運行代碼與清晰結果。
細節嚴謹，對數據精度與回測邏輯有嚴格自檢習慣（避免未來函數、倖存者偏差等）。
學習意願高，對量化交易充滿熱情，主動探索新品種、新模型。
溝通清晰，能以中文或英文清楚匯報研究成果與邏輯依據。
薪酬福利
薪資範圍 ：根據學歷、實習經歷及面試表現綜合評定。
績效獎金 ：參與策略團隊整體績效獎金分配（按個人貢獻度評定）。
簽證支持 ：公司協助辦理香港工作簽證（如適用）。
Team Overview
>We are a Hong Kong-based quantitative trading firm specializing in the research and development of strategies for commodity futures, equity index futures, and options. This role will serve as a direct research assistant to the Head of Strategy, deeply involved in the end-to-end process—from idea generation to backtesting and validation—and is a core talent-development position within the team.
Key Responsibilities
Strategy Implementation & Backtesting
Independently develop Python code to execute data cleaning, factor calculation, strategy backtesting, and performance attribution analysis based on research ideas and trading logic provided by the Strategy Lead.
Maintain and enhance the existing backtesting framework to ensure accuracy and reproducibility of results.
Data & Factor Research
Collect, organize, and preprocess market data for futures and derivatives (including tick, minute, and daily frequency data).
Assist in discovering new alpha factors or signals, and conduct statistical significance and stability testing.
Research Documentation & Reporting
Systematically document backtesting results, parameter sensitivity analyses, and logical derivations into clear research reports.
Regularly present research progress to the Strategy Lead and iterate quickly based on feedback.
Qualifications
>Required
Education : Master’s degree or above in Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, Financial Engineering, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field from a top-tier university (QS Top 100 or equivalent).
Programming Skills :
Proficient in Python for data processing and modeling, with strong command of Pandas and NumPy; familiarity with Matplotlib/Seaborn for visualization.
Experienced in using Jupyter Notebook or VS Code for research and code management.
Basic knowledge of version control tools (e.g., Git).
Technical Knowledge :
Solid foundation in probability theory, mathematical statistics, and time-series analysis.
Understanding of core financial concepts (e.g., return, volatility, Sharpe ratio, maximum drawdown).
Preferred (Not Required)
Award-winning experience in quantitative competitions (e.g., WorldQuant, Kaggle finance tracks).
Familiarity with futures/options trading rules or hands-on experience with simulated trading.
Proficiency in SQL for database querying and data management.
Soft Skills
Strong execution ability: efficiently translate the Strategy Lead’s ideas into runnable code and clear results.
Meticulous attention to detail: rigorously self-validate data accuracy and backtesting logic to avoid look-ahead bias and survivorship bias.
High learning motivation: passionate about quantitative trading and eager to explore new instruments and models.
Clear communication: able to articulate research findings and logical reasoning fluently in both Chinese and English.
Compensation & Benefits
Salary : Commensurate with academic background, internship experience, and interview performance.
Performance Bonus : Eligible for team-level performance-based bonus allocation (determined by individual contribution).
Visa Support : Company will assist with Hong Kong work visa application (if applicable).
>

jd:
Investment Transformation Business Analysts - Operating Model & Technical Implementation
>
Our client is a leading global financial services organization with a significant investment management business with a significant strategic transformation agenda. As part of a major investment transformation initiative, they are urgently seeking two experienced Business Analysts – one specializing in Operating Model and one focusing on Technical Implementation – to join the project team. Both roles will initially be offered as 12-month contract positions , with a view to extend or convert into permanent positions.
These are hands-on delivery roles requiring experienced Business Analysts who can work independently, engage directly with stakeholders, analyse complex investment-related change, and convert discussions into clear and practical project outputs.
Roles & Responsibilities
Operating Model Business Analyst
As an Operating Model Business Analyst , you will be responsible for the following:-
Conduct detailed business and operating model analysis to understand the impact of transformation initiatives across the investment organization.
Assess changes across multiple dimensions including people, processes, technology, data, finance, contracts, and services .
Analyse current-state processes and operating arrangements and support the development of future-state operating models.
Identify cross-functional dependencies, downstream impacts and operational implications arising from proposed changes.
Engage directly with business, investment, operations and other functional stakeholders to gather information and clarify business requirements.
Facilitate stakeholder discussions and workshops and translate findings into clear, structured and actionable deliverables.
Support business process redesign and broader operating model transformation activities.
Produce detailed analysis, process documentation, impact assessments and other project outputs required to support implementation.
Work independently with project leadership to take ownership of assigned areas and drive analysis through to completion.
Technical Implementation Business Analyst
As a Technical Implementation Business Analyst , you will be responsible for the following:-
Work closely with investment, operations, technology and data stakeholders to understand business and technical requirements.
Analyse investment management and investment operations processes and identify impacts arising from technology and system changes.
Gather, analyse and document business, operational and technical requirements.
Translate stakeholder discussions and business needs into clear, structured requirements and practical implementation outputs.
Support analysis across investment technology, systems, data and related operational processes.
Facilitate workshops and working sessions with business and technology stakeholders.
Identify dependencies, issues and gaps across investment processes, systems and data.
Support the implementation of investment platforms, tools and associated process changes.
Produce detailed Business Analyst documentation and tangible project deliverables.
Work independently with project leadership and stakeholders to progress assigned areas of analysis and implementation.
Requirements
Operating Model Business Analyst
To be considered for the position of Operating Model Business Analyst , you should possess the following:-
Strong hands-on experience as a Business Analyst, business change professional or transformation consultant within financial services.
Demonstrated experience in operating model analysis, target operating model initiatives, process redesign or business transformation .
Previous experience within asset management, investment management or an investment-related environment would be highly advantageous.
Strong understanding of how business change can impact multiple areas across people, process, technology and data.
Experience assessing broader operational impacts including finance, contractual arrangements, and services.
Strong process analysis, impact assessment and problem-solving capabilities.
Proven ability to identify cross-functional dependencies and downstream consequences of business change.
Strong stakeholder engagement and workshop facilitation skills.
Ability to convert complex stakeholder discussions into structured analysis and practical project deliverables.
Strong hands-on delivery mindset with the ability to work independently and with limited supervision.
Technical Implementation Business Analyst
To be considered for the position of Technical Implementation Business Analyst , you should possess the following:-
Strong hands-on Business Analyst experience within financial services.
Strong experience within asset management, investment management or institutional investments .
Solid understanding of investment operations and investment management processes .

title: Digital Analytics & MarTech Implementation Consultant
teaser: Own end-to-end digital analytics projects for top brands. Configure GA4/GTM, lead tech strategy & drive client success in this hybrid consulting role.
bullet_points: Direct exposure to senior client stakeholders
jd:
About the Role
We are a technology consultancy delivering digital analytics, customer data, and marketing technology projects for well-known consumer and e-commerce brands across Asia Pacific and Europe.
We are looking for an Implementation Consultant to take ownership of delivery on a portfolio of client accounts. You will typically hold two to four accounts at a time, and the mix changes as projects start and finish.
This is a hands-on consulting role rather than an in-house analytics seat. On your accounts you run the discovery, write the specification, configure the platform, validate that it works, and keep the client and their agencies moving toward decisions. Senior architects support you on the hard technical calls and engineers build alongside you, but the account is yours to drive.
The work spans two areas. The first is web and e-commerce analytics implementation, primarily GA4 and Google Tag Manager on platforms such as Shopify, including advertising conversion tracking across multiple countries and ad platforms. The second is customer engagement and support platform work, including configuration, automation, reporting, and migrations between platforms.
If you enjoy being the person a client calls because you know their setup better than anyone else, this role will suit you.
What You Will Do
Build and maintain analytics tracking
Configure GA4 properties and Google Tag Manager containers, including events, parameters, triggers, variables, conversions, and consent handling.
Work in client storefront code where needed, typically theme markup, dataLayer, and custom pixels.
Implement advertising conversion tracking across platforms such as Meta and Google Ads, including multi-market setups where different countries route to different ad accounts.
Write the measurement plans, event definitions, tracking specifications, and acceptance criteria that engineers and client developers build against.
Debug and validate rigorously. Verify events end to end, run structured QA before and after launch, and keep issue logs current.
Configure customer engagement platforms
Set up and refine workspaces, automation, workflows, routing rules, AI agents, and reporting in platforms such as Intercom or Zendesk.
Support platform migrations, including data mapping, rationalising legacy automation, import validation, and cutover readiness.
Produce user guidance so client teams can handle routine changes themselves.
Own the client relationship on your accounts
Serve as the primary operational contact for your accounts across tracking, reporting, access, and platform questions.
Run discovery sessions. Lead the conversation, ask the questions that surface what the client has not yet considered, and leave with documented requirements and a named owner against every dependency.
Keep the open-items list moving. Chase clients, their agencies, and third-party vendors until questions are answered. Projects stall on unanswered questions more often than on technical difficulty, so this is genuinely valuable work.
Track timelines, milestones, risks, and decisions across concurrent workstreams, and raise slippage while it is still recoverable.
Give engineers and architects the access, examples, decisions, and context they need before they have to ask.
Write clearly. Produce updates a client can forward to their own management, and record decisions so they still make sense six months later.
Contribute to feasibility assessments, effort estimates, and proposals for new work.
What a Typical Month Looks Like
The balance of this role is easier to understand through examples than a responsibilities list. In a given month you would expect to:
Run four to eight client or agency calls, most of which you lead.
Write or revise a tracking specification, then answer the developer questions it generates.
Configure tags and triggers in a container and test them until the data is correct.
Work through a QA checklist against a staging or newly launched site and log what failed.
Update an open-items tracker and follow up with the people who owe you answers.
Configure automation or reporting in a support platform and document it for the client.
Send a written status update covering what is done, what is blocked, and who owns the next step.
Brief an engineer so they can build without waiting on you.
Roughly half the role is hands-on configuration and validation. The other half is communication and coordination. Both matter equally.
What We Are Looking For
Technical skills
Hands-on GA4 and Google Tag Manager. You have configured these, not only reported from them. You can explain how an event travels from a page interaction to a report, and debug it when it does not arrive. We will ask you to walk us through a real example from your own work.
Event tracking fundamentals. Practical understanding of dataLayer, event taxonomy, parameters, and tracking plans.
Comfort reading front-end code. You do not need to be a developer. You do need to open a page's source or a theme template, find a tracking snippet, understand what it does, and modify it carefully.
Spreadsheet fluency. Google Sheets and Excel to a standard where you can organise messy data and produce output a client will read.
Client and delivery skills
Direct client ownership. You have held a client or stakeholder relationship yourself, rather than supporting a senior colleague who held it. You can clarify a vague request, push back on an unreasonable one, and reset an expectation before it becomes a complaint.
Self-directed follow-through. You keep track of your own commitments and other people's, and you chase the ones that go quiet without being reminded.
Clear written requirements. You can turn a wide-ranging business conversation into a specification precise enough that a developer builds the right thing first time.
Professional English. Written and spoken, at a standard suited to leading client meetings and working with stakeholders in Europe.
Experience and education
3 or more years in digital analytics implementation, marketing technology or platform consulting, implementation or solutions delivery, technical account management, or a comparable client-facing delivery role.
Bachelor's degree in a business, analytics, information systems, marketing, or computing field, or equivalent practical experience. Demonstrated hands-on capability matters more to us than the degree.
Nice to Have
None of these are required. Tell us about any you have.
Professional Mandarin or Cantonese, which is an advantage for regional client work.
E-commerce platform experience, particularly Shopify, including theme markup, metafields, custom pixels, or multi-market storefronts.
Advertising conversion tracking experience: Meta Pixel and Conversions API, Google Ads conversions, or multi-market pixel routing.
Customer engagement platform experience such as Intercom or Zendesk.
Customer data platform exposure such as Segment.
SQL, APIs, or data integration and migration work.
Consent management, or familiarity with GDPR, PDPA, or similar privacy regimes.
Certifications in Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, or comparable platforms.
Is This Role Right for You?
We would rather be upfront, so you can decide before applying.
This role suits you if you like owning something end to end, you are comfortable being the visible face of a vendor relationship, and you get satisfaction from tracking that is correct and provable rather than approximately right.
>
This role may not suit you if you are looking for a data science or statistical modelling position, if you would prefer to coordinate projects without working in the platforms yourself, or if you would rather focus on one product deeply than work across several client accounts.
What We Offer
Competitive salary based on experience. [Insert range, or: Salary negotiable.]
Performance bonus linked to delivery quality and client satisfaction.
Professional development budget for platform certifications and training.
Hybrid working arrangements.
Direct exposure to recognised international brands and to senior client stakeholders, at a level of responsibility that is difficult to reach at a larger firm.
A clear progression path toward Senior Implementation Consultant and then Solution Architect or Engagement Lead.
Standard benefits and statutory entitlements per your location.
Our Hiring Process
Introductory call, approximately 30 minutes.
Technical and delivery interview with the hiring manager.
A short practical exercise, around 45 minutes, reviewing a sample tracking implementation. We use this because it is a fair reflection of the actual work.
Final conversation and offer.
>

title: Intern – AI Agent Research
location: Tseung Kwan O, Sai Kung District
teaser: Research AI Agent technology ecosystem.
jd:
Job Description
Conduct deep-dive research on the AI Agent technology ecosystem: framework design (LangChain/LangGraph, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, etc.), memory architectures, tool-use patterns, multi-agent collaboration and orchestration strategies.
Track, test, and evaluate mainstream and emerging Agent frameworks, producing structured technical comparison reports and internal assessment documents.
Leverage company-provided compute resources and API tokens to build Agent prototype systems and proof-of-concept projects (PoCs), validating different architectures in real-world scenarios.
Design and build RAG knowledge bases serving Agent systems, covering data pipelines, retrieval strategies, context injection, and evaluation metrics.
Continuously track top-tier conference papers (NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, ACL, etc.), open-source project releases, and major AI lab developments, distilling key information into concise research memos and weekly reports.
Monitor regulatory developments in the US and China regarding AI safety, data governance, and compute controls, assessing their potential impact on the Agent ecosystem.
Collaborate with internal teams to identify high-potential Agent application directions, translating technical insights into actionable project proposals
>
Skills & Requirements
Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics, or a related technical field.
Fluency in English (reading, writing, and speaking) is required; bilingual proficiency in English and Chinese is highly preferred.
Ability to read and understand technical papers and open-source project documentation.
Genuine interest in and sustained attention to the AI Agent space — we are looking for someone who is genuinely obsessed with agents.
Self-driven, well-organized, and capable of working independently in a fast-paced environment.
Strong Plus
Any of the following will significantly strengthen your candidacy:
Model Training & Inference: Proficiency with PyTorch, and LLM inference/serving frameworks such as vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT-LLM, or LMDeploy; experience in inference optimization or model deployment.
Post-Training & Reinforcement Learning: Hands-on experience with RLHF, DPO, reward modeling, PPO/GRPO, or similar techniques.
Enterprise-Grade RAG Systems: Real-world experience building RAG systems from scratch (vector databases, reranking, hybrid retrieval, evaluation frameworks).
Frontier Research Awareness: Keen tracking of cutting-edge fields such as world models, virtual cells, autonomous driving, embodied intelligence, and neural-symbolic reasoning.

You will be responsible for sales performance tracking, store traffic and conversion analytics, sales KPI benchmarking, and sales revenue forecasting.
If you possess strong expertise in sales analytics, store productivity modeling, and business reporting within the retail sector, this role offers an exceptional platform to directly influence commercial decision-making.
Key Responsibilities
1. Retail Sales Performance & Store KPI Analytics
Sales KPI Tracking: Monitor, analyze, and report on daily, weekly, and monthly sales performance across direct retail stores and e-commerce platforms against sales targets.
Store Productivity Analytics: Evaluate core store performance metrics, including Like-for-Like (LFL) sales growth, Average Transaction Value (ATV), Units Per Transaction (UPT), conversion rates, footfall/traffic trends, and sales per square foot/meter.
Sales Variance & Benchmark Analysis: Analyze store-level sales variances, identify top and underperforming stores, and perform cluster benchmarking to provide actionable recommendations to field operations.
2. Commercial Sales Budgeting & Revenue Forecasting
Sales Budgeting & Forecasting: Assist in formulating annual sales budgets, seasonal sales targets, and monthly rolling sales forecasts for all retail channels.
Promotional & Campaign Sales Impact: Evaluate the sales lift, revenue impact, and customer conversion efficiency of retail promotions, marketing campaigns, and seasonal sales events.
Store Network Feasibility: Conduct sales feasibility modeling and sales projection analysis for proposed new store openings, store relocations, and lease renewals.
3. Management Reporting & Executive Dashboards
Commercial Review Packs: Prepare weekly/monthly retail sales scorecards, executive performance decks, and operational KPI dashboards for senior management review.
Dashboard Automation: Leverage Business Intelligence (BI) tools and advanced Excel modeling to automate daily sales reporting, streamline data workflows, and improve reporting speed and accuracy.
4. Cross-Functional Commercial Support
Operations Alignment: Partner closely with Area Managers, Store Managers, and Marketing teams to translate sales data insights into store-level action plans.
Data Governance: Maintain accuracy and integrity across retail point-of-sale (POS) data, footfall counter systems, and commercial databases.
Candidate Profile & Qualifications
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Statistics, Finance, Economics, Data Analytics, or a related discipline.
Experience: Minimum 3–5 years of progressive experience in sales analysis, business analytics, or commercial planning, specifically within the fashion retail, FMCG, or multi-channel consumer goods sector .
Technical Skills:
Advanced data manipulation skills in Excel (complex formulas, dynamic modeling, Pivot Tables).
Hands-on experience with BI tools (Power BI or Tableau) and POS/sales reporting databases.
Analytical Capability: Sharp commercial intuition with a strong ability to spot sales trends, store abnormalities, and revenue opportunities within raw retail data.
Soft Skills: Excellent presentation and communication skills, with a proven ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable commercial stories for retail operations teams.
Languages: Proficient in spoken and written English and Chinese (Cantonese and Mandarin).

jd:
Eclipse Trading is a leading proprietary trading firm. Founded in 2007, we have over 120 employees across 4 office locations – Hong Kong (our HQ), Sydney, Shanghai and Chicago. Our trading expertise and strategies are deployed across several markets globally, focusing on various products including equity derivatives, delta one, ETFs, commodity derivatives, and cryptocurrency. Technology is inextricably linked to our trading strategies, creating an environment powered by intellectual curiosity, problem solving, and innovation.
We’re looking for an experienced Team Lead to lead our newly established Data Systems Team. The team will build Eclipse’s next-generation data platform for both research and real-time trading, spanning orchestration, storage, data access, and governance at scale. By delivering reliable and consistent solutions, the team will support a wide range of stakeholders across the company, including engineers, researchers, and traders.
As a Team Lead, you’ll set the vision for a centralized data framework and drive seamless orchestration, storage, and access across a wide range of datasets. This is a high-impact, long-term role focused on building new infrastructure and a new team—not applying incremental fixes to legacy systems. It also blends leadership with architecture and hands-on engineering to deliver robust, maintainable, and high-performing solutions across both hardware and software.
This is an onsite role located in Hong Kong, Shanghai or Sydney (with authorization to work in Shanghai or Sydney).
Responsibilities and Duties
Build and lead a high-performance Data Systems Team, including mentoring and career development.
Define and deliver Eclipse’s data platform roadmap, balancing business and technical priorities.
Design and implement a centralized data framework and the supporting applications.
Develop robust, maintainable, and high-performing data pipelines.
Drive performance optimizations across both hardware and software for quant research and regulatory data retention.
Manage, maintain, and expand dedicated hardware infrastructure for data systems.
Ensure reliability, uptime, and effective capacity planning for data workloads.
Partner with stakeholders across research, trading, and engineering to align data workflows with business needs.

Investigate upstream data sources, identify root causes of data issues, and implement sustainable corrective actions.

10+ years of experience as a Data Systems Engineer delivering production data platforms, with 2+ years leading and mentoring engineering teams.

title: Commercial Analysis Manager
teaser: Financial analysis role supporting budgeting, forecasting, profitability analysis, and performance reporting for healthcare logistics operations.
jd:
About the Company
DCH Auriga is an Asia-based integrated market management provider specializing in healthcare. Offering comprehensive commercial and logistics solutions, DCH Auriga partners with the world’s leading healthcare companies to distribute pharmaceuticals, medical devices, surgical equipment, diagnostics and OTC products for more than 500 brands into hospitals, pharmacies and specialty stores across Asia. DCH Auriga is a subsidiary of Dah Chong Hong Holdings Limited with operations in Hong Kong, Macau, China, Singapore, Malaysia, Brunei, Thailand, Indonesia, Vietnam and the Philippines. For more details, please visit www.dchauriga.com.
>
About the Role
As an (Assistant) Commercial Analysis Manager , you will sit within our Healthcare Logistics business unit and play a key role in driving commercial performance across our regional healthcare distribution network. You will turn complex logistics, pricing and operational data into clear business insights, helping to maximize revenue growth, optimize profit margins and support executive decision-making in a highly regulated environment.
>
Key Responsibilities
1. Commercial Performance
Monitor and analyze daily, weekly, and monthly healthcare logistics commercial KPIs
Conduct margin analysis and risk assessments for pharmaceutical clients, hospitals, and clinic channels.
Regularly review the cost-efficiency of cold chain and temperature-controlled logistics to identify root causes of operational leakage or yield loss.
Design, maintain, and automate commercial performance dashboards using BI tools (e.g., Power BI).
2. Commercial Strategy & Pricing Management
Support pricing model design for major pharmaceutical and medical device tenders (RFP/RFQ) to ensure bids are market-competitive yet highly profitable.
Evaluate the ROI and cost structures of different business model.
Facilitate the annual budgeting process, rolling revenue forecasting, and commercial growth planning.
Track market trends (e.g., pharma e-commerce, specialized specialty drug distribution) to identify expansion opportunities.
3. Cross-Functional Collaboration & Compliance
Partner with Sales and Operations/Customer Service teams to optimize business pipelines and contract fulfillment rates.
Align closely with the Finance department to ensure commercial performance data fully reconciles with financial P&L reporting.
Present performance insights and clear Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) for lagging metrics to senior leadership.
>
Requirements
Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Statistics, Data Analytics or a healthcare-related field.
2–4 years of experience in commercial analysis, commercial controlling, or business intelligence within logistics, 3PL, or the pharmaceutical/healthcare sector (Assistant Manager level).
Advanced proficiency in MS Excel (financial modelling, pivot tables) and solid experience with Power BI or similar visualization tools.
Familiarity with logistics systems (WMS, TMS) and CRM (e.g. Salesforce) is highly advantageous.
Prior knowledge of GDP (Good Distribution Practice) or healthcare supply chain dynamics is a strong asset.
Highly analytical mindset with strong commercial acumen, problem-solving ability and data storytelling skills.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical data to non-technical stakeholders, and resilience in a fast-paced healthcare environment.
>
All information received will be treated in strict confidence and will be used exclusively for recruitment-related purposes. Applicants who do not receive a response within eight weeks from the date of submission may consider their application unsuccessful for the position concerned. All personal data collected will be retained for a period of six months.

title: 產品營運及用戶策略（Product Operations & User Strategy）
teaser: Management Trainee in Product Operations & User Strategy leveraging data and AI to optimize user monetization and retention.
jd:
Product Operations & User Strategy (Management Trainee)
The role involves establishing data-driven operational frameworks, optimizing user monetization through machine learning and CRM strategies, and conducting field research to understand local user psychology and preferences. This includes a 1–3 month on-site travel assignment in Africa.
About you
Must hold a Hong Kong Permanent Identity Card or a valid HK work visa (e.g., IANG, TTPS, QMAS)
Willingness to undertake a 1–3 month assignment in Africa
Bachelor's degree or above from a top-tier university (QS Top 100 preferred) in Statistics, Computer Science, Data Science, Business Analytics, Psychology, or related disciplines
Proficient in Python and SQL, Solid grasp of statistical methodologies, A/B testing, ROI attribution, and practical machine learning applications
Strong business acumen, user empathy, and cross-cultural communication skills to collaborate with global teams across time zones
Full professional proficiency in English and Mandarin (Cantonese is a plus)
Key responsibilities
Establish core business KPI frameworks and utilize machine learning algorithms (e.g., XGBoost, LightGBM) to build user churn prediction models
Partner with R&D and Big Data teams to supply data-driven insights and deploy automated retention interventions for local teams
Spearhead CRM and VIP Loyalty programs, enabling personalized content and product recommendations
Empower Country Managers with regional monetization insights to maximize user Lifetime Value (LTV) and deposit conversion rates
Conduct 1–3 months of field research in Africa to gain deep insights into local user psychology, culture, and entertainment preferences
Translate quantitative data and user insights into localized features and new gameplay concepts, driving them from design to execution
>
職位： 產品營運及用戶策略 (管培見習生)
工作地點： 香港（包含 1-3 個月非洲市場實地派駐）
要求：
語言及簽證要求： 英語及普通話流利 （可作全職工作語言，懂廣東話更佳）；須持有香港永久性居民身份 或可在港合法工作的有效簽證 （如 IANG、高才通 TTPS、優才 QMAS 等）；能接受 1-3 個月非洲海外派駐 。
學歷背景： 本科或以上學歷（全球 QS 前 100 或知名高校優先），統計學、數據科學、電腦科學、商業分析、心理學或相關學科。
專業技能： 熟練掌握 Python 及 SQL，具備扎實統計學與演算法基礎，熟悉 A/B 測試、ROI 歸因及機器學習應用。
商業洞察与溝通： 具備優秀的數據敏感度、跨文化溝通能力及項目推動力，能與全球團隊高效協作。
職責範疇：
數據驅動營運與用戶留存 (Churn Management)
建立核心商業數據指標體系，運用機器學習模型（如 XGBoost、LightGBM）預測用戶流失風險。
聯同產研與大數據團隊，為在地團隊提供策略支援，自動觸發個性化留存干預方案。
智能推薦與變現提升 (LTV & Monetization)
主導 CRM 與 VIP 忠誠度項目，推動遊戲內商業化內容的「千人千面」智能分發。
透過數據賦能國家經理（Country Manager）制定區域變現策略，提升用戶生命週期價值（LTV）及充值轉化率。
用戶心理洞察與本土化創新 (User Psychology & Localization)
配合 1-3 個月非洲實地考察，深度洞察細分市場的用戶心理與娛樂習慣。
結合定量數據與定性洞察，輸出本土化新玩法/新功能需求，並推動項目落地營運。

title: 理財規劃師 (Financial Planner )(歡迎轉行/Fresh Grad)
teaser: Financial planning role providing comprehensive asset allocation and wealth management solutions for high-net-worth clients.
bullet_points: 擺脫傳統保險/理財「跑數硬推產品」的刻板印象，主打宏觀經濟視野、多層次現金流與防守型架構，以真正專業的顧問角色贏得高淨值客戶長期信任，建立有尊嚴的專業形象。
15年+ 業界領袖 1-on-1 實戰親授，快速上手
提供優厚新人業務津貼疊加無上限佣金花紅，首年月入可達 $30,000–$60,000+；表現優異者最快 1–2 年即可晉升管理階層，打造屬於自己的財富管理團隊。
jd:
職位概述
本團隊現正招募具備宏觀視野與前瞻思維的理財規劃師。在這個資訊碎片化、市場周期劇烈變動的時代，我們拒絕流於表面的短線炒作與產品推銷。
本崗位旨在為客戶及其家庭提供超越傳統理財的全方位抗震理財藍圖與資產配置方案，建立穩健的多層次現金流防守體系。
工作職責
宏觀資產配置與動態調整：為客戶提供涵蓋進攻與防守的綜合戰略
專業理財策劃：深入分析客戶資產清單並作出個人化建議。定期進行檢視，確保客戶達到其訂下的理財目標
風險管理與防守戰略：協助客戶正視家庭責任成本，避免高風險借貸與盲目跟風，建立足以抵禦意外及市場風浪引起的財務危機
深度的客戶交流：了解客戶背景、長期目標及風險承受能力，建立長遠信任關係，傳遞正確且專業的理財哲學。
職位要求
學歷背景: （a）已完成中五學業，或具備同等學歷；（b）中英數良好，在香港中學文憑考試或香港中學會考中國語文科或英國語文科考獲第2級或以上成績，以及數學科考獲第2級成績；（c）具備合銷售經驗者優先。
行業經驗：具備證券、銀行、保險或理財策劃行業經驗（擁有豐富跨領域經驗或同級資歷者將獲優先考慮）。
亦誠意歡迎具跨行業經驗（如地產、零售管理、客戶服務等）且渴望轉型挑戰高薪之優秀人才。
專業特質： 具備良好人際溝通能力與同理心，認同「理財是為人生爭取選擇權」的價值觀。
合規資格： 具備 IIQE 卷一、三資格者優先（未考取者團隊將提供全套考牌輔導及備考資源）。
抗壓與應變能力：能在瞬息萬變的市場中穩住陣腳，具備強大的邏輯分析與問題解決能力。
我們提供
穩健收入架構： 具競爭力之月度新人業務津貼 + 優厚佣金 + 年終花紅 + 激勵獎金（首年目標預期月入 $30,000 – $60,000+，表現優異者不設上限）。
頂尖導師帶教（1-on-1 Mentorship）： 由逾 15 年資深行業領袖親自帶領，傳授實戰獲客系統、談判心理學及高淨值客戶經營心法。
階梯式專業培訓： 涵蓋環球經濟宏觀分析、信託與傳承架構、醫療保險深度對比、商務簡報技巧等全方位的知識體系。
快速透明的晉升階梯： 表現卓越者可在 1–2 年內晉升管理層，組建並領導專屬理財顧問團隊。
靈活自主的工作模式： 彈性工作時間，自主規劃日常拜訪與生活平衡，海外激勵旅遊會議機會。
如果你渴望擺脫短視的產品銷售，立志成為守護客戶資產、為家庭建立安穩生活的專業理財策劃師，歡迎加入我們的精英團隊！
>

title: AI Solution Specialist
teaser: Join the dynamic team and create a brilliant future.
jd:
About the role
You're the front line on business needs — understanding what stakeholders actually need, helping define the problem, and drafting requirements with AI. At the same time, as part of the PMO team, you'll use AI as your everyday working method and build your own tools to support the day-to-day running of the company's core-system project portfolio — helping maintain plans, track progress, log risks and prepare reporting.
>
What you'll do
Understand how the business systems work — Track data quality, field usage and how business teams actually use the core systems (primarily CRM) day to day. Notice when something is off and dig into why.
Help define the problem — Don't just record what's asked for; try to understand what's really needed. Push back with a question rather than taking a request at face value.
Draft requirements — Use AI to draft the business sections of the SDD spec — problem statement, success metrics, business rules, edge cases — for the Solution Architect or a senior colleague to review, then finalise with engineering.
Validate & follow through — Help gather data after launch to confirm whether a feature achieved what it set out to do.
Manage core-system projects — Build your own tools with AI for project tracking, status updates, meeting notes and follow-ups. Do it manually twice, automate it the third time. Managing your own workflow this way is a baseline expectation of the role, not a separate responsibility to be assessed on its own.
Use AI to speed up bilingual documentation — AI drafts the parallel version; you own terminology consistency and review.
>
What we're looking for
One to two years in business analysis, product support or related work in a technology environment; strong graduates with real AI-building work are welcome
Strong written English and Chinese; fluent Mandarin — requirement drafts and reporting are written in either language depending on the audience, and sometimes in parallel bilingual versions.
Basic familiarity with business systems (e.g. CRM platforms), or a fast willingness to learn the data model and business processes
Structured documentation skills — can turn a vague business ask into a clear problem statement
AI as a default working method — not just for writing, but for building your own tools; must demonstrate live AI use in the interview, a self-built tool is a strong plus
Curious, comfortable being pushed back on your own understanding, learns fast
>
Nice to have
Fintech or lending background · CRM / loan-management system exposure · Lark/Feishu automation · Jira / Confluence

Your role
Are you a scientist who wants to understand what drives the value of stocks? Do you enjoy using empirical methods to extract information from hundreds, or thousands, of datapoints? When your research ideas run up against data limitations, do you welcome the challenge? Do you enjoy staking out a position on what is about to happen, communicating your reasoning to skeptical audiences, and then finding out if you turned out to be right or wrong? Are you excited by the prospect of working in dynamic and diverse teams with a broad range of skillsets? Does your head turn if someone asks, "Now how might we take this hypothesis to data?" >• work closely with stock analysts to design, curate, and maintain datasets that can be used to inform their investment views

>• connect empirical findings to investment recommendations succinctly, both verbally and in writing
>• educate colleagues about replicable statistical computing workflows and habits
>• bridge between client-facing stock analyst franchises and technical resources including quantitative, data, and computing platforms

You will connect that specialized knowledge to your existing expertise in the empirical social sciences, helping to establish the next frontier of sell-side equity research.

jd:

Company Description
The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. It employs roughly 413,000 associates worldwide (as of December 31, 2025). The company generated sales of 91 billion euros in 2025. Its operations are divided into four business sectors: Mobility, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology. With its business activities, the company aims to use technology to help shape universal trends such as automation, digitalization, electrification, and artificial intelligence. In this context, Bosch’s broad diversification across regions and industries strengthens its innovativeness and robustness. Bosch uses its proven expertise in hardware, software, and service to offer customers cross-domain solutions from a single source. It also applies its expertise in connectivity and artificial intelligence in order to develop and manufacture intelligent, user-friendly, and sustainable products. With technology that is “Invented for life,” Bosch wants to help improve quality of life and conserve natural resources. The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 500 subsidiary and regional companies in over 60 countries. Including sales and service partners, Bosch’s global manufacturing, engineering, and sales network covers nearly every country in the world. Bosch’s innovative strength is key to the company’s further development. Bosch employs some 82,000 associates in research and development.
We are inviting suitably qualified candidates for the following position in our Power Tools Measuring Tools Division - responsible for the development of levelling tools for private and professional users.
>
Job Description
Role Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled AI Agent Developer to design, develop, deploy, and optimize intelligent AI agents that automate business processes, support decision-making, and enhance user experiences. The ideal candidate will combine expertise in Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), agent orchestration frameworks, API integrations, and enterprise architecture to build scalable AI-driven solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop autonomous and semi-autonomous AI agents using modern agent frameworks.
Build scalable, high-performance backend microservices, asynchronous workers, and RESTful APIs using Python and FastAPI.
Design, optimize, and maintain relational and non-relational database schemas, queries, and data storage layers supporting AI workflows.
Integrate with and consume curated enterprise data from Databricks, Azure Blob Storage, and internal data lakes to power agent workflows and RAG pipelines.
Leverage Azure Cloud & AI Services (e.g., Blob Storage, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search) for scalable model serving, storage, and retrieval.
Build and maintain multi-agent systems that collaborate to achieve business objectives.
Develop AI workflows leveraging LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and knowledge management systems.
Integrate AI agents with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, ERP, CRM, procurement, and workflow platforms.
Create tools, plugins, and function-calling capabilities enabling agents to execute business actions.
Implement prompt engineering, reasoning workflows, memory management, and agent orchestration strategies.
Ensure backend and AI solutions meet security, compliance, privacy, and governance requirements.
Monitor, evaluate, and optimize agent performance, accuracy, latency, and cost efficiency.
Collaborate with business stakeholders to identify and prioritize AI automation opportunities.
Document architecture, deployment procedures, and technical designs.
Stay current with advancements in Generative AI, agentic AI, and emerging technologies.
>
Qualifications
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
5+ years of software development experience.
Strong proficiency in Python, including hands-on experience building asynchronous services with FastAPI.
Solid database knowledge, including data modeling, indexing, and query optimization across relational (SQL) and/or NoSQL databases.
Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure services (Azure AI Services / Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Blob Storage).
Hands-on experience with Generative AI solutions, Large Language Models, RAG pipelines and agentic workflows.
Experience with code-first AI agent and orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, LangChain).

title: AI Solution Specialist
teaser: Join the dynamic team and create a brilliant future.
jd:
About the role
You're the front line on business needs — understanding what stakeholders actually need, helping define the problem, and drafting requirements with AI. At the same time, as part of the PMO team, you'll use AI as your everyday working method and build your own tools to support the day-to-day running of the company's core-system project portfolio — helping maintain plans, track progress, log risks and prepare reporting.
>What you'll do
Understand how the business systems work — Track data quality, field usage and how business teams actually use the core systems (primarily CRM) day to day. Notice when something is off and dig into why.
Help define the problem — Don't just record what's asked for; try to understand what's really needed. Push back with a question rather than taking a request at face value.
Draft requirements — Use AI to draft the business sections of the SDD spec — problem statement, success metrics, business rules, edge cases — for the Solution Architect or a senior colleague to review, then finalise with engineering.
Validate & follow through — Help gather data after launch to confirm whether a feature achieved what it set out to do.
Manage core-system projects — Build your own tools with AI for project tracking, status updates, meeting notes and follow-ups. Do it manually twice, automate it the third time. Managing your own workflow this way is a baseline expectation of the role, not a separate responsibility to be assessed on its own.
Use AI to speed up bilingual documentation — AI drafts the parallel version; you own terminology consistency and review.
>What we're looking for
One to two years in business analysis, product support or related work in a technology environment; strong graduates with real AI-building work are welcome
Strong written English and Chinese; fluent Mandarin — requirement drafts and reporting are written in either language depending on the audience, and sometimes in parallel bilingual versions.
Basic familiarity with business systems (e.g. CRM platforms), or a fast willingness to learn the data model and business processes
Structured documentation skills — can turn a vague business ask into a clear problem statement
AI as a default working method — not just for writing, but for building your own tools; must demonstrate live AI use in the interview, a self-built tool is a strong plus
Curious, comfortable being pushed back on your own understanding, learns fast
>Nice to have
Fintech or lending background · CRM / loan-management system exposure · Lark/Feishu automation · Jira / Confluence

title: Systems Analyst (Application Development & Support)
teaser: The candidate will focus on application support, design, development, and system enhancement, contributing to DevOps practices etc.
jd:
SCHOOL OF CONTINUING EDUCATION
>
The School of Continuing Education, one of the seven Faculties/Schools of the University and a major provider of continuing and professional education in Hong Kong, offers a wide range of full-time and part-time programmes at the post-secondary, undergraduate and postgraduate levels for young learners and working adults. It also offers in-house training and short courses to meet the community needs and market demands. Operated on a self-financed basis, the School and its College of International Education currently employ about 400 full-time staff and 500 part-time instructors. The School is inviting applications for the following position:
>
Systems Analyst (Application Development & Support) (Ref. No.: 26•••115 )
>
The appointee is expected to perform the following duties:
>
We are building a high‑performance IT team to support the ongoing digital transformation and future growth of the School. We are looking for a strong, motivated candidate who is passionate about application design, system development, and delivering meaningful business impact through technology.
>
This role offers an opportunity to become a core member of our IT application team, working closely with business stakeholders to enhance mission‑critical systems and deliver modern, scalable solutions. The successful candidate will play an important role in supporting, maintaining, and modernizing legacy applications while contributing to new system development, supporting the transformation journey in a complex and evolving environment.
>
Key Responsibilities:
The candidate will focus on application support, design, development, and system enhancement, contributing to DevOps practices that streamline deployment, improve system stability, and support continuous improvement
Map, analyze, and document interfaces between legacy systems and new platforms, ensuring seamless integration and efficient, reliable data exchange
Perform end‑to‑end software development lifecycle activities, including requirements gathering, system design, development, testing, implementation, and ongoing maintenance
Design and develop innovative application solutions and contribute to product and system enhancement initiatives
Enhance and modernize existing legacy applications to support institutional transformation and evolving operational needs
Prepare and maintain comprehensive testing and system documentation, ensuring quality, reliability, and adherence to delivery timelines
Produce clear and user‑friendly manuals to support effective adoption and optimal utilization of new systems
Collaborate closely with IT colleagues and business users on institution‑wide IT initiatives and projects
Perform other IT projects and assignments as assigned
>
Requirements:
Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology or related discipline
At least 5 years of relevant work experience in end‑to‑end application development, covering front‑end, back‑end, and database design and development, with experience in responsive design and system integration. (Candidates with less relevant experience are welcome to apply and may be considered for an associate-level role)
Strong hands-on solid proven experience in the following programming languages: Java, PHP, Python, RESTful API, SQL and shell script;
Good knowledge of any of the following is an advantage: Docker, Kubernetes, MS Power Platform, PowerBuilder, Sybase database, Jira and test automation tools;
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and address complex system issues; and
Possess solid written and verbal communication skills to both technical and non-technical audiences, and strong commitment-to-task. Proficiency in both English and Chinese is required.
>
Shortlisted candidates will be invited to attend a written assessment.
>
The initial appointment will be offered on a fixed-term one contract ending in August 2027. Re-appointment thereafter is subject to mutual agreement and availability of funding.
>Salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience.
>
Application Procedure:
Applicants are invited to submit their applications at the HKBU e-Recruitment System. Those who are not invited for interview 8 weeks after submission of application may consider their applications unsuccessful. Details of the University’s Personal Information Collection Statement can be found at https://hro.hkbu.edu.hk/en/worklife-at-hkbu/employee-favourable-environment.html#privacy-policy.
>
The School reserves the right not to make an appointment for the post advertised, and the appointment will be made according to the terms and conditions applicable at the time of offer.
>
Review of applications is ongoing until the position is filled.

jd:
About the Role
We are seeking a highly conversion-driven marketer with solid e-commerce and promotional experience to join our young, energetic team. Operating within a fast-paced, startup-like culture backed by HK01, this role focuses heavily on driving bottom-funnel performance. You will take extreme ownership of platform traffic, executing targeted event and SKU-level promotions to hit strict conversion KPIs and maximize ticket sales.
>Responsibilities:
E-Commerce & Platform Operations: Manage the daily operations of the 01Space ticketing platform, including product listings, order fulfillment, promotional setups, and content preparation.
SKU & Event-Level Promotion: Spearhead targeted promotional campaigns across the platform, focusing specifically on individual events and SKUs to drive ticket sales and Gross Merchandise Value (GMV).
Conversion Optimization: Take direct ownership of conversion-based KPIs. Design and execute high-converting tactical promotions (e.g., flash sales, promo codes, exclusive bundling) and continuously A/B test marketing channels to drive ROI.
Omnichannel Campaign Management: Plan and oversee the launch timeline for comprehensive deliverables across a 360-degree marketing mix (Social Media, Display Banners, Native Ads, SEM, SEO, EDM, Push Notifications, O2O Roadshows, etc.).
Performance Tracking & Analytics: Monitor daily key metrics, analyze user traffic and market data, and translate insights into actionable optimizations to improve the end-to-end customer journey.
Partnership Collaboration: Nurture strong relationships with event organizers and external partners to seek brand exposure and leverage mutual brand value.
>
Requirements & Culture Fit
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, e-Commerce, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
Targeted Experience: 3-year solid, hands-on experience in e-commerce marketing and tactical promotions, ideally within a ticketing, marketplace, or high-volume retail platform.
Analytical & KPI-Driven: Proven track record of taking ownership of direct sales targets, with a deep understanding of conversion rate optimization (CRO), performance marketing, and data-driven decision-making.
Startup Agility: Thrives in a highly energetic, fast-paced "startup-style" environment; comfortable pivoting quickly to capitalize on new market trends.
Results & Team-Oriented: Relentlessly focused on outcomes with a strong appetite for hitting GMV targets, while remaining a highly collaborative player who brings positive energy to the team.
Proactive Mindset: Possesses a resilient "can-do" attitude with a strong bias for action, ready to roll up your sleeves and work independently to get things done.
Communication: Excellent interpersonal skills for cross-functional collaboration in a matrix environment. Highly proficient in written and spoken English and Chinese (Cantonese/Mandarin).
>

About AIA

title: Business & AI Associate
teaser: Work with senior management to explore AI, improve workflows, test new tools and turn useful ideas into practical business improvements.
jd:
The Opportunity
Work closely with senior management at an established Hong Kong-headquartered international financial services firm to explore how AI, technology and better ways of working can improve the business.
We are looking for a highly curious and proactive person who enjoys discovering new tools, experimenting with them, understanding how businesses work, and turning ideas into something useful.
Your objective is simple:
Understand how the firm operates, identify problems and opportunities, explore possible solutions, build and test ideas, and implement what works.
This is not a traditional IT support role or an AI research position. We are not hiring an engineer to work against a fixed technical roadmap. What matters is whether what you build, test or introduce actually improves the business.
What You Will Do
You will spend time across the firm understanding how work actually gets done, where time is being wasted, and where processes are unnecessarily manual, repetitive or complicated.
You will:
explore AI, automation and new software that could improve the way we work
understand existing workflows and identify opportunities for improvement
simplify processes before trying to automate them
experiment with different tools and build simple prototypes, workflows or internal solutions
test ideas with employees, learn from what happens and improve them
help colleagues use AI and technology more effectively in their everyday work
work with internal IT colleagues or external specialists when deeper technical expertise is required
Some assignments will start with us saying:
“We have this problem. Find a better way.”
But we also want the reverse:
You discover something, experiment with it, show us what you found, and together we decide whether there is a business opportunity worth pursuing.
The Person We Are Looking For
You are probably the kind of person who sees a new AI tool and wants to try it before anyone asks you to.
Perhaps you have built a small app, automated something that annoyed you, experimented with AI-assisted coding, tried a new platform, or spent an evening figuring something out simply because you wanted to know what it could do.
That instinct matters to us.
But this role is not just about playing with the latest technology. You also need to be interested in how a business actually works.
One day you might be experimenting with a new AI tool. Another might involve sitting with a colleague for two hours, understanding exactly how they handle emails, documents and spreadsheets, and discovering that the best solution has nothing to do with AI.
Sometimes the answer will be AI. Sometimes it will be automation. Sometimes it will simply be a better process.
Knowing the difference is important.
You will be the person primarily responsible for exploring these opportunities, so you should be comfortable working independently. There will not always be a detailed roadmap telling you what to investigate or what to try next.
What Would Make You Stand Out
You do not need to be an AI engineer or professional programmer.
What matters more is whether you learn independently, experiment with new tools, ask good questions, build things, and turn ideas into practical improvements.
Experience with ChatGPT, Claude, Microsoft Copilot, workflow automation, Microsoft 365, Power Automate, SharePoint, no-code or low-code tools, AI-assisted coding, APIs, Python or data analysis would be useful, but we do not expect you to know everything.
Experience in financial services or insurance is helpful but not essential.
A Real Business Environment
We operate in financial services, so confidentiality, data security and appropriate controls matter.
The challenge is not simply finding the newest technology. It is understanding how new technology can be used practically, safely and intelligently in a real business environment.
Who Should Apply
This role is particularly suited to fresh graduates and candidates with up to around two years of professional experience who want unusually broad exposure early in their careers.
You will work closely with senior management, see how different parts of a business operate, and have the opportunity to turn your own ideas into improvements that people actually use.
As you develop, there is scope to take on increasing responsibility for business improvement, automation and AI adoption across the firm.
Strong written and spoken English and fluent Cantonese are required.

teaser: This position offers the opportunity to work on innovative projects and contribute to the development of advanced AI solutions
jd:
Job Description
>As a Large Model Algorithm Engineer, you will focus on the technical research and development of Large Language Models (LLMs) and multimodal large models, driving their application in industrial vertical domains. You will participate in core processes such as model training, optimization, and inference deployment while collaborating with top university research teams to explore cutting-edge technologies and improve model performance and efficiency.
Key Responsibilities
Responsible for training, fine-tuning (SFT), and system deployment of vertical domain large models, promoting efficient application of large models in industrial environments.
Research and implement compression and optimization techniques for large models, including pruning, quantization, and knowledge distillation, to improve inference efficiency and deployment performance.
Participate in the algorithm design and development of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) and Agent modules to enhance reasoning capabilities in dynamic and complex environments.
Research and apply multimodal understanding technologies to optimize the application of Large Vision Models (LVM) in industrial vision and other fields.
Translate business rules into efficient workflow code and participate in the design and implementation of Agentic Workflow to enhance workflow intelligence.
Build industry datasets to support large model training and applications, including data preprocessing, pretraining data construction, and training/application/evaluation dataset setup.
Research and implement large model merging techniques, exploring collaborative optimization solutions for multiple models.
Develop and maintain validation, evaluation, and performance monitoring processes for large models to ensure system stability and usability.
Participate in the development and optimization of large model application platforms (microservices) to enhance system modularity and usability.
Qualifications
Master’s degree or higher in Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field is preferred.
Proficient in machine learning, deep learning, and Transformer architecture, with hands-on experience in end-to-end training and development of large models.
Familiar with large model compression and optimization methods such as pruning, quantization, and knowledge distillation.
Strong capabilities in large-scale data processing and familiarity with big data tools (e.g., Hadoop, Spark), with experience in data preprocessing, cleaning, and building training datasets.
Skilled in Python, C/C++, and Linux programming, with a solid foundation in algorithms and data structures.
Familiar with mainstream large model training and inference frameworks such as PyTorch, Hugging Face (HF), DeepSpeed, PEFT, vLLM, TRL, etc.
Knowledge of Triton or other high-performance inference tools, with experience in applying model optimization to real-world deployments.
Proficient in Docker and Linux shell scripting; experience with FastAPI development is a plus.
Experience in enterprise-level large model development, optimization, deployment, and tool development is preferred.
Strong teamwork and communication skills, capable of collaborating with cross-domain teams.
Passionate about cutting-edge large model technologies and their applications in industrial vertical domains.
Bonus Points
Experience in RAG systems and Agent module development and optimization.
Familiarity with CUDA programming, distributed computing, or related high-performance computing technologies.
Publications in top-tier conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICLR, CVPR).
Knowledge of hardware acceleration technologies (e.g., GPU, TPU) and their applications in model optimization.

Who we are
TMax is an AI inference platform built for Asia. We buy model capacity straight from Chinese labs — ByteDance/Volcengine, Alibaba, Kuaishou — at origin pricing, and serve it through one OpenAI-compatible API. 50+ models across video, image, text and speech, with video as our core market. On top of that we ship white-label apps for companies that want a finished product rather than raw tokens.
Small team, real customers, a lot of ground to cover.
What this actually is
In a given fortnight you might price a new video model, dig through a supplier contract for the clause that changes what we're allowed to resell, rewrite a section of the website, help a customer get their integration working, chase down why a pod won't start, and put together a deck for Friday.
You won't know how to do most of that on day one. What matters is that you figure it out and come back with something finished.
What you'd work on
Platform — our Go API gateway and the adaptors that connect each upstream provider, onboarding new models and getting their billing right, the Kubernetes cluster everything runs on, test sweeps across the image and video models we serve, and shipping features on top of the API.
Commercial — pricing and margin models across the catalogue, competitive benchmarking against comeptitors, supplier contract review, billing and payments reconciliation across Stripe and Airwallex, and the website, decks and onboarding docs that go out to customers and partners.
The two sides feed each other, which is the whole reason this is one role. The person who onboards the model is the person who knows what it costs, and the person who reads the supplier contract is the person who knows what we're allowed to build.
What we're looking for
Three things we won't compromise on:
You work independently. We'll tell you what needs solving, not how. Decide anything reversible yourself and only bring us the things that genuinely need a call. When you bring something, lead with the recommendation and put the reasoning underneath — we should be able to act on it in a few minutes, not read twenty pages and guess what you think.
You'll go anywhere. Engineering one day, contracts the next, a landing page after that. If some part of that makes you think "not my thing," this isn't the role.
fYou use agent harnesses properly. Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode — whichever, but daily and fluently, including the config layer (instruction files, custom commands, skills, MCP, hooks). More importantly: you know what to check before it ships. Agents are confidently wrong all the time, and your work touches billing and production.
Also required:
Mandarin, written and spoken. Supplier docs, consoles, contracts and support are largely Chinese-only, and our collateral goes out bilingually.
Good written English — the decks and briefs go to enterprise buyers.
Proficient Programming in any Language. Any language. You need to read a diff and tell whether the approach makes sense, not just whether it runs. You do not need to be a strong engineer — the bar is "can direct and check," not "can build unaided."
Comfortable in a terminal. Git, logs, env vars, running something locally.
Solid with spreadsheets. You'll be expected to deliver documents to help facilitate decision-making in a short period of time with less help from agents when dealing with spreadsheets.
You learn fast. Go, Kubernetes, Docker, contract review — pick them up as you go. Prior experience is a bonus, not an expectation.
Nice if you have it: exposure to APIs and usage-based billing, some sense of the Chinese model ecosystem (Doubao, Qwen/Wan, Kling, MiniMax, DeepSeek), an eye for design.
What you'll own
Real ownership, not shadowing. Two halves, both yours to run:
Technical
The gateway and its adaptors. Our gateway (Go) normalises requests across every upstream provider and bills for them. Providers handle multimodal input very differently — some fold any number of images into a content array, some take only the first and quietly drop the rest, some have no images field at all. Knowing those differences across the Doubao, Vidu, Alibaba, Jimeng, Kling, Hailuo, MuleRouter and Gemini/Vertex adaptors is a big part of the job.
Model onboarding, end to end. Read the provider's docs (often Chinese-only), test the endpoint, map the request and response shapes, extend the adaptor, register the channel, configure the billing, and verify against real call logs before it goes live with assistance from the tech team.
Billing configuration. Per-token ratio, tiered expressions, per-call fixed price, upstream-response passthrough — including resolution-tiered video billing. When the billing system can't express what commercial needs, you get it built.
Infrastructure. The Kubernetes estate (k3s under Rancher): Deployments, Services and targetPort routing, ingress, namespaces, secrets, and the reverse-proxy gateway in front of it. Building and publishing Docker images. Debugging production to root cause when a 502 shows up.
Model QA. Test sweeps across the full catalogue on payload validation, field normalisation, timeouts and output quality. Then reports that separate our bugs from upstream behaviour we need to document and price around.
Business
Pricing and margin. The cost-to-price model across the catalogue: landed supplier cost, markup, customer price, margin per call. Plus competitive benchmarking against competitors, normalised properly — /image, $/1M tokens split in and out, sources cited. Flag it early when margin starts eroding.
Supplier contracts. Read them and pull out what actually constrains us — resale restrictions, minimum commitments, platform-operator obligations, price-adjustment rights — and make sure our customer-facing terms line up.
Billing ops and reconciliation. Prepaid wallet and PAYG mechanics, top-ups across Stripe and Airwallex, and tying payment rails to wallet credits to gateway logs to the books when something doesn't match.
The website and everything that goes out. Model catalogue, pricing presentation, copy. Plus decks, partner briefs, API onboarding guides and one-pagers — in English and Chinese, to a standard that goes to an enterprise buyer without anyone rewriting it.
Customer work. Helping trial accounts get integrated, and turning what they tell you into pricing and product signal rather than testimonials.
Why bother
You'll touch the whole business — pricing, contracts, infrastructure, product, customers — in a market that's moving faster than almost anything else right now. You'll be trusted to make calls rather than asked to draft options. And you'll come out of it able to point at things that actually shipped.
Strong performers have a route to a full-time offer.
>

Integrations with Salesforce, Shopify, and OneSignal—learn and own end-to-end
jd:
About the role
We're looking for a hands-on Backend Engineer to help us build and maintain reliable backend services on AWS. You'll focus on APIs, data flows, and integrations that power our web and mobile experiences. Ideal if you've connected third-party platforms like Salesforce, Shopify, and push notification providers (e.g., OneSignal).
What you'll do
Build and maintain backend services and APIs on AWS (ECS, ECR, VPC, API Gateway, S3, CloudFront, RDS/Postgres, SQS).
Design and operate secure, highly reliable backend infrastructure (VPC networking, containerized services on ECS).
Implement integrations with Salesforce (REST/Bulk APIs), Shopify, and push notifications (OneSignal or similar).
Write clean, well-documented API endpoints (REST/GraphQL) and maintain clear schema/contracts.
Set up basic CI/CD and monitoring; contribute to Infrastructure as Code (CloudFormation/Terraform) with guidance.
Ensure security, reliability, and performance basics: authentication/authorization, input validation, caching, logs/metrics/alerts.
Collaborate with frontend/mobile teams to deliver features on time and with quality.
Requirements
3+ years of backend development experience (Node.js or Go preferred; Python a strong plus).
Practical experience building on AWS (ECS, ECR, VPC, API Gateway, S3, CloudFront, RDS/Postgres, SQS).
Comfortable with REST APIs; exposure to GraphQL helpful.
Experience integrating at least one of: Salesforce, Shopify, or OneSignal (or similar).
Understanding of authentication best practices (OAuth/JWT, IAM basics) and OWASP fundamentals.
Clear communication in English and a collaborative, problem-solving mindset.
Nice to have
Experience with webhooks, event-driven patterns (SNS/SQS, Redis), and rate limiting.
Familiarity with headless CMS (Strapi, Contentful, Sanity, Prismic, Hygraph, WordPress headless).
Exposure to Next.js/React integrations and preview environments.
Terraform basics and setting up simple CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).

Execute full-lifecycle management of major research projects (requirement analysis, proposal formulation, progress control, and completion acceptance) to ensure high-quality project delivery.

Education: Master's or Ph.D. degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Automation, Robotics, or related disciplines.

jd:
ACCESS is a multi-disciplinary center for advancing IC design and design automation technologies to enable novel data-centric computing paradigms supporting a wide range of AI applications. The research agenda in ACCESS is organized into four research programs, addressing four key technical areas, including 1) Computing-in-Memory Architecture for Large-scale AI Models, 2) Hardware-Software Co-Design for Energy-Efficient and High-Performance Edge AI, 3) EDA (Electronic Design Automation) for Large-Scale AI Hardware, and 4) Cross-layer Optimization and Demonstration for Targeted Applications.
ACCESS is seeking high caliber appointees for multiple full-time positions of Research Assistant of our four research programs through the scheme of Research Talent Hub (RTH) of Innovation Technology Commissioner.
Responsibilities
The Research Assistants are expected to be involved in the development of one or multiple research programs and projects in the Center. He/she will conduct research and development tasks that are assigned by the Principal and/or Senior Researchers. He/she is required to station and work at the Hong Kong Science Park, with occasional business travels to HKUST Clear Water Bay Campus and other Partner Universities of the Center when needed.
Requirements
Applicants should have a master degree (MSc or MPhil) preferably in electronics, electrical or computer engineering, computer science, or equivalent, with proven experience in integrated circuit design, design automation or broadly microelectronics and specialized in at least one or more of the technical areas of our four research programs. He/ She must be legally permitted to work in Hong Kong ; and in possession of a master degree of a STEM (i.e. Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics)-related discipline awarded by a local university, or jointly awarded by a local university together with a non-local university. Specifically, R&D as well as hands-on implementation experiences in the following area(s) with relevance to the design of AI accelerators are preferred (but not limited to):
ASIC design, FPGA prototyping, AI algorithm design;
Strong programming skills of at least one of the following languages: Verilog/VHDL, System Verilog, Python, C/C++, Matlab;
R&D experiences of using Cadence and Synopsys EDA tools or machine learning frameworks such as Caffe, Tensorflow and PyTorch.
The ideal candidate should have strong R&D motivation and sense of responsibility, ability to multi-task and work independently, and a good command of written and spoken English.
Terms of Appointment
Starting salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. Fringe benefits including annual leave, medical and dental benefits will be provided. (Duration: 1 year, renewable)
ACCESS is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from all qualified candidates.
Application Procedure
