company: AI Chip Center for Emerging Smart Systems Limited
title: Principal Researcher / Senior Researcher
teaser: Involved in one of the research programs and will conduct collaborative research in one or multiple research projects in the Center
jd:
ACCESS is a multi-disciplinary center for advancing IC design and design automation technologies to enable novel data-centric computing paradigms supporting a wide range of AI applications. The research agenda in ACCESS is organized into four research programs, addressing four key technical areas, including 1) Computing-in-Memory Architecture for Large-scale AI Models, 2) Hardware-Software Co-Design for Energy-Efficient and High-Performance Edge AI, 3) EDA (Electronic Design Automation) for Large-Scale AI Hardware, and 4) Cross-layer Optimization and Demonstration for Targeted Applications.
We are seeking outstanding applicants for full-time researcher positions of our four research programs at the AI Chip Center for Emerging Smart Systems Limited (ACCESS).
Responsibilities
The Principal Researcher will be involved in the development of multiple research programs and projects in the Center and will co-lead one of the four research programs in the Center. He/she will assist the Director and Executive Director overseeing all aspects of research management, scientific technological development, and operations for multiple research projects or research facilities. He/she will conduct research and development, as well as working with junior research staff, in one or multiple research projects in the Center.
We also seek applicants for the positions of Senior Researcher . Reporting to the Principal Researcher, Senior Researcher will be involved in one of the research programs and will conduct collaborative research in one or multiple research projects in the Center. He/she will conduct R&D tasks as well as working with junior research staff, in one or multiple research projects in the Center.
All researchers are required to station and work at the Hong Kong Science Park, with occasional business travels to HKUST Clear Water Bay Campus and other Partner Universities of the Center when needed.
Requirements
Applicants should have a PhD degree preferably in electronics, electrical or computer engineering, computer science, or equivalent, and at least 8 years and 3 years of post-qualification experience in R&D for the Principal Researcher and the Senior Researcher positions respectively plus specialized in at least one or more of the technical areas of our four research programs are welcome to apply. In-depth knowledge and experience in integrated circuit design, design automation or broadly microelectronics are essential. Specifically, R&D as well as hand-on implementation experiences in the following area(s) with relevance to the design of AI accelerators are preferred (but not limited to):
Neuromorphic computing, compute-in-memory (CIM) and relevant memory and storage systems;
Non-volatile memory (CVM), silicon photonic devices, or 3D integration for acceleration of computing or communications;
AI algorithm and architectural co-design; Neural network optimization for hardware implementation;
ASIC design; FPGA prototyping;
Design and implementation of chip/hardware accelerators for AI applications;
Hardware-software co-design; Electronics design automation (such as modelling, simulation, physical design, logic/high-level synthesis, verification, testing, design for manufacturability, etc.)
The ideal candidate should have strong R&D capability and superior interpersonal and organizational skills. He/ She should be an excellent team-player with a strong sense of responsibility, ability to multi-task and work independently, and a good command of written and spoken English. Outstanding verbal, written and presentation skills are also required.
Terms of Appointment
Starting salary will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. Fringe benefits including annual leave, medical and dental benefits will be provided.
ACCESS is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from all qualified candidates.
Application Procedure
For applications/nominations, please apply with a full curriculum vitae indicating their current and expected salaries . Review of applications will begin shortly and continue until the positions are filled. Only shortlisted candidates will be notified.
(Information provided by applications will be used for recruitment and other employment-related purposes.)

title: Software Engineer, Trading Systems
teaser: We are looking for a strong software engineer to help build and improve our trading and execution infrastructure.
bullet_points: gain exposure to both traditional and virtual asset markets

jd:
About Posley (https://posleyim.com)
Posley is a quantitative investment firm focused on opportunities across traditional and alternative markets.
We study how price, funding, liquidity, market structure and execution interact across markets, and build systematic trading strategies around those opportunities.
We combine the discipline of a licensed investment environment with the speed and ownership of a startup. Our core research, trading and technology capabilities are built in-house , so engineers work closely with researchers and traders and see their systems running in live markets.
>
The Role
We are looking for a strong software engineer to help build and improve our trading and execution infrastructure .
This is not a pure DevOps role and not a traditional backend role. You will work on systems that directly interact with live markets — including execution engines, exchange connectivity, position and order management, monitoring, reconciliation and production infrastructure.
You should be someone who cares about correctness, edge cases and details , while having enough trading intuition to understand why those details matter.
>
What You Will Work On
Develop exchange connectivity through WebSocket / REST APIs
Improve order, position and account state management
Handle execution edge cases, failures, retries and reconciliation
Build monitoring and safeguards for live trading systems
Improve latency, reliability and operational resilience
Investigate discrepancies in positions, balances, fills, fees and P&L
Support deployment, cloud infrastructure and DevOps where needed
Work directly with quantitative researchers to bring strategies into production
Because we are a startup, the scope will evolve. If something important sits between research, trading and infrastructure, you may end up owning it.
>
What We Are Looking For
Strong software engineering fundamentals
Experience building reliable backend or distributed systems
Strong attention to detail and a high standard for correctness
Able to reason about asynchronous systems, state and failure scenarios
Comfortable taking ownership without needing detailed instructions
Genuine interest in trading, markets or quantitative systems
Able to use AI coding agents effectively while critically reviewing and validating production-critical code
You do not need to be a quantitative researcher, but you should have enough numerical and market intuition to understand concepts such as:
orders, fills and positions
bid / ask and liquidity
exposure and P&L
fees and funding
latency and execution quality
basic risk controls
>
Technical Skills
﻿Our systems primarily use:
Python for trading, execution, research and analytics
TypeScript / Node.js across selected infrastructure and internal systems
AWS / Linux / Docker
Redis and messaging / streaming infrastructure
Time-series databases and monitoring systems
APIs across centralized and decentralized trading venues
Experience with every technology above is not required. Strong engineering ability matters more than matching the stack exactly.
>
Nice to Have
Experience with trading systems, exchanges or market data
Crypto exchange API experience
Low-latency or high-throughput systems
AWS / Linux / Docker production experience
Experience with reconciliation or financial systems
Understanding of market microstructure
Personal interest in systematic or algorithmic trading
>
Why Posley
You will not be maintaining one small component inside a large engineering organisation.
You will have the opportunity to:
work within a licensed quantitative investment environment
build systems used directly in live trading
gain exposure to both traditional and virtual asset markets
own meaningful pieces of production infrastructure
work closely with traders and quantitative researchers
see the impact of your engineering decisions quickly
solve problems across software, markets and infrastructure
>
We value people who are curious, rigorous, hands-on and serious about getting the details right.
If you enjoy building systems where small engineering details can have real financial consequences, we would like to hear from you.

jd:

聯同財務及其他相關團隊，搭建新業務及外部合作團隊引進的費用成本模型；結合預計業務規模、佣金收入、渠道費用、合作分成及相關投入，完成成本、收益及利潤空間測算。
根據不同業務及合作方案進行多情景經營分析，輸出經營測算及分析報告，協助管理層評估項目的商業可行性，為新業務及合作團隊引進決策提供數據支持。
負責新業務及外部合作團隊引進的全流程項目管理，統籌內外部多方及跨部門溝通協作，跟進項目全週期落地，協調解決推進過程中的各類問題。
跟進測算方案及合作安排的實際落地情況，持續追蹤收入、成本及業務表現，分析實際結果與測算方案的差異，並牽頭完成引進業務的經營復盤。
統籌業務落地的配套工作，推動財務、合規、營運、結算及其他相關部門的SOP對齊，打通內部承接流程，保障合作業務穩定營運。
在業務團隊引進及項目落地的全流程中，識別成本、收益及渠道合作等方面的潛在風險，及時同步風險情況，並協調各部門制定應對方案。
職位要求
具備3年或以上金融保險行業相關工作經驗，熟悉保險業務運作邏輯、行業費用結構及市場現況；具香港人壽保險或儲蓄型保險相關經驗者優先。
熟悉保險渠道的收入及費用構成，對保費、佣金收入、渠道費用、合作分成、激勵及營運成本等具備良好理解。
具備較強的數據分析及經營測算能力，能夠完成或協同完成業務成本、收益及利潤空間核算，並將分析結果轉化為業務建議。
具備良好的項目管理及跨部門協作能力，能夠跟進項目計劃、協調相關持份者並推動方案落地。
具備良好的商務溝通能力，能熟練使用粵語或英語其中一種語言開展外部對接工作。
我們提供
靈活的辦公地點選擇，可選擇於香港或深圳辦公。
完整的跨境金融業務歷練機會，深度參與新業務、新渠道及新團隊引進的全流程。
參與業務經營測算、管理層決策支持及合作項目落地的機會。
完善的薪酬體系及符合行業標準的福利。
清晰的晉升通道，以及在經營支持板塊橫向及縱向發展的空間。
Key Responsibilities
Work with Finance and other relevant teams to develop cost models for the introduction of new businesses and external partner teams. Assess costs, returns and profit potential based on projected business volume, commission income, channel expenses, partnership sharing arrangements and related investments.
Conduct scenario-based business analysis for different commercial and partnership proposals. Prepare financial assessment and analysis reports to evaluate commercial feasibility and support management decisions on new business and partner introductions.
Manage the end-to-end introduction of new businesses and external partner teams. Coordinate internal and external stakeholders across multiple functions, follow through on the full project lifecycle and resolve issues arising during implementation.
Monitor the implementation of approved financial assessments and partnership arrangements. Track actual revenue, costs and business performance, analyse variances against projections and lead periodic business reviews.
Coordinate the supporting work required for business implementation. Drive SOP alignment among Finance, Compliance, Operations, Settlement and other relevant teams, establish internal handover processes and ensure stable business operations.
Identify potential risks relating to costs, returns and channel partnerships throughout the introduction and implementation process. Communicate risks in a timely manner and coordinate appropriate mitigation plans with relevant teams.
Requirements
At least three years of relevant experience in the financial services or insurance industry, with a good understanding of insurance business models, industry cost structures and current market conditions. Experience in Hong Kong life insurance or savings insurance is preferred.
Good understanding of insurance distribution economics, including premiums, commission income, channel expenses, partnership sharing arrangements, incentives and operating costs.
Strong data analysis and business modelling capabilities, with the ability to independently complete or support the assessment of business costs, returns and profit potential, and translate findings into commercial recommendations.
Strong project management and cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to manage project plans, coordinate relevant stakeholders and drive implementation.
Strong business communication skills, with proficiency in either Cantonese or English for external stakeholder engagement.

Build scalable Growth Playbooks across areas such as product strategy, CRM, membership, advertising, KOL, AI and Marketing Automation.
Package resources across Marketing Services, Partnerships, Product, CRM, Advertising, AI, Logistics and other teams into simple, merchant-ready growth solutions.
Support the Team Head in coordinating cross-functional growth initiatives and preparing the recommendations and materials required for execution.
About you
5–8 years of relevant experience in e-commerce, brands, digital marketing, market research, strategy consulting, commercial strategy or growth-related roles.
Strong ecommerce understanding with the ability to turn data and market insights into practical merchant growth recommendations.
Able to identify and prioritise growth opportunities based on business outcomes such as traffic, conversion, GMV and retention.
Able to simplify complex information into actionable recommendations and work effectively across teams in a fast-moving environment.
Strong proficiency in Looker / Excel / Google Sheets and PowerPoint / Google Slides, with experience in data analysis, campaign planning, market insights or merchant growth strategy.

At SHOPLINE, we believe merchant success goes beyond providing ecommerce software. Our mission is to help merchants grow sustainable online businesses by combining technology, first-party commerce data and professional marketing services. Our team is smart, friendly, self-driven, and passionate about solving merchant growth challenges. We encourage open discussion, experimentation, and scaling what works. We operate in a flat and collaborative environment where you'll have the freedom to identify opportunities, propose new approaches, and drive high-impact initiatives from insight to adoption.

title: Applied Physics & Modelling - Color Scientist
teaser: Build the models that make an LED wall visually perfect — from photon to camera pixel to per-LED correction
jd:
Deepsky is a privately owned company based in Hong Kong that has been developing new technologies for LED screens for more than ten years. We build the industry’s first end-to-end video processing solution for LED displays:
Smart IC LED drivers (ASIC) featuring Deepsky’s patented Variable Current Technology, for outstanding HDR picture quality
FPGA-based gateway boards between the LED drivers and the Ethernet video distribution
A high-performance Linux GPU processor as screen controller
OrbitalCam, our robotic precision calibration camera for LED panel opto-electrical characterization in our customers’ factories
Picture quality is the entire point of our stack — and calibration is where it is won. Every LED on a Deepsky screen is individually photographed, measured and corrected.
You will take ownership of our calibration and color-science software: a Python monorepo of about twenty packages — pure algorithm libraries, calibration machine software, and the robotic acquisition layer — that turns camera and spectroradiometer measurements into per-LED corrections rendered live on the wall. This is an end-to-end ownership role: you design the pipeline that runs in production, improve its algorithms, and extend it as our silicon evolves.
The role
Calibrating a display is a physics problem before it is a software problem: how an LED’s emission responds to drive current, how it drifts with temperature, how its light spreads into its neighbours through the optics, how a camera and a spectroradiometer each see it — and how all of this is modelled well enough to correct every LED individually. You will own this physical understanding end to end: the models, the measurement science behind our robotic calibration station, and the Python pipeline that turns both into per-LED corrections rendered live on the wall.
Responsibilities
Model the display’s physical behaviour: LED emission and non-linearity versus drive current, thermal drift, optical crosstalk between neighbouring LEDs (PSF), angular dependence — and turn these models into per-LED corrections
Own the measurement science of the calibration station: camera radiometry (exposure, flat-fielding, geometric correction, PSF deconvolution), optical filter characterization, spectroradiometer reference campaigns, and the traceability chain between camera measurements and absolute references
Design measurement protocols and error budgets: what to measure, at which drive and temperature points, and how noise and systematic errors propagate to the final on-screen color accuracy
Maintain and extend the Python pipeline that implements the above — acquisition, post-processing, packaging of corrections for the GPU processor, and color-accuracy benchmarks and reports
Support our operations team during production calibration campaigns
>
Requirements
A background in physics, optics, photonics, or measurement science — through degree, research, or equivalent industrial experience
Strong modelling skills: fitting physical models to noisy measurements, linear algebra, optimization, interpolation, and honest uncertainty/error analysis
An experimentalist’s rigor: designing measurements, hunting systematic errors, validating results against independent references before trusting them
Working proficiency in Python/NumPy — your models must become running code, though software is your instrument here, not the job itself
An autonomous owner: this pipeline is critical to the product, and you will run it, evolve it, and document it for others
>
Nice to have
Colorimetry and radiometry (CIE XYZ, chromaticity, ΔE metrics, HDR transfer functions)
Hands-on experience with optical metrology instruments: spectroradiometers, machine-vision cameras, optical filters
Image processing / computer vision experience
Machine-learning experience applied to correction or fitting problems; software engineering practices (CI, packaging, databases)
>
Organization
Our team works mostly remotely from France and Hong Kong. Our HQ, operations, digital electronics, sales and marketing teams are located in Hong Kong (Tsuen Wan); screen production is in Shenzhen at our partner’s factories. The position can be based in our Hong Kong office or remote; occasional travel to Hong Kong and Shenzhen during special calibration campaigns and new feature tests is part of the job.
Excellent English proficiency is required.
We can sponsor work visa applications in Hong Kong.

JIA Investment Limited is a Hong Kong-based diversified investment firm specializing in strategic investments across Education and Finance sectors. Our Trading Department overseas institutional asset management and drives the firm's overarching growth strategies. As we continue to expand our investment activities across global financial markets, we are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Investment Trader to strengthen our trading execution, market monitoring, and investment decision-making capabilities.

ROLE OVERVIEW
We are looking for a Full-Time Investment Trader to join our Trading Department. The successful candidate will work closely with the Head of the Investment Team / Principal and be responsible for day-to-day trade execution, real-time market monitoring, position and P&L tracking, trading records, reconciliation, and investment support across Hong Kong, Mainland China, U.S. and other relevant public markets.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in a fast-moving market environment, able to execute investment instructions accurately and efficiently, and capable of providing timely market observations and analytical support to the investment team.
>
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
1/ Trade Execution
Execute buy and sell orders for equities and other approved securities in accordance with instructions from the Head of the Investment Team / Principal.
Handle order placement, amendment and cancellation through designated brokerage accounts and trading platforms.
Monitor bid/ask prices, market depth, liquidity, trading volume and intraday price movements to support efficient trade execution.
Closely monitor order status and executions, and promptly report material execution issues or unusual market conditions.
2/ Real-Time Market Monitoring
Monitor portfolio holdings, watchlists and key market indices throughout relevant trading sessions.
Track real-time price movements, volume changes, unusual trading activity, company announcements and market-moving news.
Promptly alert the investment team to significant price movements, unusual trading patterns or material developments affecting portfolio companies.
Provide concise intraday market updates and observations when required.
3/ Pre-Trade Checks & Risk Control
Verify security code, account, buy/sell direction, quantity, price and other key trade details before order submission.
Check available cash, available positions and other relevant account information prior to execution.
Execute trades strictly within approved instructions and internal authorization requirements.
Immediately escalate any potential trading error, account discrepancy or risk issue.
4/ Position & P&L Monitoring
Monitor portfolio positions, average costs, market values, realised and unrealised P&L, cash balances and overall exposure.
Prepare daily or periodic position and trading summaries for internal review.
Assist the investment team in monitoring portfolio concentration and significant changes in individual positions.
5/ Trading Records & Reconciliation
Maintain accurate records of daily transactions, including security, account, direction, quantity, execution price and transaction costs.
Reconcile internal trading records against brokerage statements, trade confirmations and account records.
Identify and follow up on any discrepancies in positions, cash balances, transaction records or corporate actions.
Maintain well-organised trading and portfolio documentation for internal review and record-keeping purposes.
6/ Investment & Research Support
Track macroeconomic developments, industry trends, company announcements, earnings releases and other market-moving events.
Conduct fundamental and market research on existing holdings and potential investment targets as required.
Review financial statements, valuation indicators, broker research and relevant market data to support investment discussions.
Participate in investment meetings and provide trading perspectives, market observations and relevant analytical input.
7/ Broker & Account Coordination
Liaise with brokers, relationship managers and relevant service providers on day-to-day trading and account-related matters.
Follow up on trade confirmations, settlement matters, corporate actions and other operational issues when required.
8/ Strategic & Ad-hoc Support

Support other investment, trading and portfolio-related projects as required.
>

Education: Bachelor's degree or above in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science or other relevant disciplines.

title: Digital Assets Investment Associate/Specialist
teaser: An excellent opportunity for building a career in corporate finance, digital finance, and the rapidly evolving field of Real-World Assets (RWA).
jd:
Position Overview:
This is not a traditional analyst position.
The Digital Asset Investment Associate/Specialist is a multidisciplinary role designed to develop future investment professionals with broad commercial exposure. You will work closely with the management team throughout the full lifecycle of origination and investment projects - from opportunity origination and financial analysis to transaction structuring, strategic partnerships and project execution.
As part of SageRock's strategic focus on Real-World Assets (RWA) and financial innovation, you will have the opportunity to participate in projects involving asset tokenization, innovative investment structures, and capital formation. You will gain valuable insights into how traditional assets can be integrated with modern financial infrastructure to create institutional-grade investment opportunities.
The successful candidate will gain first-hand experience across investment structuring, financial analysis, RWA project development, business development, ecosystem partnership management and corporate branding, while working alongside financial institutions, technology partners, professional advisers and asset owners.
This position offers an excellent opportunity for ambitious graduates who aspire to build a long-term career in investment, corporate finance, strategic business development and the rapidly evolving field of Real-World Assets (RWA) and digital finance.

Support the origination, evaluation and development of Real-World Asset (RWA) projects across sectors such as infrastructure, renewable energy, AI, intellectual property, private credit and other emerging industries.
Assist in designing investment structures, fund solutions and capital deployment strategies.
Participate in transaction execution, due diligence and project implementation.
Prepare financial models, investment memoranda, project presentations and internal reports.
Monitor project performance and provide analytical support throughout the origination and investment lifecycle.
Research market trends, regulatory developments and emerging technologies relevant to RWA and digital finance.

Assist in preparing business proposals and partnership presentations.
Coordinate communications across ecosystem participants.
Support business development initiatives and strategic projects.

Assist in producing market insights and thought leadership content on RWA, digital finance and investment trends.
Prepare presentations, case studies and conference materials.
Support branding initiatives and corporate communications.

Bachelor's degree in one of the following disciplines – Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business Administration, Financial Engineering, Data Analytics, and other related disciplines

Technical Competencies
Solid understanding of financial statements and business analysis.
Strong analytical and quantitative abilities.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint and Word.
Ability to prepare professional reports and presentation materials.
Experience in AI tools, financial modelling or investment research is an advantage.
Fluency in English and Chinese (written and spoken) is required, Proficiency in Mandarin is an advantage.

This role focuses primarily on B2C and D2C business , covering major ecommerce platforms such as Amazon, Walmart, Best Buy, and other online marketplaces, as well as offline consumer distribution channels.

Manage product listings, product information, digital content, pricing, promotions, platform settings, and other daily marketplace activities.
Monitor and enforce pricing policies across ecommerce platforms and offline consumer channels to maintain pricing consistency and channel discipline.
Ensure that marketplace accounts, product listings, and operational activities comply with relevant platform policies and requirements.
Translate regional business objectives into annual, quarterly, and monthly sales targets and actionable plans.
Develop and execute strategies to achieve GMV, revenue, profitability, and other assigned business targets.
Monitor sales, traffic, conversion, pricing, inventory, and market data to identify performance gaps, business risks, and growth opportunities.
Coordinate demand planning, inventory replenishment, order fulfilment, and logistics arrangements.
Prepare regular business reports covering target achievement, operational performance, key issues, and recommended actions.
About you
Bachelor's degree in Ecommerce, Business Administration, International Business, International Trade, Marketing, Digital Marketing, Supply Chain Management, Logistics Management, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or another related discipline.
At least 2 years of overall work experience, including a minimum of 1 year of relevant experience in ecommerce, online retail, marketplace operations, or a related field.
Experience managing an ecommerce account, marketplace, or business portfolio with monthly GMV of approximately HKD 1.2 million / USD 150,000; or annual GMV of approximately HKD 12 million / USD 1.5 million.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel is essential, including commonly used formulas, PivotTables, data organizing, reporting, and basic data analysis.

Strong execution skills, with the ability to translate business objectives into clear action plans and follow through on implementation.
Basic project management skills, including task planning, progress tracking, cross-functional coordination, and timely delivery.

Strong command of English, with the ability to communicate effectively in both Mandarin and Cantonese.

市場營運與策略規劃

負責區域專案全週期商務工作，包含意向跟進、招標資料籌備、合約洽談與簽署、進度統籌、需求同步；聯動國內總部售前、技術、交付團隊，推進專案落地、實施、驗收及回款，獨立處理本地商務問題與專案協調工作，把控專案履約品質與回款進度。

負責香港本地代理商及合作管道的開發、洽談與維護，建立穩定的在地化通路體系；做好合作夥伴日常溝通、賦能與關係維護，推動通路專案轉化，實現區域業務增量。

參與香港本地科創展會、產業高峰會、政企交流活動，進行品牌宣傳與市場推廣，提升公司商用機器人產品在港澳市場的知名度與標竿案例影響力。

本科及以上學歷，行銷、工商管理、國際貿易、理工科、人工智慧相關專業優先；接受優秀應屆畢業生或1–2年相關商務、市场、銷售工作經驗。

title: Senior AI Engineer

jd:
Senior AI Engineer
>
## Our stack
You should be strong across most of this.
- Agent frameworks: LangGraph / LangChain — building agents, subagents, and orchestrated subagent fleets.
- Frontend: React, React Native.
- Backend: Node.js.
- Models (we're model-agnostic): Claude / Anthropic, OpenAI / Codex, DeepSeek, Gemini, Sakana — routing across multiple models per task.
- Agent infrastructure: MCP servers, subagent orchestration, short-term and long-term memory systems.
- Data: integrating external data sources into agents; synthesizing unstructured/structured data into models; scraping (bonus).
- Domain (preferred): blockchain data, blockchain RPC, stablecoins.
>
## The role
You'll lead the design and delivery of our most important consumer AI features — owning the architecture, quality, and roadmap of how AI shows up in the product. You'll set technical direction, mentor other engineers, and be the person who makes hard applied-AI problems ship reliably at scale. This is an applied product role, not a research or protocol-engineering role.
>
## What you'll do
- Own end-to-end design and delivery of consumer-facing AI features, from concept to production.
- Architect robust agent systems with LangGraph / LangChain : agents, subagents, and orchestrated subagent fleets.
- Design and build MCP servers and the tooling that connects agents to the rest of the product.
- Build short-term and long-term memory systems and integrate external data sources into the agent fleet.
- Route intelligently across multiple AI models (Claude, OpenAI / Codex, DeepSeek, Gemini, Sakana) based on task, quality, latency, and cost.
- Build the eval and observability foundations that let the team ship quality improvements with confidence.
- Set technical direction for applied AI and mentor junior and mid-level engineers.
- Partner with product and leadership to shape what we build and why.
>
## What we're looking for
- 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong track record of shipping consumer-facing products to real users at scale.
- Demonstrated experience building applied AI / LLM-powered features in production — not just experiments.
- Deep fluency in TypeScript/Node.js and/or Python; experience with React and/or React Native.
- Hands-on experience building agents and subagents , including subagent orchestration and MCP servers .
- Experience working across multiple model providers and routing between them.
- Experience integrating external data sources into agents for short-term and long-term memory .
- Experience designing evals and improving model-driven systems with data.
- Strong product instincts: you make good trade-offs between speed, quality, cost, and UX.
- Ability to lead projects and level up the engineers around you.
>
## Nice to have
- Strong at scraping unstructured data and turning it into something an agent can use.
- Experience with blockchain data, blockchain RPC, and stablecoins .
- Experience in crypto, fintech, or payments , ideally on consumer products.
- Experience scaling AI features under real latency, reliability, and cost constraints.
- History of taking 0→1 products to launch.

jd:

jd:

The objective of the position is to maintain and optimize a fully automated, GitOps-driven cloud infrastructure. Act as a highly resolutive, self-driven operational backup in the absence of the DevOps & Cloud Manager, keeping production systems stable and secure with minimal supervision.
What will you do?
Maintain Code-Driven Infrastructure: Maintain and scale declarative Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions via Terraform across complex, large-scale codebases, prioritizing reusable module design, state optimization, and drift prevention.

Enterprise SaaS Administration: Programmatically configure and manage enterprise platforms, including Bitbucket Cloud (RBAC, branch strategies) and SonarQube Cloud (Quality Gates).
Contribute to Future Migrations: Participate actively in the long-term planning and execution of our multi-year strategic migration from Azure to Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and from Argo Workflows to Azure DevOps pipelines.
What will you need?
Background: Degree holder in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a closely related field (or 3–5 years of equivalent commercial experience in a SysAdmin/DevOps discipline).
Experience Tier: 3–5 years of commercial experience working as a DevOps Engineer in highly automated, multi-contributor enterprise environments.
Automation Workflow & GitOps Depth: Solid understanding of event-driven automation workflows and extensive hands-on experience running Kubernetes workloads using GitOps tools (ArgoCD or equivalent).
Large-Scale IaC: Proven experience handling Terraform inside large repositories, including clean state management and writing modular, linted, reusable code.
Cloud Platforms: 2+ years of administrative experience with Microsoft Azure cloud services. Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or Azure DevOps is a strong plus due to upcoming migration initiatives.
Containerization & Code Quality: Strong proficiency in Docker (creating secure, unprivileged, size-optimized containers) and familiarity with running code quality automation tools (like SonarQube).
Mindset: Highly resolutive problem-solver who takes strict ownership of tasks and thrives in an environment that requires minimal micromanagement.

Conduct ad-hoc strategic analyses, including loss-making entity diagnostics, financial assessments of investment plans, and monthly reporting for overseas subsidiaries, to directly support executive decision-making.

Leadership & Collaboration

title: Chief Credit Officer
teaser: We are seeking a highly commercial, analytically strong, and operationally rigorous CCO to lead the company's end-to-end credit function.
bullet_points: Executive presence - able to influence stakeholders, investors, funders, boards
Practical understanding of AI / machine learning use cases in credit
jd:
We are seeking a highly commercial, analytically strong, and operationally rigorous Chief Credit Officer (CCO) to lead the company's end-to-end credit function. This is a critical senior role responsible for shaping credit strategy, underwriting excellence, portfolio quality, and the evolution of the company’s automated credit decisioning capabilities.
>
The CCO will lead both (i) traditional / expert-led credit underwriting, including policy, approvals, exception handling, and portfolio oversight, and (ii) the ongoing development, governance, calibration, monitoring, and enhancement of an automated credit decisioning tool incorporating data, analytics, and AI / machine learning components.
>
Role Purpose
This role sits at the intersection of credit risk, product, data science, analytics, operations, technology, and business growth. The successful candidate will ensure the company’s scales responsibly while maintaining robust credit discipline, strong customer outcomes, and a fit-for-purpose governance framework for both manual and automated decisioning.
>
Key Responsibilities
1. Credit Strategy & Leadership
Own the company’s overall credit philosophy, risk appetite implementation, underwriting framework, and portfolio risk strategy.
Develop and continuously refine credit policies, scorecards, approval criteria, early warning frameworks, and exposure limits across customer segments, products, geographies, and channels.
Balance growth, loss performance, customer experience, and capital efficiency in line with the company’s business objectives.
Serve as the senior sponsor for credit risk matters with senior management, board committees, funders, and key external stakeholders as required.
Build and lead a high-performance credit organisation spanning underwriting, credit policy, portfolio management, decision science, and credit governance.
>
2. Manual / Expert Underwriting
Lead the traditional underwriting function for more complex, higher-value, escalated, or exception-based transactions.
Set clear underwriting standards for assessing borrowers using financial statements, transaction data, cashflow trends, inventory, receivables, supply chain information, and sector dynamics.
Establish approval authorities, delegation matrices, escalation thresholds, and exception governance.
Ensure consistency, quality, and turnaround time in underwriting decisions while maintaining robust risk discipline.
Act as final decision-maker or chair of credit committee for material exposures, structured cases, and policy exceptions.
>
3. Automated Credit Decisioning & AI-Enabled Credit
Own the vision, roadmap, and performance of the company’s automated credit decisioning platform.
Partner with Product, Data, Engineering, and Analytics teams to design and improve credit decision engines, rules frameworks, scorecards, and machine learning models.
Ensure automated decisions are commercially effective, statistically robust, operationally reliable, and aligned to policy intent.
Define and oversee model segmentation, champion-challenger testing, cut-off strategies, decision flows, and periodic recalibration.
Drive the integration of new internal and external data sources to improve predictive power, decision speed, and underwriting depth.
Ensure that AI and model-based credit decisions are explainable, appropriately governed, monitored for model drift, and subject to rigorous human oversight where required.
Create strong feedback loops between manual underwriters and automated systems so policy learning and expert judgment continuously improve model performance.
>
4. Portfolio Risk Management
Monitor and actively manage portfolio quality across origination cohorts, products, sectors, geographies, and partner channels.
Establish and oversee KPIs / KRIs such as approval rate, bad rate, delinquency, default, roll rates, vintage performance, recoveries, concentration risk, and profitability by segment.
Lead portfolio reviews and recommend timely adjustments to strategy, pricing, terms, and approval rules based on performance trends.
Design early warning and account management strategies for deteriorating borrowers or vulnerable sectors.
Work closely with collections / recoveries teams to ensure insights from arrears and losses inform origination strategy.
>
5. Credit Governance, Controls & Risk Frameworks
Maintain strong first-line credit governance across policy, procedures, controls, documentation, and audit readiness.
Ensure decisioning and underwriting frameworks comply with internal risk standards, legal and regulatory requirements, and lender / funding-partner expectations.
Implement robust model governance practices including model inventory, validation, change control, approval logs, periodic review, and outcome monitoring.
Chair or contribute to relevant credit, risk, and product governance forums.
Ensure clear documentation of credit decisions, policy rationale, model assumptions, overrides, and exceptions.
>
6. Cross-Functional Partnership
Work closely with the Executive Committee on growth and risk trade-offs.
Partner with Product & Technology on decision engine architecture and workflow design.
Collaborate with Data / Analytics on model development, feature engineering, monitoring, and experimentation.
Coordinate with Operations on straight-through processing, service levels, and underwriting efficiency.
Work with Legal / Compliance on regulatory and governance requirements.
Support Finance on portfolio performance, lender reporting, and funding considerations.
Engage Commercial / Partnerships teams on channel strategy and partner-level risk performance.
>
7. Team Building & Capability Development
Recruit, lead, and develop a best-in-class credit team combining deep underwriting judgment with data-led decisioning capability.
Foster a culture of analytical rigor, accountability, constructive challenge, and continuous improvement.
Upskill teams in the use of data, automation, and AI-enabled decision support tools.
Define organisational design and hiring strategy across underwriting, policy, portfolio analytics, and model governance.
>
Candidate Profile
Experience
10+ years of relevant experience across credit risk, underwriting, portfolio management, structured lending, trade finance, working capital finance, SME lending, or fintech lending.
Significant leadership experience in a bank, non-bank lender, fintech, trade finance platform, digital lender, or specialty finance business.
Proven experience leading both manual / judgment-based underwriting teams and data-driven or automated credit decisioning environments.
Strong track record in building or overseeing credit scorecards, rules engines, decision platforms, or ML-enabled lending models in production.
Experience in SME, cross-border trade, e-commerce, supply chain, receivables, inventory, or cashflow-based lending is highly desirable.
Experience managing portfolio performance through different market cycles and scaling credit frameworks in high-growth environments.
Familiarity with Hong Kong / Greater China / regional Asian lending environments is strongly preferred.
>
Technical / Functional Expertise
Deep understanding of credit risk principles, underwriting, portfolio analytics, and loss performance management.
Strong command of data-driven lending concepts including scorecards, feature design, segmentation, validation, cut-off strategy, override analysis, and monitoring.
Practical understanding of AI / machine learning use cases in credit, including model risk, explainability, bias / fairness considerations, and drift monitoring.
Strong quantitative capability; able to challenge model outputs and translate analytics into credit policy decisions.
Comfort working with alternative data, transaction data, platform data, and ecosystem-derived risk signals.
Strong knowledge of governance and control requirements for credit policy and model lifecycle management.
>
Leadership & Personal Attributes
Executive presence with the ability to influence senior stakeholders, investors, funders, and boards.
Commercially minded, with the judgment to balance prudent risk management and growth ambition.
Hands-on, intellectually curious, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced fintech environment.
Able to move between strategic design and practical execution.
Strong communicator who can bridge credit, data, technology, and business teams.
High integrity, sound judgment, and a bias for disciplined decision-making.
>
Success Measures / KPIs
Portfolio quality and loss performance
Approval quality and consistency
Underwriting turnaround times and operational efficiency
Performance of automated decisioning tools and model monitoring metrics
Credit policy effectiveness and governance quality
Portfolio profitability and risk-adjusted returns
Reduction in avoidable manual touchpoints through effective automation
Quality of lender / investor / board credit reporting
Team capability, retention, and leadership effectiveness
>Example First-Year Priorities
Review and refine the company’s end-to-end credit strategy and approval architecture.
Assess the current underwriting framework and identify opportunities to improve consistency, speed, and quality.
Conduct a full review of the automated credit decisioning tool, including data inputs, rules, model performance, override rates, explainability, and governance.
Implement a robust model monitoring and validation framework for all production credit models and AI components.
Define a target operating model for hybrid decisioning across manual underwriting and automated approvals.
Improve portfolio surveillance, early warning indicators, and vintage-level performance reporting.
Strengthen credit committee governance, policy documentation, and exception management.
Build stronger integration between credit, product, engineering, and data teams.
>

jd:
About the role
The Global Markets Technology Manager will act as the primary business technology owner for a sophisticated portfolio of systems supporting institutional brokerage and cross asset solutions. The role will manage the systems roadmap, optimise existing applications and interfaces, lead implementation and change initiatives, and ensure that the technology environment evolves in line with the business strategy, product development and control requirements of Global Markets. This is a business-facing technology role within Global Markets rather than a general IT support position.
Key responsibilities
Own and maintain the Global Markets systems inventory, target architecture, application lifecycle and multi-year technology roadmap.
Translate business strategy and new product plans into system requirements, delivery priorities, business cases and practical implementation plans.
Lead system selection, implementation, migration, upgrade and integration projects from requirements and solution design through UAT, rollout and post-implementation review.
Manage and enhance institutional sales, CRM and client-information platforms supporting client coverage, activity tracking, onboarding workflows, pipeline management and management reporting.
Oversee the business functionality and integration of OMS, EMS, PMS and RMS platforms across order capture, routing, execution, allocation, booking, positions, limits and risk controls.
Work with other teams to improve confirmation, post-trade, reconciliation and middle- and back-office workflows, with a focus on accuracy, straight-through processing and operational control.
Manage and optimize external connectivity with clients, brokers, custodians, vendors and trading venues, including FIX, API, SFTP and other approved interfaces, onboarding and certification processes.
Develop and govern internal data, analytics, dashboard and decision-support solutions, ensuring consistent definitions, reliable data flows and appropriate access controls.
Assess the technology impact and readiness of new businesses, products, markets and client solutions before launch, including build-versus-buy and vendor options.
Coordinate production support, incident escalation, root-cause analysis, release management and permanent remediation for business-critical systems.
About you
Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, information systems, engineering, finance or a related discipline.
At least seven years of relevant experience in Global Markets technology, trading systems, business analysis, product ownership, project management or systems implementation within a broker, investment bank, asset manager or market infrastructure provider.
Strong understanding of institutional brokerage and Global Markets workflows across client coverage, sales, trading, risk, confirmations and the full trade lifecycle.
Hands-on experience with several of the following: CRM or client platforms, OMS, EMS, PMS, RMS, confirmation, middle-office, back-office or management-information systems.
Good understanding of system architecture, interfaces and data models, including FIX, APIs, file-based integration, reference data and reconciliation processes.
Proven ability to manage the full delivery lifecycle, including requirements, solution evaluation, UAT, release, change, incident and vendor management.
Strong commercial judgement, ownership, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced business environment.
Fluency in English and Chinese, with the ability to communicate effectively with business users, technology teams and external vendors.

jd:
E-Commerce Manager
Amazon Operations & Digital Marketing | Team of 8 | Report to Founder
About Us
We are a highly efficient, fast-growing cross-border eCommerce company with an agile team of 27 professionals. Specialized in children's apparel, we operate across major global Amazon marketplaces with over 4,000 active SKUs and generating over HKD 200M in annual revenue.
Our culture is deeply rooted in hard work, high execution, and a pragmatic "get-your-hands-dirty" mindset. We believe true leaders lead from the front , driving growth alongside their team.
Role Summary
We are seeking a hands-on, execution-driven E-Commerce Manager to lead a team of 8 across Amazon operations and digital marketing. You are not a pure specialist — you are a team leader who understands the full Amazon ecosystem, from listing optimisation and PPC to cross-functional collaboration with purchasing, inventory, and logistics.
You will report directly to the Founder and play a key role in building the operational systems and team capabilities that will drive our next stage of growth. If you are someone who takes pride in both growing a team and getting things done, this role is for you.
Key Responsibilities
1. Team Leadership & Development
Directly manage a team of 8 across Amazon operations and digital marketing, including setting clear KPIs, conducting regular performance reviews, and maintaining a high-accountability team culture.
Identify capability gaps within the team and actively coach and develop members into future senior contributors.
2. Amazon Marketplace Management
Oversee end-to-end Amazon marketplace operations across multiple international sites (US, UK, DE, FR and beyond), including listing strategy, keyword optimisation, conversion rate tracking, account health, and promotional planning.
Monitor sales performance and rankings across all marketplaces and make timely pricing and promotional adjustments to maximise revenue.
Resolve workflow bottlenecks and implement project management tools to eliminate communication silos across the team.
3. Digital Marketing & PPC Oversight
Supervise the digital marketing team's Amazon PPC campaigns (SP/SB/SD), ensuring TACoS targets are met and ad spend is optimised.
Review and challenge the team's advertising strategies — you do not need to execute campaigns yourself, but you must understand PPC logic deeply enough to lead, evaluate, and if necessary, step in temporarily when team members are unavailable.
Track and report on key marketing metrics including TACoS, ROAS, CTR, and conversion rate.
4. Operational Efficiency & AI Integration
Champion the adoption of AI tools across the team's daily workflows — including listing copywriting, image briefing, PPC analysis, and operational reporting — to systematically reduce manual workload and improve output quality.
Identify and implement process improvements that eliminate repetitive tasks and free the team to focus on higher-value activities.
Establish clear SOPs for all key operational processes to ensure consistency and reduce dependency on individual team members.
5. Cost Control & Cross-Functional Collaboration
Protect bottom-line profitability by optimising key cost levers: FBA shipment planning, return rate reduction, TACoS management, and storage fee optimisation.
Work closely with purchasing, inventory, and logistics teams to ensure accurate sales forecasting and zero-gap FBA replenishment planning.
Job Requirements
Degree holder with 6–8 years of hands-on eCommerce experience , including at least 3–4 years managing an eCommerce team of 5 or more people.
Deep, hands-on understanding of Amazon Marketplace operations across multiple international marketplaces — including Seller Central, FBA logistics, listing optimisation, and account health management.
Solid understanding of Amazon PPC (SP/SB/SD) logic and performance metrics (TACoS, ROAS, CTR). You do not need to be a PPC specialist, but you must be able to supervise, evaluate, and step in when needed.
AI Mindset: Demonstrated interest in or hands-on experience with AI tools for operational workflows (e.g., copywriting, reporting, data analysis). This is a core expectation, not a bonus — we are building an AI-integrated team.
Stability: We value candidates who have demonstrated commitment — ideally 2 or more years in each role — and who are looking to build something meaningful over the long term, not just add a title to their CV.
Experience in fashion, apparel, or children's products — particularly managing size variations and seasonal demand cycles — is a strong advantage.
Excellent bilingual skills in English and Chinese.
A hands-on leader with strong analytical skills who is equally comfortable setting team direction and solving frontline problems.
What We Offer
Competitive salary package commensurate with experience, with year-end performance bonus tied directly to company results.
5-day work week, bank holidays, birthday leave, and comprehensive medical insurance.
Generous staff purchase discount on our children's apparel range.
High autonomy and direct culture — you will have the trust and space to build and run your team your way, without corporate politics.
Direct reporting line to the Founder — a rare opportunity to operate at a senior level and develop a genuine understanding of how a high-efficiency business is run.
How to Apply
Interested parties please click Apply Now and submit your CV with your current salary, expected salary, and available start date.
In your application, please briefly describe (in 3–5 sentences) : a specific Amazon marketplace challenge your team faced, how you led the team to resolve it, and the measurable outcome.

title: Regional HRIS Manager

jd:
Company Overview:
Mitrade is an award-winning global Contract for Difference (CFD) and forex broker, regulated by authorities in Australia (ASIC), Cyprus (CySEC), the Cayman Islands (CIMA), Mauritius (FSC), South Africa (FSCA), and the United Arab Emirates (CMA). Mitrade was founded in Melbourne, Australia, and has offices worldwide.
Leveraging proprietary in-house state-of-the-art technology, Mitrade has developed a one-stop digital trading platform tailored for investors. Mitrade offers market data, news and analysis, plus trading and risk management services within a comprehensive user-centric FinTech ecosystem.
Mitrade serves over seven million users worldwide and offers accessibility across mobile iOS and Android, desktop, and web platforms.
>
Role Summary:
We are seeking a Regional HRIS Manager to lead the end-to-end transformation of our HR systems across multiple markets. This role will unify core HRIS, performance management (PMS), and talent acquisition (ATS) onto a single, scalable platform tailored to our organisation’s size and complexity.
This is a strategic ownership role: you will drive the full project lifecycle from requirements gathering and vendor selection through implementation, rollout, and post-launch optimisation. You will act as the primary HR project lead, working closely with Corporate HR, regional HR teams, IT, vendors, and business stakeholders to standardise processes, enhance data quality, strengthen people analytics, and reduce manual effort.
The role requires a balanced approach: driving global consistency while respecting regional nuances across jurisdictions such as Hong Kong, Singapore, Australia, and beyond. If you are a structured, hands-on HR systems professional with proven experience owning transformation initiatives from sourcing to go-live, we invite you to join us in shaping the future of HR at Mitrade.
>
What Would Be Your Responsibilities:
End-to-End Project Ownership: Lead the full HRIS transformation from current-state assessment, vendor evaluation, and system selection through to implementation, testing, rollout, and continuous improvement.
Process Standardisation: Review existing HR systems, spreadsheets, and regional practices to identify gaps, redundancies, and opportunities for harmonisation. Role Summary:
With primary focus on establishing a reliable, fact-based integrated business planning process that connects regional sales, supply, inventory, finance and operational execution. This role is accountable for the quality and governance of the consensus demand plan, the monthly S&OP/IBP cycle, inventory-planning standards and the business design of future SAP S/4HANA planning processes.
The ideal candidate is a senior planning leader with strong operational credibility, hands-on S&OP/IBP experience, and the ability to standardise fragmented planning processes across regions, functions and legal entities. This role is based in Hong Kong with occasional travel.
Candidates with less experience may be considered as Associate Director of Integrated Business Planning & Planning Excellence.

Responsibilities:
Lead the S&OP / IBP process. Own the monthly planning calendar, Demand Review, Supply and Inventory Review, pre-S&OP and Executive S&OP preparation. Ensure decisions, owners and follow-up actions are documented and escalated.
Own forecasting and demand planning. Consolidate and challenge regional commercial inputs, apply appropriate statistical and judgmental forecasting methods, manage forecast bias and create a single consensus demand plan.
Align demand, supply and inventory. Translate demand into clear supply, capacity and inventory requirements. Identify constraints and scenarios early and support decisions on allocation, service, working capital and risk.
Build planning excellence. Define common processes, roles, planning calendars, master-data requirements, segmentation logic, KPIs and exception-management standards across regions and entities.
Act as business process owner for planning. Define business requirements for SAP S/4HANA and related planning solutions, and support process design, data readiness, testing, user adoption and continuous improvement. IT retains technical solution ownership.
Create performance transparency. Establish consistent reporting for forecast accuracy, bias, plan adherence, inventory, slow-moving and obsolete stock, service risk and planning actions.
Lead cross-functional decision-making. Work closely with Regional Sales, Finance, Manufacturing, Procurement, Customer Service, Logistics and IT. Challenge assumptions constructively and resolve or escalate material gaps.
Develop the planning capability. Build a strong planning team and improve planning discipline and capability across the wider organization.
>
Qualifications and Experience:
Education. Degree in supply chain, engineering, business, finance, analytics or a related discipline. Advanced qualifications are useful but not essential.
Leadership experience. Substantial leadership experience in demand planning, supply-chain planning, S&OP or IBP within a multi-country consumer, FMCG, industrial or similarly complex product business.
Functional depth. Minimum 10 years of relevant experience. Strong hands-on understanding of forecasting, demand planning, inventory planning, supply alignment, working capital and performance management.
ERP transformation. Demonstrable business-process experience with SAP S/4HANA and preferably SAP IBP or comparable advanced planning solutions or major ERP transformation ; experience must go beyond being an end user.
Transformation track record. Proven ability to standardise fragmented processes, improve data discipline and implement practical changes across functions and geographies.
International profile. Fluent business English and experience working across cultures, time zones, legal entities and outsourced logistics networks. Asia exposure is an advantage.
>
Required Skills & Competencies:
S&OP / IBP leadership. Ability to personally operate and improve a recurring S&OP/IBP process with measurable business outcomes.
Forecasting and planning capability. Strong capability in forecasting, demand planning, supply alignment, inventory management, segmentation and exception-based planning.
Commercial and operational credibility. Able to challenge senior commercial, finance and operational stakeholders with facts while building trust and maintaining execution momentum.
Transformation and change leadership. Pragmatic operator. Experience in integrating owned manufacturing and third-party supply is an advantage.
Operating Model Excellence . Credibility with Sales, Finance, Supply Chain and senior management. Experience in designing a global template or centre of excellence

title: Chief Credit Officer
teaser: We are seeking a highly commercial, analytically strong, and operationally rigorous CCO to lead the company's end-to-end credit function.
bullet_points: Executive presence - able to influence stakeholders, investors, funders, boards
Practical understanding of AI / machine learning use cases in credit
jd:
We are seeking a highly commercial, analytically strong, and operationally rigorous Chief Credit Officer (CCO) to lead the company's end-to-end credit function. This is a critical senior role responsible for shaping credit strategy, underwriting excellence, portfolio quality, and the evolution of the company’s automated credit decisioning capabilities.
>
The CCO will lead both (i) traditional / expert-led credit underwriting, including policy, approvals, exception handling, and portfolio oversight, and (ii) the ongoing development, governance, calibration, monitoring, and enhancement of an automated credit decisioning tool incorporating data, analytics, and AI / machine learning components.
>
Role Purpose
This role sits at the intersection of credit risk, product, data science, analytics, operations, technology, and business growth. The successful candidate will ensure the company’s scales responsibly while maintaining robust credit discipline, strong customer outcomes, and a fit-for-purpose governance framework for both manual and automated decisioning.
>
Key Responsibilities
1. Credit Strategy & Leadership
Own the company’s overall credit philosophy, risk appetite implementation, underwriting framework, and portfolio risk strategy.
Develop and continuously refine credit policies, scorecards, approval criteria, early warning frameworks, and exposure limits across customer segments, products, geographies, and channels.
Balance growth, loss performance, customer experience, and capital efficiency in line with the company’s business objectives.
Serve as the senior sponsor for credit risk matters with senior management, board committees, funders, and key external stakeholders as required.
Build and lead a high-performance credit organisation spanning underwriting, credit policy, portfolio management, decision science, and credit governance.
>
2. Manual / Expert Underwriting
Lead the traditional underwriting function for more complex, higher-value, escalated, or exception-based transactions.
Set clear underwriting standards for assessing borrowers using financial statements, transaction data, cashflow trends, inventory, receivables, supply chain information, and sector dynamics.
Establish approval authorities, delegation matrices, escalation thresholds, and exception governance.
Ensure consistency, quality, and turnaround time in underwriting decisions while maintaining robust risk discipline.
Act as final decision-maker or chair of credit committee for material exposures, structured cases, and policy exceptions.
>
3. Automated Credit Decisioning & AI-Enabled Credit
Own the vision, roadmap, and performance of the company’s automated credit decisioning platform.
Partner with Product, Data, Engineering, and Analytics teams to design and improve credit decision engines, rules frameworks, scorecards, and machine learning models.
Ensure automated decisions are commercially effective, statistically robust, operationally reliable, and aligned to policy intent.
Define and oversee model segmentation, champion-challenger testing, cut-off strategies, decision flows, and periodic recalibration.
Drive the integration of new internal and external data sources to improve predictive power, decision speed, and underwriting depth.
Ensure that AI and model-based credit decisions are explainable, appropriately governed, monitored for model drift, and subject to rigorous human oversight where required.
Create strong feedback loops between manual underwriters and automated systems so policy learning and expert judgment continuously improve model performance.
>
4. Portfolio Risk Management
Monitor and actively manage portfolio quality across origination cohorts, products, sectors, geographies, and partner channels.
Establish and oversee KPIs / KRIs such as approval rate, bad rate, delinquency, default, roll rates, vintage performance, recoveries, concentration risk, and profitability by segment.
Lead portfolio reviews and recommend timely adjustments to strategy, pricing, terms, and approval rules based on performance trends.
Design early warning and account management strategies for deteriorating borrowers or vulnerable sectors.
Work closely with collections / recoveries teams to ensure insights from arrears and losses inform origination strategy.
>
5. Credit Governance, Controls & Risk Frameworks
Maintain strong first-line credit governance across policy, procedures, controls, documentation, and audit readiness.
Ensure decisioning and underwriting frameworks comply with internal risk standards, legal and regulatory requirements, and lender / funding-partner expectations.
Implement robust model governance practices including model inventory, validation, change control, approval logs, periodic review, and outcome monitoring.
Chair or contribute to relevant credit, risk, and product governance forums.
Ensure clear documentation of credit decisions, policy rationale, model assumptions, overrides, and exceptions.
>
6. Cross-Functional Partnership
Work closely with the Executive Committee on growth and risk trade-offs.
Partner with Product & Technology on decision engine architecture and workflow design.
Collaborate with Data / Analytics on model development, feature engineering, monitoring, and experimentation.
Coordinate with Operations on straight-through processing, service levels, and underwriting efficiency.
Work with Legal / Compliance on regulatory and governance requirements.
Support Finance on portfolio performance, lender reporting, and funding considerations.
Engage Commercial / Partnerships teams on channel strategy and partner-level risk performance.
>
7. Team Building & Capability Development
Recruit, lead, and develop a best-in-class credit team combining deep underwriting judgment with data-led decisioning capability.
Foster a culture of analytical rigor, accountability, constructive challenge, and continuous improvement.
Upskill teams in the use of data, automation, and AI-enabled decision support tools.
Define organisational design and hiring strategy across underwriting, policy, portfolio analytics, and model governance.
>
Candidate Profile
Experience
10+ years of relevant experience across credit risk, underwriting, portfolio management, structured lending, trade finance, working capital finance, SME lending, or fintech lending.
Significant leadership experience in a bank, non-bank lender, fintech, trade finance platform, digital lender, or specialty finance business.
Proven experience leading both manual / judgment-based underwriting teams and data-driven or automated credit decisioning environments.
Strong track record in building or overseeing credit scorecards, rules engines, decision platforms, or ML-enabled lending models in production.
Experience in SME, cross-border trade, e-commerce, supply chain, receivables, inventory, or cashflow-based lending is highly desirable.
Experience managing portfolio performance through different market cycles and scaling credit frameworks in high-growth environments.
Familiarity with Hong Kong / Greater China / regional Asian lending environments is strongly preferred.
>
Technical / Functional Expertise
Deep understanding of credit risk principles, underwriting, portfolio analytics, and loss performance management.
Strong command of data-driven lending concepts including scorecards, feature design, segmentation, validation, cut-off strategy, override analysis, and monitoring.
Practical understanding of AI / machine learning use cases in credit, including model risk, explainability, bias / fairness considerations, and drift monitoring.
Strong quantitative capability; able to challenge model outputs and translate analytics into credit policy decisions.
Comfort working with alternative data, transaction data, platform data, and ecosystem-derived risk signals.
Strong knowledge of governance and control requirements for credit policy and model lifecycle management.
>
Leadership & Personal Attributes
Executive presence with the ability to influence senior stakeholders, investors, funders, and boards.
Commercially minded, with the judgment to balance prudent risk management and growth ambition.
Hands-on, intellectually curious, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced fintech environment.
Able to move between strategic design and practical execution.
Strong communicator who can bridge credit, data, technology, and business teams.
High integrity, sound judgment, and a bias for disciplined decision-making.
>
Success Measures / KPIs
Portfolio quality and loss performance
Approval quality and consistency
Underwriting turnaround times and operational efficiency
Performance of automated decisioning tools and model monitoring metrics
Credit policy effectiveness and governance quality
Portfolio profitability and risk-adjusted returns
Reduction in avoidable manual touchpoints through effective automation
Quality of lender / investor / board credit reporting
Team capability, retention, and leadership effectiveness
>
Example First-Year Priorities
Review and refine the company’s end-to-end credit strategy and approval architecture.
Assess the current underwriting framework and identify opportunities to improve consistency, speed, and quality.
Conduct a full review of the automated credit decisioning tool, including data inputs, rules, model performance, override rates, explainability, and governance.
Implement a robust model monitoring and validation framework for all production credit models and AI components.
Define a target operating model for hybrid decisioning across manual underwriting and automated approvals.
Improve portfolio surveillance, early warning indicators, and vintage-level performance reporting.
Strengthen credit committee governance, policy documentation, and exception management.
Build stronger integration between credit, product, engineering, and data teams.
>

bullet_points: SFC Regulatory Mastery & Client Money Governance
jd:
About the role
Act as the deputy to the Head of Treasury and serve as the key backup for treasury management matters, supporting the overall governance, planning, review, and coordination of the company's treasury function.
Key responsibilities
Review and oversee the client money segregation process in full compliance with applicable HK SFC rules and regulatory guidelines, ensuring accurate segregation, recording, reconciliation, and reporting of client funds, as well as strict adherence to segregation requirements at all times.
Support the Head of Treasury in reviewing liquidity positions, funding needs, cash flow forecasts, and treasury-related risk indicators, and provide timely insights and recommendations to senior management.
Develop, refine, and maintain short-term and medium-term cash flow forecasting frameworks, review variances and root causes, and drive continuous improvement in forecast accuracy and treasury planning.
Coordinate with finance, operations, compliance, risk, product, and other internal teams to ensure treasury processes are aligned with business objectives, regulatory requirements, and overall financial reporting needs.
Act as a senior treasury contact with domestic and international banks, payment service providers, and external financial institutions; support the management of banking relationships, treasury service arrangements, bank account structures, and related issue escalation.
Review and enhance treasury policies, procedures, controls, and working processes to improve operational efficiency, reduce manual errors, and strengthen governance over treasury activities.
Support the automation and digitization of treasury processes and treasury management systems, working with IT and relevant stakeholders to review requirements, participate in testing, and coordinate system enhancements.
Provide guidance and coaching to junior treasury team members, including training on treasury processes, client money segregation requirements, regulatory compliance, liquidity monitoring, and financial analysis.
Step in for the Head of Treasury when required, including representing treasury in internal meetings, supporting management reporting, coordinating key treasury deliverables, and following up on cross-functional action items.
About you
Bachelor's degree or above in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field; professional treasury or finance qualifications such as CTP, CPA, ACCA, AFP, or equivalent are highly preferred.
Minimum 5–7 years of progressive treasury, cash management, liquidity management, or corporate finance experience, preferably within regulated financial services firms in Hong Kong.
Prior experience acting as a senior treasury team member, deputy treasury lead, treasury manager, or key backup to the treasury function head is highly preferred.
Strong technical knowledge of treasury management, including cash flow forecasting, liquidity planning, multi-currency cash management, bank account management, short-term investment oversight, and foreign exchange exposure monitoring.
In-depth familiarity with client money segregation processes and the relevant HK SFC rules and regulatory requirements governing client funds.
Strong review, control, and governance mindset, with the ability to identify process gaps, assess treasury risks, and recommend practical improvements.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with senior internal stakeholders, banks, payment service providers, auditors, and other external parties.
Exceptional attention to detail, numerical accuracy, and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple treasury priorities and meet tight regulatory, reporting, and internal management deadlines.
Fluency in Cantonese and English for daily business, banking, and regulatory communication; proficiency in Mandarin is a strong advantage for cross-regional treasury operations and stakeholder engagement.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel for cash flow analysis, liquidity monitoring, data review, variance analysis, and treasury reporting; experience with treasury management systems or financial system enhancement projects is an advantage.
>
