title: E-commerce & Growth Manager, US & Hong Kong
teaser: Own Shopify, Meta, CRM and e-commerce growth at Maison Muguet, turning brand demand into profitable revenue across HK and global markets.
jd:
About Maison Muguet
Maison Muguet is a Hong Kong-based modern jewellery house founded in 2020.
As we enter our next phase of growth, we are looking for a Growth & E-commerce Manager to build and own the commercial engine connecting brand demand to qualified traffic, online conversion, customer retention and profitable revenue across Hong Kong and the US market.
This role may be based in the United States , or based in Hong Kong with strong hands-on experience growing e-commerce businesses in the US market .
This is a hands-on role for a commercially minded operator who combines strong e-commerce capability, Meta performance marketing, CRM, analytics and consumer judgment.
You will work directly with the Founder and have meaningful ownership over how our digital business grows, with a particular focus on building a stronger and more scalable presence in the US. You will also play a key commercial role in the next stage of Louve and Solentina , Maison Muguet’s owned jewellery brands.
This is not a reporting-only or agency-management position. The successful candidate must be comfortable working directly inside e-commerce, advertising, CRM and analytics platforms, diagnosing problems, recommending priorities and driving implementation through to completion.
The Role
You will report directly to the Founder and own Maison Muguet’s e-commerce and growth agenda across Hong Kong and the US market.
Depending on your location, you may be stationed in the United States or Hong Kong . Candidates based in Hong Kong must have meaningful prior experience managing or growing e-commerce activity targeting US consumers.
You will work closely with the Founder, Brand Marketing, Content and Operations teams to connect:
Product → Creative → Traffic → Conversion → CRM → Repeat Purchase
Your role is to turn brand demand into measurable and profitable customer revenue, while building a stronger understanding of Maison Muguet’s US customer base and growth potential.
Key Responsibilities
E-commerce Ownership
Own the commercial performance and development roadmap of Maison Muguet’s e-commerce business across Hong Kong and the US.
Manage and continuously improve the Shopify customer journey from landing page through checkout and post-purchase.
Identify major funnel drop-offs and prioritise improvements based on commercial impact.
Manage website merchandising, homepage priorities, product pages, landing pages and campaign pages.
Improve product discovery, navigation, product information, trust signals and conversion.
Identify checkout friction and coordinate technical improvements.
Ensure website campaigns, launches and product drops are commercially ready.
Lead and support Maison Muguet’s US e-commerce growth, including market-specific customer experience and conversion requirements.
Review US-market requirements including shipping, payments, returns, customer service, pricing presentation and other conversion-related factors.
Coordinate effectively with developers, agencies and external technical partners where required.
Paid Acquisition & Growth
Own Meta advertising strategy, campaign setup, testing, optimisation and budget recommendations across Hong Kong and the US.
Build disciplined prospecting and retargeting structures for both markets.
Develop and refine US customer-acquisition strategies based on market response and customer economics.
Review audience, creative, product, offer and landing-page performance.
Diagnose whether performance issues are driven by creative, customer demand, targeting, website experience, pricing, merchandising or offer.
Build a structured creative-testing process with the Founder and Content team.
Identify which founder, brand and product content should be amplified through paid media.
Establish clear criteria for scaling, reducing or stopping campaigns.
Evaluate paid activity based on customer quality, contribution economics and long-term value — not only gross revenue or ROAS.
Identify meaningful differences between Hong Kong and US customer behaviour and adapt acquisition strategies accordingly.
Support or review selected China digital activity only where commercially justified.
CRM & Customer Lifecycle
Build and continuously improve Maison Muguet’s CRM and lifecycle-marketing strategy.
Develop customer segmentation based on recency, frequency, spending, product interest, geography and engagement.
Build and optimise welcome, browse-abandonment, cart-abandonment, checkout, post-purchase, reactivation and retention journeys.
Adapt CRM strategy and messaging for US customer behaviour where relevant.
Develop commercially sound VIP, referral, gifting and repeat-purchase programmes.
Connect CRM activity to hero products, campaigns and product launches.
Monitor CRM-attributed revenue, repeat purchase, reactivation and customer engagement.
Partner with the Senior Brand & Marketing Executive on CRM execution and campaign scheduling.
Identify opportunities to increase customer lifetime value and reduce dependence on constant new-customer acquisition.
Analytics & Commercial Reporting
Own weekly reporting across traffic, conversion, AOV, customer acquisition, CRM and e-commerce performance.
Analyse new versus returning customer behaviour across Hong Kong and the US.
Compare market-level performance and identify meaningful differences in acquisition cost, conversion behaviour, product demand and customer value.
Track and interpret key commercial metrics including:
Conversion rate
AOV
CAC
ROAS
MER
CRM revenue
Repeat purchase
Customer value
Contribution after marketing
Build reporting that explains:
what happened
why it happened
what should happen next
Identify the highest-value commercial problems rather than simply reporting statistics.
Build and manage a prioritised testing roadmap.
Recommend where budgets and internal resources should be increased, reduced or stopped.
Work with the Founder on commercial priorities across Hong Kong and the US.
Product Launch & Cross-functional Growth
Build the e-commerce and growth strategy supporting Louve and Solentina launches, including their US-market potential.
Work with Brand & Marketing team to translate growth requirements into campaign deliverables and deadlines.
Brief the Content team on required creative formats, hooks, product angles and paid-media variations.
Ensure product pages, landing pages, CRM, tracking, retargeting and paid campaigns are ready before launch.
Develop market-specific testing approaches for US customers where appropriate.
Conduct post-launch analysis and recommend reorders, creative changes, merchandising adjustments or funnel improvements.
Help Maison Muguet increase the commercial contribution of its owned brands and improve overall inventory efficiency.
Requirements
5+ years of relevant hands-on experience in e-commerce, growth, digital commerce, performance marketing or a closely related field.
Strong hands-on experience managing an e-commerce platform such as Shopify or a comparable system.
Strong working knowledge of Meta Ads Manager.
Experience with CRM and lifecycle-marketing platforms such as Klaviyo, Mailchimp or similar tools.
Experience using analytics and tracking tools such as GA4, Meta Pixel and related reporting systems.
Demonstrated experience improving e-commerce conversion, customer acquisition, CRM revenue or other measurable commercial outcomes.
Strong understanding of traffic, conversion, AOV, CAC, ROAS, retention and contribution economics.
Able to interpret data and translate analysis into clear commercial action.
Able to personally work inside the systems rather than relying entirely on agencies.
Strong project-management and cross-functional communication skills.
Sufficient aesthetic and consumer judgment to work effectively with a premium, fashion or design-led brand.
Able to evaluate whether creative is both on-brand and commercially useful.
Experience in jewellery, fashion, beauty, luxury, lifestyle or premium consumer brands is strongly preferred.
Demonstrated hands-on experience with the US e-commerce market is required.
Strong understanding of US digital customer acquisition, consumer behaviour and e-commerce conversion is highly preferred.
Candidates may be based in the United States or based in Hong Kong with proven experience managing US-market e-commerce growth .
Experience managing cross-border e-commerce between Asia and the US is an advantage.
Proficient in English.
Chinese language capability is preferred for candidates working closely with the Hong Kong team.
Cantonese and/or Mandarin would be an advantage but are not essential for US-based candidates.
The Right Person
You are likely to succeed in this role if you:
Are commercially curious and naturally look for the real reason behind performance.
Think beyond surface-level metrics and want to understand why customers do or do not convert.
Can personally work inside Shopify, Meta, CRM and analytics systems rather than only directing agencies.
Understand the US digital consumer and can identify how customer behaviour differs across markets.
Can distinguish between a traffic problem, product-demand problem, creative problem and conversion problem.
Understand that advertising cannot compensate indefinitely for weak product, customer demand or customer experience.
Balance premium brand standards with commercial discipline.
Communicate clearly with creative, operational and technical teams across markets and time zones.
Are comfortable challenging assumptions with evidence.
Take ownership of commercial outcomes rather than simply reporting activity.
Naturally follow problems through to closure rather than waiting for the Founder to chase.
Enjoy building systems and improving an evolving business rather than inheriting a completely finished machine.
Can prioritise ruthlessly and focus resources on the few actions most likely to improve commercial performance.
Success in the First Six Months
Success in this role would include:
A clear and prioritised e-commerce and growth roadmap is established for Hong Kong and the US.
A reliable weekly commercial dashboard is in place.
Shopify conversion performance and major funnel drop-offs are clearly understood and actively improving.
Website and product-page improvements have been implemented based on measurable commercial priorities.
Meta prospecting and retargeting have clear structures, testing processes and economic thresholds.
Paid-media decisions are increasingly based on customer quality and contribution economics.
CRM lifecycle journeys are established or materially improved.
CRM revenue, repeat purchase and customer retention become more measurable.
Hong Kong online customer acquisition becomes more systematic and repeatable.
A structured US-market acquisition and conversion strategy is established.
US customer behaviour, hero products, acquisition economics and conversion barriers are better understood.
Controlled US e-commerce tests produce clear conclusions on what should be scaled, improved or stopped.
Louve and Solentina launches are supported by functioning acquisition, conversion, CRM and retargeting systems.
Weekly reporting consistently results in decisions and actions rather than statistics alone.
The Founder no longer needs to personally manage day-to-day e-commerce, performance advertising and technical growth execution.
>

>

>About AWS

Leversys’s valuation model, systems, and data are recognized as among the market leaders in the convertible bonds space.

As a Leversys Analyst in the Client and Data team, you will:
Be part of a multi-functional team that covers client services, client success and analysis, setup, and maintenance of convertible bonds.
Within three months, you will complete the onboarding process that includes training about convertible bonds and financial markets, our internal processes, products, and services and how we help our clients.
You will acquire a deep understanding of the convertible bond asset class, different structures and prospectus language, valuation models and the impact of various features on theoretical pricing.

You may help our product development team with new ideas, requirements, specifications, and testing in your spare work time.
As your career progresses within Leversys, you will start to expand your knowledge into other asset classes and front-to-back functions.
This role will lead you to become a convertible bonds expert, acquire a good knowledge of other financial instruments and capital markets front-to-back functions, develop strong client communication and engagement skills, and build relationships with clients.
You can continue developing your career within the client and data team, while this role may also provide a pathway into the product development team for those with the skills and aptitude for product ownership.

The ability to develop and apply a unique blend of knowledge and skills.
The scope to work on exciting and highly dynamic projects and interact with clients.
Personal development support.
Sponsorship to enhance your skills and continue your education.
An effective hybrid working structure.
Occasional trips to our other global locations.
Top of the market remuneration, based on the experience level.
Twenty days holiday, pro-rata.
This is your opportunity to work with a company that actively looks to its people to take charge, come up with ideas and innovate.

title: Applied Data Scientist, AI & Text Intelligence (Part-Time)
teaser: Applied Data Scientist for AI-powered player intelligence platform analyzing multilingual gaming conversations.
jd:
Applied Data Scientist, AI & Text Intelligence (Part-Time)
About the Role
Vivacity is building Diimsum , an AI-powered player intelligence platform that analyzes millions of player conversations from Discord, Steam, Reddit, Chinese gaming communities, and other sources.
We are looking for someone to help us turn this highly unstructured, multilingual text data into useful intelligence with as little human intervention as possible.
This is not a traditional Data Scientist role built around numerical datasets, dashboards, forecasting, or statistical modeling .
Our data is primarily what people say: messy conversations filled with slang, abbreviations, game-specific terminology, multiple languages, and constantly changing community expressions.
We also do not expect you to invent a new language model. We are fully aware that the strongest general-purpose AI models available in the market already represent capabilities that a small team cannot realistically reproduce from scratch.
Instead, your job is to figure out:
How can we combine existing AI models, prompting, search, rules, and our own logic to reliably identify useful patterns from millions of unstructured player conversations?
Problems You Will Work On
Today, some of Diimsum's intelligence still requires manual judgment from our team or our clients.
For example:
Are thousands of conversations actually discussing the same issue?
Did AI summarize these conversations correctly?
Which patterns are meaningful and which are just noise?
How do we recognize that different languages, slang, abbreviations, and nicknames refer to the same game concept?
How should search retrieve the right conversations when users search for multilingual, game-specific terminology?
Can we identify important issues or emerging patterns before the client actively searches for them?
Your role is to analyze these problems using real data and turn human judgment into repeatable system logic .
A solution might use:
AI prompting and structured outputs
multiple AI calls arranged into a workflow
lexical or semantic search
embeddings
simple rules or heuristics
clustering or classification
evaluation datasets
ranking logic
combinations of AI and deterministic methods
We care about what works reliably , not whether the solution uses the most sophisticated model.
What We Are Looking For
The most important skill for this role is the ability to look at messy text data and design an effective system around existing AI capabilities.
You should be comfortable taking a vague problem such as:
"Clients still have to manually group these keywords."
and turning it into:
data inspection → hypothesis → prompt/logic design → testing → evaluation → scalable product logic
Required
Strong analytical thinking and ability to work independently
Experience working with AI models and designing effective prompts
Ability to evaluate AI outputs systematically rather than relying on intuition
Experience analyzing large or messy datasets
Strong Chinese reading comprehension and professional English
Ability to explain findings and proposed logic clearly to product and engineering teams
Helpful, but not required
Data Science, NLP, ML, search, recommendation, or information retrieval experience
SQL and data analysis experience
Embeddings, vector search, clustering, classification, or ranking
Experience with multilingual text, social listening, community data, or gaming
A Data Science or NLP degree is not required. Deep theoretical knowledge of machine learning is not the focus of this role.
We care much more about whether you can use today's AI effectively, understand its limitations, and design systems that produce reliable results.
Why Chinese Matters
More than half of the player conversations we currently process are in Chinese.
You will regularly work with Simplified and Traditional Chinese, gaming terminology, internet slang, abbreviations, and mixed Chinese-English conversations. Strong reading comprehension is therefore essential.
Working Arrangement
This is a part-time, Hong Kong-based hybrid role .
Our product and engineering teams are primarily based in Korea, so most collaboration happens online and working hours are highly flexible.
However, regular physical attendance at our Hong Kong office a few days each week is required.
The role may suit someone who already has another professional or academic commitment, provided their existing arrangements allow additional employment.
Compensation
HK$16,000–20,000 per month for approximately 2 days per week , depending on experience and level of ownership.
MPF will be provided in accordance with Hong Kong employment requirements.
Who Will Enjoy This Role
You will probably enjoy this role if you are more interested in:
"How do I make AI reliably understand this messy real-world data?"
than:
"Which new model should I train?"
We are looking for someone who enjoys experimenting with existing AI, questioning its outputs, discovering patterns humans are currently identifying manually, and turning those observations into scalable product logic.

title: Senior Analyst, Sales
teaser: • The Senior Analyst Sales is primarily responsible for the day to day management of a group of Mastercard customers in Hong Kong and Macau. The...
jd:
Our Purpose
Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.
Title and Summary
>
Senior Analyst, Sales
>
Overview
>• The Senior Analyst Sales is primarily responsible for the day to day management of a group of Mastercard customers in Hong Kong and Macau. The role is the primary point of contact for Mastercard interaction at all levels of the customer organization. The objective of the role is to achieve measurable stretched account sales targets and to bring knowledge leadership to the customer.
>• The position requires a self-motivated, commercially pragmatic, business developer with strong relationship management and influencing skills to partner with MasterCard’s cross functional teams to create and implement impactful card and payments programs for customers that drive MasterCard and customer bank business growth.
>• Do you like working with people who possess diverse skills and high creativity?
>• Are you motivated to be a part of driving a world beyond cash?
>• Are you a strong individual contributor who can also be part of a high performance team?
>Role
>• Individual in position will be accountable for strategic sales management, relationship management, project planning, new product sales, program retention, and portfolio growth
>• Individual will drive the sales and implementation process to analyze and introduce new business opportunities to customers that will drive profitable market share growth for Mastercard
>• This requires individual to develop relationships with customers at both senior / executive and middle management levels and develop value propositions to customers to increase Mastercard's business with customers
>• Individual will need to coordinate and integrate MasterCard's involvement in all marketing-related and acquirer based activities with customers and provide consultative support relative to specific Mastercard products/services, trends and the card industry
>• The individual will drive periodic account review meetings and proactively identify growth opportunities for both the customer and Mastercard
>• The individual is experienced and comfortable with building numerically accurate and logically sound business cases to support the internal and external sales process;
>• To leverage industry and customer knowledge to seek new business growth opportunities in the market across all product lines and segments including consumer and commercial card products, emerging payment products such as mobile / contactless payment, online digital payment, etc.
>All About You
>• Relevant experience in financial services relationship management, product management and / or marketing of consumer financial services products achieved in a financial institution, processor and/or payments company, or network. Relevant sales and account management experience in adjoining industries (including management consulting, telecommunication and information technology) will be considered.
>• Good understanding of payment products and services including consumer, commercial card products and also emerging payment products such as contactless, online, etc. The ideal candidate will possess a solid payments industry experience in Hong Kong and/or Asia Pacific region, preferably gained in product management on the issuer side with the ability to work across multiple disciplines, functions and cultures.
>• Strategic vision and the ability to think quickly with an eye to creating differential advantage for the customer whilst balancing the interests of Mastercard will be essential to success in this role;
>• Commercially aggressive and numerically astute and able to drive a strong sales culture with a strong understanding of strategy and execution;
>• Excellent at developing business relationships with people at all levels in the customer organization and bringing in results;
>• Excellent communication skills; Fluent in English, Cantonese and Mandarin;
>• The ability to work within a multicultural and matrix environment. Needs to be disciplined and tolerant of ambiguity, with the maturity and capability to credibly interact and influence across customer organization at multiple levels;
>• Strong problem solving skills and ability to reason logically with clear cause & effect arguments;
>• High professional delivery standards and personal and professional integrity and unquestionably high personal ethical standards.
>
>
Corporate Security Responsibility
>All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst
teaser: As a Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst, you will be part of our Cyber Fusion Center team, supporting the organization and its global stakeholders....
jd:
>
Key Responsibilities
As a Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst, you will be part of our Cyber Fusion Center team, supporting the organization and its global stakeholders. You’ll be integrated within our Cyber Threat Intelligence Program, which drives our worldwide efforts to identify, analyze, and manage threats to Swift. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, taking ownership of intelligence activities from collection through dissemination and stakeholder engagement, while collaborating closely with senior analysts and the Head of Cyber Threat Intelligence.
Examples of the activities you will be responsible for include:
Conduct Intelligence Collection, Analysis, and Production: Independently conduct intelligence collection, research, and analysis activities using a wide range of intelligence sources, tools, and methodologies. Produce and present high-quality intelligence products across tactical, operational, and strategic levels, including threat actor profiles, TTP analyses, threat hunting packages, geopolitical assessments, executive briefings, and threat landscape reports. Apply structured analytical techniques and clearly communicate key judgements, confidence assessments, and recommendations.
Support Threat-Informed Defence and Intelligence Response Activities: Partner with Security Operations, Incident Response, Threat Hunting, Detection Engineering, Red Team, and Vulnerability Management teams to ensure intelligence is operationalised effectively. Lead the investigation and assessment of intelligence-driven alerts, Requests for Intelligence (RFIs), emerging threats, suspicious infrastructure, and third-party exposures. Identify relevant adversary behaviours and attack trends to support defensive prioritisation and response activities.
Drive Stakeholder Engagement and Intelligence Requirements: Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across technical, operational, and business functions. Identify intelligence requirements, translate stakeholder needs into collection objectives, and ensure intelligence outputs remain relevant, actionable, and aligned with organisational priorities. Develop collection plans and priorities based on documented intelligence requirements.
Conduct Threat Infrastructure and Campaign Tracking: Monitor and analyse threat actor infrastructure, campaigns, tooling, and operational activity to identify trends, relationships, infrastructure overlaps, and emerging threats. Perform infrastructure analysis to support actor tracking, attribution assessments, collection efforts, and organisational risk assessments.
Drive CTI Capability Development, Automation, and Innovation: Identify opportunities to improve intelligence processes, workflows, automation, reporting, and operational effectiveness. Design, implement, and maintain technologies that support intelligence operations, including automation workflows, data enrichment pipelines, and platform playbooks. Contribute to intelligence-led initiatives such as analytical experimentation, deception technologies, collection projects, and emerging capability development.
Share Knowledge and Support Team Development: Actively support the growth of junior analysts through knowledge sharing, peer review, coaching, and collaboration. Promote analytical rigour, consistency, and intelligence tradecraft within the team.
This is a dynamic and growing function, and the examples above represent only a portion of the work undertaken by our team. We welcome discussions about additional areas of responsibility and opportunities for growth during the recruitment process.
Competency Profile
This position is suited to an analyst who has developed a solid foundation in cyber threat intelligence and is ready to take ownership of intelligence activities with limited supervision.
Relevant Experience in Cyber Threat Intelligence or Related Security Functions: Demonstrated experience within a Cyber Threat Intelligence function or a closely related field such as Security Operations, Incident Response, Threat Hunting, Detection Engineering, Digital Forensics, Adversary Emulation, or Security Research. Experience producing analytical assessments and intelligence products will be highly desirable.
Threat Intelligence Analysis and Tradecraft: Strong understanding of cyber threats, threat actors, intrusion methodologies, attack lifecycles, and contemporary threat trends. Experience collecting, evaluating, analysing, and synthesising information from multiple sources to produce clear, concise, and actionable intelligence outputs. Practical experience applying threat intelligence concepts and analytical methodologies, including the Intelligence Cycle, Intelligence Requirements Management, MITRE ATT&CK®, Cyber Kill Chain®, Pyramid of Pain, Structured Analytical Techniques, and Threat-Informed Defence principles. Ability to assess source reliability, evidential strength, analytical confidence, and competing hypotheses when producing intelligence assessments.
Security Operations and Intelligence Platforms, Sources, and Technologies: Understanding of common security technologies and security operations workflows, including network security controls, endpoint security, SIEM technologies, threat hunting, incident response processes, and detection engineering concepts. Experience leveraging threat intelligence platforms, intelligence sources, and analytical technologies to support intelligence collection, analysis, investigation, and dissemination activities. Ability to translate intelligence into actionable outcomes for operational security teams.
Stakeholder Engagement, Communication, and Presentation Skills: Ability to engage confidently with stakeholders across varying levels of technical expertise and seniority. Excellent written English skills are essential, with the ability to produce clear, concise, and well-structured intelligence assessments, reports, and briefings for both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong verbal communication and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex intelligence assessments clearly, deliver briefings, facilitate discussions, and provide practical recommendations that support decision-making.
Technical Engineering and Automation: Ability to develop, maintain, or enhance automations, scripts, workflows, and integrations that improve intelligence operations. Experience with Python, PowerShell, APIs, data processing, workflow automation, or security orchestration platforms is highly desirable. Comfortable working with Linux-based systems, containerised applications, cloud services, and technologies used within intelligence operations. Experience supporting, maintaining, or enhancing intelligence platforms and associated workflows is advantageous.
Threat Actor Infrastructure Analysis: Experience investigating threat actor infrastructure and campaign activity, including domains, hosting providers, SSL/TLS certificates, malware distribution mechanisms, command-and-control infrastructure, phishing infrastructure, passive DNS, WHOIS analysis, internet scanning services, and internet-facing attack surface analysis. Ability to support threat actor tracking, attribution assessments, collection efforts, and organisational risk assessments.
Intelligence Collection Management: Experience translating stakeholder needs into intelligence requirements, developing collection plans, identifying collection gaps, and measuring intelligence outcomes. Ability to proactively drive intelligence activities based on documented intelligence requirements rather than reactive tasking.
Continuous Improvement Mindset: Demonstrated curiosity and desire to continuously improve intelligence capabilities, processes, and tradecraft. Comfortable identifying opportunities for automation, workflow optimisation, capability development, and improved intelligence delivery.
Collaborative Team Player with Global Perspective: You will work within a diverse global environment and should be comfortable collaborating across functions, cultures, and geographic regions. We value individuals who actively contribute to team success, share knowledge openly, and help develop the capabilities of those around them.
Mandarin/Cantonese Language Proficiency (Highly Desirable): Professional working proficiency or fluency in Mandarin and Cantonese is highly desirable. The ability to consume, analyse, and contextualise traditional and simplified Chinese-language reporting, technical content, and threat intelligence sources, as well as engage with Mandarin/Cantonese speaking stakeholders when required, would be advantageous.
What we offer
We give you the freedom to be yourself. We are creating an environment of unique individuals – like you – with different perspectives on the financial industry and the world. A diverse and inclusive environment in which everyone’s voice counts and where you can reach your full potential.
>

About the Opportunity
>Job Type: Permanent
Application Deadline: 28 September 2026
Job Description
Title Portfolio Construction & Risk Analyst
Department Portfolio Construction & Risk
Location Hong Kong
Reports To Head of Portfolio Construction Governance
Level Level 5
We're proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you're part of something bigger.
Our clients come from all walks of life and so do we. We are proud of our inclusive culture and encourage applications from the widest mix of talent, whatever your age, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, social background and more.
As a flexible employer, we trust our people to perform their role in the way that works best for them, our clients and our business. We are a disability-friendly company and would welcome a conversation with you if you feel you might benefit from any reasonable adjustments to perform to the best of your ability during the recruitment process and beyond.
About your team
The Portfolio Construction & Risk team sits within FIL's broader cross-asset investment platform and plays a central role in supporting both Fixed Income and Multi-Asset investing.
The team's core remit is to lead the first line of defence investment risk process, partner closely with Portfolio Managers to support portfolio construction, portfolio analytics and risk management, and provide independent, insight-driven challenge to investment teams. The team also acts as a key advisor to Chief Investment Officers, contributing to investment oversight forums including Quarterly Fund Reviews (QFRs) and other regular governance discussions.
More broadly, the team helps ensure that risk is embedded in day-to-day investment decisions, while also driving the continued evolution of FIL's portfolio construction and risk-management capabilities.
About your role
This role has been created to support the growing responsibilities of the Portfolio Construction & Risk team as FIL continues to enhance its investment risk framework, analytics toolkit and portfolio construction capabilities.
The role will be focused primarily on Fixed Income, while also providing support to Multi-Asset activities where required. It is well suited to an analytically strong and commercially minded individual who enjoys solving real investment problems, working closely with portfolio managers, and translating quantitative analysis into practical portfolio insights.

jd:
ABOUT US We're the world's leading provider of secure financial messaging services, headquartered in Belgium. We are the way the world moves value - across borders, through cities and overseas. No other organisation can address the scale, precision, pace and trust that this demands, and we're proud to support the global economy.
We're unique too. We were established to find a better way for the global financial community to move value - a reliable, safe and secure approach that the community can trust, completely. We're always striving to be better and are constantly evolving in an ever-changing landscape, without undermining that trust. Five decades on, our vibrant community reflects the complexity and diversity of the financial ecosystem. We innovate diligently, test exhaustively, then implement fast. In a connected and exciting era, our mission has never been more relevant. Swift now has a presence in 200+ countries and legal territories to serve a community of more than 12,000 banks and financial institutions.
Key Responsibilities
As a Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst, you will be part of our Cyber Fusion Center team, supporting the organization and its global stakeholders. You'll be integrated within our Cyber Threat Intelligence Program, which drives our worldwide efforts to identify, analyze, and manage threats to Swift. You will operate with a high degree of autonomy, taking ownership of intelligence activities from collection through dissemination and stakeholder engagement, while collaborating closely with senior analysts and the Head of Cyber Threat Intelligence.
Examples of the activities you will be responsible for include:
Conduct Intelligence Collection, Analysis, and Production: Independently conduct intelligence collection, research, and analysis activities using a wide range of intelligence sources, tools, and methodologies. Produce and present high-quality intelligence products across tactical, operational, and strategic levels, including threat actor profiles, TTP analyses, threat hunting packages, geopolitical assessments, executive briefings, and threat landscape reports. Apply structured analytical techniques and clearly communicate key judgements, confidence assessments, and recommendations.
Support Threat-Informed Defence and Intelligence Response Activities: Partner with Security Operations, Incident Response, Threat Hunting, Detection Engineering, Red Team, and Vulnerability Management teams to ensure intelligence is operationalised effectively. Lead the investigation and assessment of intelligence-driven alerts, Requests for Intelligence (RFIs), emerging threats, suspicious infrastructure, and third-party exposures. Identify relevant adversary behaviours and attack trends to support defensive prioritisation and response activities.
Drive Stakeholder Engagement and Intelligence Requirements: Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across technical, operational, and business functions. Identify intelligence requirements, translate stakeholder needs into collection objectives, and ensure intelligence outputs remain relevant, actionable, and aligned with organisational priorities. Develop collection plans and priorities based on documented intelligence requirements.
Conduct Threat Infrastructure and Campaign Tracking: Monitor and analyse threat actor infrastructure, campaigns, tooling, and operational activity to identify trends, relationships, infrastructure overlaps, and emerging threats. Perform infrastructure analysis to support actor tracking, attribution assessments, collection efforts, and organisational risk assessments.
Drive CTI Capability Development, Automation, and Innovation: Identify opportunities to improve intelligence processes, workflows, automation, reporting, and operational effectiveness. Design, implement, and maintain technologies that support intelligence operations, including automation workflows, data enrichment pipelines, and platform playbooks. Contribute to intelligence-led initiatives such as analytical experimentation, deception technologies, collection projects, and emerging capability development.
Share Knowledge and Support Team Development: Actively support the growth of junior analysts through knowledge sharing, peer review, coaching, and collaboration. Promote analytical rigour, consistency, and intelligence tradecraft within the team.
> This is a dynamic and growing function, and the examples above represent only a portion of the work undertaken by our team. We welcome discussions about additional areas of responsibility and opportunities for growth during the recruitment process. Competency Profile
This position is suited to an analyst who has developed a solid foundation in cyber threat intelligence and is ready to take ownership of intelligence activities with limited supervision.
Relevant Experience in Cyber Threat Intelligence or Related Security Functions: Demonstrated experience within a Cyber Threat Intelligence function or a closely related field such as Security Operations, Incident Response, Threat Hunting, Detection Engineering, Digital Forensics, Adversary Emulation, or Security Research. Experience producing analytical assessments and intelligence products will be highly desirable.
Threat Intelligence Analysis and Tradecraft: Strong understanding of cyber threats, threat actors, intrusion methodologies, attack lifecycles, and contemporary threat trends. Experience collecting, evaluating, analysing, and synthesising information from multiple sources to produce clear, concise, and actionable intelligence outputs. Practical experience applying threat intelligence concepts and analytical methodologies, including the Intelligence Cycle, Intelligence Requirements Management, MITRE ATT&CK®, Cyber Kill Chain®, Pyramid of Pain, Structured Analytical Techniques, and Threat-Informed Defence principles. Ability to assess source reliability, evidential strength, analytical confidence, and competing hypotheses when producing intelligence assessments.
Security Operations and Intelligence Platforms, Sources, and Technologies: Understanding of common security technologies and security operations workflows, including network security controls, endpoint security, SIEM technologies, threat hunting, incident response processes, and detection engineering concepts. Experience leveraging threat intelligence platforms, intelligence sources, and analytical technologies to support intelligence collection, analysis, investigation, and dissemination activities. Ability to translate intelligence into actionable outcomes for operational security teams.
Stakeholder Engagement, Communication, and Presentation Skills: Ability to engage confidently with stakeholders across varying levels of technical expertise and seniority. Excellent written English skills are essential, with the ability to produce clear, concise, and well-structured intelligence assessments, reports, and briefings for both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong verbal communication and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex intelligence assessments clearly, deliver briefings, facilitate discussions, and provide practical recommendations that support decision-making.
Technical Engineering and Automation: Ability to develop, maintain, or enhance automations, scripts, workflows, and integrations that improve intelligence operations. Experience with Python, PowerShell, APIs, data processing, workflow automation, or security orchestration platforms is highly desirable. Comfortable working with Linux-based systems, containerised applications, cloud services, and technologies used within intelligence operations. Experience supporting, maintaining, or enhancing intelligence platforms and associated workflows is advantageous.
Threat Actor Infrastructure Analysis: Experience investigating threat actor infrastructure and campaign activity, including domains, hosting providers, SSL/TLS certificates, malware distribution mechanisms, command-and-control infrastructure, phishing infrastructure, passive DNS, WHOIS analysis, internet scanning services, and internet-facing attack surface analysis. Ability to support threat actor tracking, attribution assessments, collection efforts, and organisational risk assessments.
Intelligence Collection Management: Experience translating stakeholder needs into intelligence requirements, developing collection plans, identifying collection gaps, and measuring intelligence outcomes. Ability to proactively drive intelligence activities based on documented intelligence requirements rather than reactive tasking.
Continuous Improvement Mindset: Demonstrated curiosity and desire to continuously improve intelligence capabilities, processes, and tradecraft. Comfortable identifying opportunities for automation, workflow optimisation, capability development, and improved intelligence delivery.
Collaborative Team Player with Global Perspective: You will work within a diverse global environment and should be comfortable collaborating across functions, cultures, and geographic regions. We value individuals who actively contribute to team success, share knowledge openly, and help develop the capabilities of those around them.
Mandarin/Cantonese Language Proficiency (Highly Desirable): Professional working proficiency or fluency in Mandarin and Cantonese is highly desirable. The ability to consume, analyse, and contextualise traditional and simplified Chinese-language reporting, technical content, and threat intelligence sources, as well as engage with Mandarin/Cantonese speaking stakeholders when required, would be advantageous.
> What we offer We give you the freedom to be yourself. We are creating an environment of unique individuals - like you - with different perspectives on the financial industry and the world. A diverse and inclusive environment in which everyone's voice counts and where you can reach your full potential.
We are committed to an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. If you require a reasonable accommodation related to accessibility during your application or interview, please contact ••••@swift.com or indicate this in your application.
Please note that this mailbox is not monitored for general recruitment enquiries and should only be used for accessibility or accommodation-related requests (for example related to vision, hearing or neurodiversity).
All requests are confidential and will not affect your candidacy.
Don't meet every single requirement? At Swift, we are dedicated to building a workplace where people can bring their full selves and ideas to the team, so if you are excited about this role, we encourage you to apply even if you do not meet every single qualification.

This is a Market Risk Management and Credit Risk Management role responsible for tracking and analyzing market risk exposures across trading portfolios, including equities, derivatives (US stock options), and digital assets. The role involves calculating and validating Value-at-Risk (VaR), Expected Shortfall (ES), and conducting scenario analysis and stress testing under various market conditions. You will monitor trading limits, position limits, and stop-loss triggers, escalate breaches, and coordinate with the front office on remediation actions. Monitor and report on options risk metrics (Delta, Gamma, Theta, Vega, Rho) and implied volatility surfaces
Assess client creditworthiness, set margin limits, and monitor collateral adequacy (haircuts, concentration, eligibility)
Support credit assessment of third-party products (funds, structured notes, bonds) prior to distribution
Oversee collateral valuation, margin call processes, and forced liquidation procedures for both traditional and digital asset collateral
Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly risk reports for senior management, highlighting key risk indicators (KRIs), limit utilization, and emerging risk trends
Support internal model validation, back-testing, and documentation for regulatory submissions

jd:
ABOUT SILVER INNOVATION
Silver Innovation Limited conducts technology research for older adults, with a focus on active ageing, mobility, exercise and age-friendly digital experiences. We are recruiting Researcher(s) to join one of three independent research directions according to their academic background and technical expertise.
>
>Visit us to learn more: https://www.silverinnovation.design/
>
RESEARCH DIRECTIONS
• A. Wearable Technology & Mobility - Research wearable technologies, sensing and mobility support for older adults, including movement, balance, pressure distribution and physical performance.
>• B. AI & Movement Analysis - Research AI, computer vision and sensor-based methods for analysing movement, balance and mobility patterns of older adults.
>• C. Immersive Interaction & Active Ageing - Research VR/XR and interactive technologies for age-friendly exercise, movement training and active ageing applications.
>
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Conduct research on computational methods for analysing human body movement and exercise performance.
Investigate machine-learning and computer-vision methods for recognising and classifying movement patterns.
Define research datasets and measurable parameters such as joint movement, body orientation, trajectories, movement consistency and classification accuracy.
Collect, preprocess and analyse motion data from cameras, sensors or motion-tracking systems.
Investigate human pose estimation, motion feature extraction and related AI methods.
Train, test and evaluate machine-learning models using defined datasets and quantitative evaluation metrics.
Compare algorithms and model configurations and investigate methods for improving accuracy, robustness and consistency.
Document datasets, experimental settings, algorithms, evaluation procedures and research findings in technical reports.
>
REQUIREMENTS
A Bachelor's degree or Master's degree or Doctoral's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Computer Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Design Engineering, Design Science, Information Technology or a related STEM discipline.
Strong interest in technology research for older adults, mobility and active ageing.
Good analytical, problem-solving and research skills; able to work independently.
Ability to conduct structured experiments, evaluate quantitative results and document research methods.
Strong analytical and problem-solving ability with an interest in applied technology research.
Fresh graduates with relevant academic, research or technical projects are welcome.
Good command of written and spoken English.
>
PREFERRED EXPERIENCE
Experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV, VR/XR, Python, Unity, sensors, data analysis.
Experience with statistical analysis, AI APIs, large language models or cloud GPU environments.
This is an excellent learning opportunity which allows the Researcher to collaborate with senior leaders in Hong Kong. Candidates with more working experience could be considered as Senior Researcher.
>
APPLICATION
If interested, please send your full CV, cover letter, availability, and preferred research direction (A, B or C) by clicking Apply Now on the website or send email to ••••@silverinnovation.design . Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.
Fresh graduates with strong relevant research or technical project experience are welcome to apply.

Hands-on experience building RAG pipelines and integrating Vector Databases (Pinecone, Milvus, Qdrant).
Proficiency in Python and deep experience with AI orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex) and backend web frameworks like FastAPI to build scalable service layers.
Practical knowledge of local AI deployment tools and model optimization techniques, with a strong understanding of inference optimization, quantization, and hardware acceleration.

Your projects will be selected according to your skills, learning goals, and NexLLM’s current priorities. Possible areas include:
Researching and prototyping model-routing strategies
Comparing models across quality, cost, latency, availability, and reliability
Building benchmark datasets and reproducible evaluation tools
Developing fallback, retry, timeout, caching, and quota-management features
Investigating provider errors, rate limits, response formats, and performance changes
Integrating new model providers and standardising their APIs and capabilities
Building scripts, dashboards, data pipelines, and internal developer tools
Reviewing relevant papers, technical documentation, and open-source projects
Turning validated experiments into well-tested product features
Writing clear technical notes explaining methods, results, limitations, and recommendations
The work may involve Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, HTTP APIs, databases, asynchronous systems, cloud services, data analysis, and AI model APIs. You will not be expected to know everything before joining; we care about your ability to learn and make steady, evidence-based progress.
What you will learn
During the internship, you may gain practical experience in:
Building and debugging software used by real developers
Working with multiple commercial and open-source AI model providers
Designing experiments and evaluating model behaviour
Measuring latency, cost, quality, failure rates, and recovery performance
Building reliable API integrations and distributed services
Understanding how AI gateways, routing systems, and token usage work
Translating research ideas into practical engineering decisions
Communicating technical findings clearly
Working in an early-stage company where priorities evolve quickly
How the internship will work
You will normally work through a complete project cycle:
Understand a technical problem and the user or product context.
Review existing approaches, documentation, and relevant research.
Form a hypothesis and define how success will be measured.
Build a small experiment, prototype, or test harness.
Analyse the results and identify limitations.
Discuss the findings with the engineering team.
Improve the solution and, where appropriate, help move it into production.
Document what was learned and what should happen next.
The level of independence will increase as you become familiar with the platform. We provide direction and review, but you should be comfortable asking questions, investigating problems, and taking ownership of agreed tasks.
What we are looking for
We are looking for a university student who is curious, technically capable, and motivated to build real systems.
You should have:
Current university enrolment in computer science, software engineering, artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science, mathematics, or a related field
Strong interest in AI models, software engineering, or developer infrastructure
Basic programming experience in Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, Java, C++, or a similar language
Familiarity with APIs, Git, databases, or cloud services, through coursework or personal projects
Ability to break an unclear problem into smaller steps
Willingness to test assumptions and measure results rather than rely on guesses
Care with details, reproducibility, and technical documentation
Ability to communicate clearly and work collaboratively
Availability for a full-time internship during the agreed internship period
Prior professional experience is not required. Strong coursework, personal projects, research projects, hackathon work, open-source contributions, GitHub repositories, or technical writing are welcome.
You do not need prior experience with AI gateways, large language model infrastructure, or distributed systems. We value learning ability and practical curiosity more than a long list of tools.
Helpful but not required
What makes someone a strong fit
You may be a strong fit if you:
Like understanding how things work rather than only using them
Enjoy both reading and building
Can turn a question into a small experiment
Are willing to start with an imperfect prototype and improve it
Care about whether your results are reliable and reproducible
Take responsibility for finishing work and communicating blockers early
Want to see your work used in a real product
Are excited by the fast-moving AI infrastructure landscape in Asia
This internship may not be the right fit if you are looking only for a passive learning experience, do not want to write or debug software, or prefer a fixed task list with no ambiguity. Early-stage engineering work requires curiosity, initiative, and a willingness to learn unfamiliar systems.
Why join NexLLM
Work on a live AI platform used by developers
Gain practical experience with multiple leading AI models and providers
Work directly with the founder and engineering team
Learn about model routing, evaluation, reliability, APIs, and cloud infrastructure
Build projects that can become real product capabilities
Receive feedback and guidance from experienced team members
Explore the intersection of applied AI research and product engineering
Help build a regional AI infrastructure capability from Hong Kong
Potentially be considered for future engineering opportunities based on performance and business needs
Compensation and university coordination
This is a full-time internship. Internship compensation, working arrangement, duration, start date, and any university documentation will be discussed with shortlisted candidates and confirmed before the internship begins.
Candidates who need an internship agreement, supervisor information, learning objectives, progress reviews, or other university documentation should mention this when applying.

Build predictive models for trading costs, short-term price dynamics, liquidity conditions, market impact, and execution risk.
Research, develop, and support central risk book strategies, including internal crossing, risk warehousing, inventory management, hedging, and risk transfer between trading desks.
Build quantitative tools and monitoring frameworks to support execution decision-making, internalization opportunities, risk monitoring, performance attribution, and CRB-related strategies.

Working Experience around 2-5 years.
Strong quantitative research skills, with experience applying statistical, econometric, optimization, or machine learning techniques to real-world data.
Strong programming ability in Python, KDB+/q, Java, or another language commonly used in quantitative research and trading.
Good understanding of market microstructure concepts, including liquidity, spreads, market impact, order types, execution algorithms, venue behavior, and short-term price dynamics.
Familiarity with TCA, execution analytics, algorithmic trading, smart order routing, or electronic trading workflows is preferred.
Entrepreneurial mindset, with strong analytical skills, commercial judgment, attention to detail, and independent thinking.
Strong communication skills and ability to explain quantitative findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Good to Have
Experience developing execution algorithms, market impact models, or liquidity forecasting models.
Experience with broker / venue analysis, algo wheel analytics, post-trade TCA, or execution benchmarking.
Familiarity with internal crossing, central risk book, market making, inventory optimization, or risk warehousing strategies.
Prior financial markets experience, particularly in equities or electronic trading.
Meeting Performance Goals
Complete research and analytics projects on time.
Independently own research initiatives leading to practical application.
Deliver tools, models, and insights that improve execution performance and trading efficiency.
Contribute to CRB-related monitoring, including exposures, inventory, and key drivers of trading outcomes.

title: Low Latency MM Engineer
teaser: We are hiring for a Low Latency Market Making Engineer to design, build, and continuously optimize the systems responsible for quote generation and...
jd:
About G20 Group
G-20 Group is a cross-asset trading firm headquartered in Switzerland, trading delta-one and derivatives markets globally. We combine startup agility with institutional-grade experience in proprietary trading, technology, and quantitative finance.
>
Role Overview
We are hiring for a Low Latency Market Making Engineer to design, build, and continuously optimize the systems responsible for quote generation and order execution within microsecond-level latency tolerances. This role sits combines deep knowledge of software engineering, hardware, and market microstructure, and requires close collaboration with traders and quantitative researchers to translate strategy requirements into production systems capable of achieving favorable queue position across trading venues.
Responsibilities
Design, build, and maintain ultra-low-latency market making systems, including order entry, market data processing, risk controls, and quote and order management functionality
Continuously profile and optimize the tick-to-trade path, from network interface through kernel to application, with close attention to CPU cache behavior, memory layout, branch prediction, and lock-free data structures
Collaborate with hardware engineers, or develop FPGA logic directly depending on background, to minimize latency in critical-path processing
Own exchange connectivity, including implementation and maintenance of FIX, ITCH/OUCH, or proprietary binary protocols for order entry and market data feeds
Partner with traders and quantitative researchers to implement and calibrate quoting logic, risk controls, and inventory management in production environments
Build and maintain simulation, backtesting, and replay infrastructure to validate strategy and system changes prior to live deployment
Monitor live trading systems, diagnose latency regressions and operational anomalies in real time, and lead root-cause resolution efforts
Contribute to capacity planning and infrastructure decisions relating to co-location, network topology, and hardware upgrades
Uphold rigorous engineering standards, including code review, testing, deployment safety, and change management practices appropriate for systems executing live capital.
Requirements
Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Data Science, Economics, Business, or a related field, top-tier university preferred
Strong proficiency in C++ (modern C++17/20 preferred), with the ability to reason about assembly output and compiler behavior
Thorough understanding of computer architecture, including CPU caches, NUMA, memory ordering, and kernel bypass networking technologies (e.g., Solarflare/OpenOnload, DPDK, or comparable solutions)
Experience with low-latency networking and associated protocols (TCP/UDP internals, multicast, kernel bypass) as well as exchange connectivity protocols such as FIX, ITCH, or OUCH
Solid understanding of Linux internals, including scheduling, interrupt handling, NUMA pinning, and huge pages, with demonstrated experience tuning production systems at the operating system level
Working knowledge of market microstructure, including order books, matching engine behavior, queue position, adverse selection, and inventory risk management practices employed by market makers
Experience with FPGA development (Verilog/VHDL) is advantageous, though not a strict requirement for all candidates
Demonstrated experience working on systems where microsecond- or nanosecond-level performance was critical, such as high-frequency trading, market making, exchange technology, or comparable latency-sensitive domains (telecommunications, high-performance computing, real-time systems)
Strong debugging and profiling capabilities using tools such as perf, VTune, or custom tracing and timestamping infrastructure
Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with trading personnel under time-sensitive conditions during market hours.
Preferred / Desirable Experience
Experience building or tuning matching engines or exchange-side systems
Exposure to FPGA-based trading systems or programmable networking hardware (e.g., Solarflare, Exablaze, Arista MetaWatch)
Prior experience at a market making firm, high-frequency trading firm, or exchange technology vendor.
Locations and Right to work : This role can be based out of our Zurich, London, New York or Hong Kong office. Only candidates who possess the pre-existing right to work in one of the locations above without company sponsorship need apply.
Join G-20 and be a part of a team that is at the forefront of financial markets, driving innovation and excellence in the sector.

title: Product Management Trainee
location: Tsim Sha Tsui, Yau Tsim Mong District
teaser: If you want to start your career at the intersection of Product × AI × Data × Global Growth, this is your chance .
jd:
About the Role
We are looking for high-potential graduates to join our Product Management team as Product Management Trainees.
You will work closely with our global advertising business and gain hands-on experience across Meta, Google, TikTok, DSPs, and our proprietary advertising platforms. You will be exposed to product management, advertising operations, data analytics, growth strategy, and ad technology.
This is not a traditional administrative management trainee role. We are looking for future product leaders who can understand business, data, technology, and user needs, and eventually take ownership of core advertising or growth products.
You will work directly with product, advertising operations, engineering, data, and algorithm teams to solve real business problems and build products from 0 to 1.
Key Responsibilities
1. Advertising Product Development
* Learn and understand the advertising logic and product ecosystems of major platforms such as Meta, Google, TikTok, and DSPs.
* Participate in product planning, requirements analysis, and feature design for advertising platforms and internal campaign management tools.
* Assist with user/business research, problem analysis, product prototyping, and PRD documentation.
* Participate in building new products from 0 to 1 and continuously improving existing products.
2. Advertising Strategy & Growth Products
* Develop an understanding of key advertising processes, including budget allocation, bidding, creative management, audience targeting, and campaign management.
* Analyze advertising performance and identify issues affecting key metrics such as CTR, CVR, CPA, ROAS, and LTV.
* Assist in designing and optimizing features such as automated bidding, budget management, creative management, and strategy recommendations.
* Use data and business insights to identify opportunities to improve advertising efficiency and ROI.
3. Data & Attribution
* Learn the fundamentals of advertising attribution, MMPs, data tracking, and performance measurement.
* Help map data flows across impressions, clicks, installs, purchases, retention, and LTV.
* Work with engineering, data, and advertising teams to ensure accurate and timely data collection and transmission.
* Translate data insights into actionable product improvement recommendations.
4. Cross-functional Project Execution
* Work with advertising operations, engineering, data, and algorithm teams to translate business problems into product requirements.
* Follow projects through development, testing, launch, and performance evaluation.
* Gradually develop product thinking, project management skills, and business judgment through hands-on projects.
5. Structured Training & Rotation
* Participate in structured learning and project rotations across product, advertising operations, data, and growth.
* Work with experienced mentors and gradually take ownership of small product projects.
* Build a systematic understanding of global advertising, internet growth, data analytics, and product management.
Requirements
1、 Basic Qualifications
* Bachelor's or Master's degree, with 0–2 years of full-time work experience. Outstanding fresh graduates are welcome to apply.
* Open to all academic backgrounds. Degrees in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Finance, Business Analytics, Marketing, or related fields are preferred.
* Strong interest in internet products, digital advertising, global markets, or growth.
* Strong analytical and logical thinking skills.
* Ability to quickly learn unfamiliar businesses, technologies, and platforms and break down complex problems into structured solutions.
* Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* High ownership, initiative, and ability to drive tasks to completion.
* Good working proficiency in English, with the ability to read English product documentation, technical materials, and advertising platform resources.
2、What We Value Most
* Product mindset: You naturally think from user and business needs rather than simply executing instructions.
* Data mindset: You enjoy using data to identify problems, test hypotheses, and find opportunities.
* Business sense: You are interested in metrics such as ROI, cost, revenue, and LTV.
* Technical curiosity: You do not need to be a programmer, but you should be comfortable learning concepts such as APIs, data flows, and system logic.
* Learning agility: You can quickly build knowledge in unfamiliar domains.
* Execution: You are capable of turning ideas into real products and measurable results.
Preferred Qualifications
Any of the following would be a strong plus:
* Internship experience in product management, growth, internet, or digital advertising.
* Experience using or researching advertising platforms such as Meta, Google, or TikTok.
* Exposure to global advertising, gaming, social, e-commerce, fintech, or other internet businesses.
* Experience with SQL, Python, Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or other data analytics tools.
* Experience with product projects, business analysis projects, entrepreneurship, or product management coursework.
* Experience independently building an app, website, SaaS product, or other digital product.
* Experience with AI, automation tools, data platforms, or AdTech-related projects.
* Strong English communication skills or international study/project experience.
Training & Career Development
We aim to develop this role into a core talent pipeline for the company.
You will receive:
* Mentorship: One-on-one guidance from experienced product or business leaders.
* Business Rotation: Exposure to advertising operations, product management, data, and growth.
* Real Ownership: Direct involvement in our global advertising platform and core product initiatives.
* Accelerated Growth: Gradually take ownership of product modules and business projects based on your capabilities.
* Career Path: Product Manager / Growth Product Manager / Data Product Manager / Advertising Strategy Product Manager / Product Lead.
If you are excited about Product + Global Advertising + Data & Growth + AI/Automation, and want to build strong business and product capabilities early in your career, we would love to hear from you.
>

title: Digital Marketing Specialist
teaser: We are looking for a Performance Media Specialist who is genuinely curious about the intersection of marketing, code, and AI.
jd:
Shifted the weighting so Google Ads and Meta Ads optimization is the clear centerpiece — moved it to the top of responsibilities, expanded it with specifics (bid strategy, A/B testing, budget allocation logic), and pushed Microsoft/Mainland platforms further down as secondary. Qualifications now ask for optimization depth on these two platforms specifically, not just "understanding."
The Role
We're looking for a data-driven Digital Marketing Specialist who lives inside Google Ads and Meta Ads and treats optimization as a craft . This role owns performance: bid strategy, budget allocation, audience and creative testing, and the constant work of finding the next percentage point of efficiency.
In 2026, BMG is putting AI and automation at the core of how our Hong Kong team operates. You'll use Python to automate the repetitive parts of campaign management and build dashboards that tell people what to do next — not just what happened. If you're the kind of marketer who gets genuinely excited by a well-run A/B test or a bid strategy that finally clicks, this role is built for you.
You'll work closely with our HK media team and BMG's global MarTech and AI engineering team across Hong Kong, Taipei, Guangzhou, Melbourne, Los Angeles, New Jersey, and New York — with direct exposure to Adeqo, our proprietary analytics and automation platform, and Pable.ai, our agentic AI division.
Key Responsibilities
Own and optimize paid campaigns end-to-end on Google Ads and Meta Ads: campaign structure, bid strategy, budget allocation, audience targeting, and creative testing.
Run structured A/B tests on ad creative, audiences, and bidding approaches, and translate results into scaling decisions.
Monitor performance daily against client KPIs (CPA, ROAS, CTR, conversion rate) and take action — reallocating budget, adjusting bids, pausing underperformers.
Use Python (Pandas, requests, marketing platform APIs) to automate routine optimization work: budget pacing, anomaly detection, keyword expansion, and reporting.
Build GA4 and Looker Studio dashboards that surface performance insights and recommended actions, not just numbers.
Use AI tools (Kimi/Moonshot, DeepSeek, Qwen, Doubao, or similar) for ad copy variation and creative iteration.
Extend optimization skills to Microsoft Ads and Mainland platforms (Xiaohongshu, WeChat, Douyin) as client needs require.
Collaborate with internal teams to keep campaigns aligned with client business objectives.
Monitor competitor activity and emerging trends to identify optimization opportunities.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Data Science, Information Systems, Advertising, or a related field.
Proven hands-on experience managing and optimizing Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns — not just familiarity, but ownership of performance outcomes.
Comfortable with bid strategies, audience segmentation, and structured testing frameworks.
Working knowledge of Python — comfortable reading and modifying scripts that use Pandas or call marketing APIs.
Solid grounding in GA4, web analytics, and SEO fundamentals — able to turn a dataset into a decision, not just a chart.
Familiarity with Microsoft Ads is a plus.
Familiarity with Cursor, VS Code, or another modern code editor is a plus.
Exposure to Mainland channels (Xiaohongshu, WeChat, Douyin) is a plus, not a requirement.
Comfortable working in English; Cantonese and/or Mandarin a strong plus.
A genuine analytical mindset — curious about why a number moved, not just that it moved.
Ability to manage multiple projects under deadlines.
Bonus Points
Experience with Google Ads API or Meta Marketing API directly.
Hands-on experience with an LLM-based workflow for marketing tasks (Kimi/Moonshot, DeepSeek, Qwen, or Doubao).
Tag management, GTM server-side, or Consent Mode v2 implementation.
Exposure to MCP servers, Cursor agents, or RPA-style automation.
What We Provide
Tooling: Cursor team seat, paid AI tool access (Kimi/Moonshot API, DeepSeek API, Qwen API), managed marketing platform API credentials, and shared automation infrastructure.
Direct exposure to BMG's proprietary MarTech stack — Adeqo and Pable.ai — so your optimization work plugs into real products, not side projects.
Direct collaboration with BMG's global team across Hong Kong, Taipei, Guangzhou, New York, New Jersey, Los Angeles, and Melbourne.
5-day work week, MPF, medical insurance, annual leave, and discretionary performance bonus.
Annual training and certification budget.

Proficient in Python, familiar with mainstream ML/DL frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, etc.) and LLM fine-tuning toolchains; possess experience in NLP and LLM application development, with knowledge of Fine-tuning, RAG, Prompt Engineering, etc.

title: Founding AI R&D Engineer — AI Infrastructure & Model Routing
teaser:
We are looking for a Founding AI R&D Engineer to help turn research ideas into working systems.
What you will work on
Research and prototype...
jd:
Location: Hong Kong / flexible hybrid arrangementCompany: A-Field Tech LimitedType: Founding-team, full-time role
Help build the intelligence layer for AI infrastructure in Asia
A-Field Tech Limited is a Hong Kong-based AI and network infrastructure company. We are building a stable regional AI gateway (www.nexllm.ai) to leading AI models. Our live platform gives developers one interface for accessing 51 models across Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, Qwen, DeepSeek, and other providers.
We are now developing the next layer: intelligent routing, model evaluation, reliability tooling, and developer infrastructure that helps applications choose and operate the right model for each task.
We are looking for a Founding AI R&D Engineer to help turn research ideas into working systems.
What you will work on
Research and prototype intelligent model-routing strategies
Build evaluation and benchmarking tools for quality, cost, latency, and reliability
Develop fallback, retry, caching, observability, and quota-management systems
Investigate how prompts and task requirements can be matched to suitable models
Build experiments, simulations, datasets, and reproducible test harnesses
Integrate new model providers and standardise different APIs and capabilities
Turn validated research into reliable production features
Document findings, limitations, and technical recommendations clearly
The role combines applied AI research, software engineering, distributed systems, and product development. You will work on real technical problems affecting a live platform, not a purely theoretical research project.
What we are looking for
Strong software engineering fundamentals
Experience with applied research, experimentation, data analysis, AI systems, or complex technical products
Familiarity with Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, or a similar language
Understanding of APIs, databases, asynchronous systems, cloud infrastructure, or distributed services
Ability to turn an unclear problem into a hypothesis, experiment, measurable result, and practical implementation
Strong analytical thinking and attention to reliability and reproducibility
Curiosity about large language models, model evaluation, routing, and AI infrastructure
Ownership mindset and comfort working in an early-stage company
A degree in computer science, AI, machine learning, software engineering, data science, or a related field is helpful. Strong projects, research experience, publications, open-source work, or equivalent practical experience are also welcome.
You do not need prior experience building an AI gateway. We care about your ability to learn unfamiliar systems, investigate difficult questions, and build useful solutions.
Why join A-Field Tech/NexLLM
Join while the core R&D direction is still being shaped
Work directly with the founder and have visible technical ownership
Build systems used by developers and AI teams across Asia
Work at the intersection of AI models, routing, evaluation, reliability, and developer tools
Help establish a regional technical capability in AI infrastructure
Receive a competitive salary and share-option opportunity, subject to formal scheme terms
