title: 强化学习算法工程师（Agent Reinforcement Learning Engineer）
teaser:
We are looking for Agent Reinforcement Learning Engineers to join our Agent Core team.
You will help build learning-capable AI agents...
jd:
部门： AI智能体研究中心
>地点： 香港, 深圳
>工作经验： 实习生、应届生
>招聘人数： 10人
关于岗位
我们正在招聘 AI 智能体强化学习工程师，加入 echOS Agent 核心团队。
你将直接参与构建在真实产业环境中运行的智能体系统，让 Agent：
>•与复杂业务环境持续交互
>•学习定价、库存、调度等决策策略
>•具备长程规划能力
>•基于真实反馈持续自我进化
>•根据企业偏好动态调整行为
这是强化学习 + 大模型 + 多智能体协同在真实商业系统中的落地，而不是模拟世界里的 benchmark。
⸻
工作重点（Focus）
>•为产业级 AI Agent 构建环境交互系统（业务状态 / 行为空间 / 奖励建模）
>•将强化学习引入真实场景，如渠道定价优化、库存分配、履约调度
>•构建 Agent 长程规划与复杂任务拆解能力
>•实现偏好学习与反馈优化（企业目标、风险约束、利润权衡）
>•设计仿真环境与离线评估体系，用于训练与回放真实业务策略
>•构建 Agent 学习闭环：感知 → 决策 → 执行 → 反馈 → 进化
>•搭建自动化训练、评估与部署流水线
>•提升大规模 RL 任务的稳定性与可观测性
>•重构 Agent / 数据 / 训练框架，使研究成果快速进入生产系统
⸻
理想经验
>•有强化学习 / Agent / 决策系统经验
>•能将现实问题抽象为状态、动作、奖励
>•熟悉 PyTorch / Python
>•有系统工程意识
>•对真实商业系统有好奇心
加分项：
>•多智能体系统
>•运筹优化 / 博弈
>•供应链 / 定价 / 资源调度经验
>•LLM Agent 框架
⸻
你将面对的典型问题
>•一个渠道价格策略在不同区域表现完全不同，Agent 如何通过强化学习自动适配？
>•库存与履约冲突时，如何让 Agent 学会权衡利润、时效与风险？
>•新增一个业务模块，如何快速构建可学习环境？
>•真实业务数据噪声极大，如何设计鲁棒 reward？
>•企业偏好变化时，如何让 Agent 快速重新对齐目标？
⸻
技术栈
Python / PyTorch
>分布式 RL
>Agent 框架
>Typescript / React（内部工具）
Department:
>AI Agent Research Center
>Location:
>Hong Kong, Shen Zhen
>Work Experience:
>Graduate / Early Career
>Number of openings: 10
About the Role
We are looking for Agent Reinforcement Learning Engineers to join our Agent Core team.
You will help build learning-capable AI agents that:
>•Interact continuously with real-world business environments
>•Learn decision policies for pricing, inventory, and operations
>•Perform long-horizon reasoning and planning
>•Optimize behavior through feedback and preference alignment
>•Improve themselves over time in production
This role focuses on applying reinforcement learning together with large language models and agent architectures in real industrial systems — not simulated toy environments.
⸻
Focus
>•Design agent-environment interaction systems (observations, actions, rewards)
>•Apply reinforcement learning to real scenarios such as pricing optimization, inventory allocation, and fulfillment scheduling
>•Build long-horizon planning and multi-step reasoning pipelines for agents
>•Implement preference learning and feedback optimization (RLHF / RLAIF / online learning)
>•Construct simulation environments and offline evaluation pipelines from real business data
>•Build closed learning loops: Sense → Decide → Act → Feedback → Improve
>•Develop automated training, evaluation, and deployment workflows
>•Improve observability and stability of large-scale RL jobs
>•Refactor agent, data, and training frameworks for production readiness
⸻
Ideal Experience
>•Background in reinforcement learning, agents, or decision systems
>•Strong Python + PyTorch
>•Ability to abstract real-world problems into states, actions, and rewards
>•Systems thinking mindset
Nice to have:
>•Multi-agent experience
>•Operations research / game theory
>•Supply chain, pricing, or resource optimization exposure
>•LLM agent frameworks (LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI)
⸻
Typical Problems You’ll Work On
>•A pricing strategy behaves differently across regions — how should the agent adapt via reinforcement learning?
>•Inventory and fulfillment objectives conflict — how can agents learn trade-offs between profit, cost, and service level?
>•Business data is noisy and delayed — how do we design robust reward functions?
>•Enterprise preferences shift — how do we quickly realign agent behavior?
⸻
Tech Stack
Python / PyTorch
>Distributed RL
>Agent frameworks

title: Marketing Executive

Scale a Next-Gen Education Brand as Marketing Executive
Own Meta Ads, AI workflows & growth funnels. Salary + quarterly bonuses. Join us!
jd:
明道教育 Lumos Education
>誠聘：Associate Marketing Executive 市場推廣主任
關於我們
明道教育（Lumos Education）是一間位於佐敦的持牌 DSE 補習教育中心，專注為中學生提供高質素、小班制及貼身跟進的學習體驗。
我們的教學特色包括「錯題分析」、「改卷員視角」、「小班跟進」及 AI 改卷與學習分析技術，致力協助學生更有系統地提升公開試表現。
隨着課程及團隊持續發展，我們正積極建立更完整的市場推廣及增長系統，現誠邀一位對數碼營銷、內容創作、數據分析及 AI 工具有興趣的市場推廣人才加入團隊。
即使你未有正式 Marketing 工作經驗，只要你對這個領域有興趣、有相關作品或實踐經驗，並願意主動學習，我們亦歡迎你申請。

Associate Marketing Executive 將參與明道教育不同市場推廣項目的策劃及執行，包括數碼廣告、社交媒體內容、網站數據追蹤、SEO／AEO、試堂推廣及招生 Campaign。
你會與團隊共同策劃 Campaign，並負責不同項目的實際執行、跟進及數據整理，逐步掌握一個教育品牌由內容、廣告到招生轉化的完整 Marketing 流程。
我們希望你不只是完成工作清單，而是逐步學懂從數據了解：
廣告 → 查詢 → 試堂預約 → 試堂出席 → 正式報名
整個招生漏斗如何運作，以及如何透過不同 Marketing 實驗持續改善成效。
相比「已經識晒所有 Marketing 工具」，我們更加重視你的：
學習能力、主動性、執行力、內容 Sense，以及對數據的敏感度。
主要職責
1. 數碼廣告及 Campaign 執行協助策劃、執行及優化數碼市場推廣 Campaign，以 Meta Ads 為主要投放渠道
協助處理廣告受眾設定、素材測試及不同 Offer 的 A/B Testing

使用 Google Analytics、Google Search Console、Meta Ads Manager 等工具查看及整理數據

利用 AI 協助產生不同版本的廣告文案、Social Content 及 Campaign Idea

協助改善團隊 Marketing Workflow

查詢 → 試堂預約 → 試堂出席 → 正式報名
協助製作試堂提醒、Follow-up Message 及招生推廣訊息
整理不同 Campaign 及渠道的轉化數據

入職要求
歡迎應屆畢業生申請，沒有正式工作經驗亦可考慮
如具 1–2 年 Marketing、Digital Marketing、Social Media、Content Creation 或相關經驗更佳
對 Marketing、Social Media、Advertising 或品牌營運有興趣

對數據有基本敏感度，願意學習 CPL、Conversion Rate、Cost per Booking 等 Marketing 指標
曾接觸 Google Analytics、Search Console、Meta Ads Manager 等工具者優先，但非必要
具良好文字及內容判斷能力
熟悉或願意學習使用 ChatGPT、Claude 等 AI 工具
對 AI、數碼工具及新的 Marketing 方法保持好奇
具良好中英文書寫及溝通能力
做事有條理、細心，能按時完成工作及主動跟進
願意接受 Feedback，並持續改善自己的工作
具教育行業、補習社、本地品牌或服務業經驗者優先
如你沒有正式 Marketing 工作經驗，但曾有以下經歷，我們亦非常歡迎你申請：
經營自己的 IG／Threads／YouTube／小紅書帳號
為學會、學生組織或活動負責宣傳
曾製作 Social Media Content、短片或設計
曾自己嘗試投放 Meta Ads
有 Freelance、Internship 或 Part-time Marketing 經驗
有自己的 Marketing／Content Portfolio
曾利用 AI 工具完成 Content、Design 或 Marketing Project
相比履歷上的年資，我們更加重視你是否：
願意學、肯落手做、主動思考、睇數據、識改善。

月薪 HK$16,000 – HK$23,000 ，視乎經驗、能力及 Portfolio 而定
季度 KPI 獎金

title: Senior Engineer, Trading Product Engineering

jd:
About Bullish
> Bullish is an institutionally focused global digital asset platform that provides market infrastructure and information services. These include: Bullish Exchange - a regulated and institutionally focused digital assets spot and derivatives exchange, integrating a high-performance central limit order book matching engine with automated market making to provide deep and predictable liquidity. Bullish Exchange is regulated in Germany, Hong Kong, and Gibraltar. CoinDesk Indices - a collection of tradable proprietary and single-asset benchmarks and indices that track the performance of digital assets for global institutions in the digital assets and traditional finance industries. CoinDesk Data - a broad suite of digital assets market data and analytics, providing real-time insights into prices, trends, and market dynamics. CoinDesk Insights - a digital asset media and events provider and operator of Coindesk.com, a digital media platform that covers news and insights about digital assets, the underlying markets, policy, and blockchain technology. Reports to:
> Vice President, Engineering
Engineering Organization & Culture
At Bullish, we are engineering the institutional standard for the digital asset industry. Our mission is to build a platform centered on security and compliance, requiring a commitment to technical excellence that extends beyond delivering code. As a global organization, we set a high bar for those driven to do their best work alongside experienced, deeply specialized peers.
Engineers here treat development as a craft and own the outcome from concept to deployment. Our teams bring structure to ambiguity and shape the frameworks that support a global organization. We refuse to compromise on quality and seek problem solvers who thrive on complex technical challenges with real market consequences.
The Team: Trading Product Engineering
The Trading Product Engineering team builds the core distributed systems that drive the global trading experience on Bullish Exchange. We own the end-to-end order lifecycle, orchestrating a hybrid matching engine that combines a Central Limit Order Book with proprietary Automated Market Making. Our high-throughput APIs enable trading across Spot, Futures, and Options. The work demands absolute correctness in managing complex financial state transitions, translating intricate market structures into scalable solutions.
What You'll Do
>
Design and deliver reusable, reliable, low-latency Java code that powers the Exchange.
Raise the bar on code quality, organization, and automation as the system scales under load.
Profile and resolve performance bottlenecks in the order-processing path.
Improve stability through automated tests at the unit, integration, and performance layers.
Collaborate across a distributed team of engineers, product managers, and project managers.
> What You'll Bring
> Strong Java (17+) fluency with experience in performance tuning.
Track record of designing and building systems for high throughput and low latency.
Hands-on experience with agentic AI development: LLM integration, prompt engineering, and SDLC automation.
Solid understanding of middleware and messaging technologies such as Chronicle Queue, RabbitMQ, Aeron, and Kafka.
Working knowledge of Spring or Micronaut, Docker, and Kubernetes.
Deep knowledge of testing methodologies, SDLC practices, and CI/CD pipelines.
Ownership of the components the Exchange depends on.
> Nice to Haves
> Experience working on core trading functionality such as order matching and orderbook generation.
Familiarity with financial derivative products (Options, Futures), the FIX protocol, and related workflows.
Understanding of blockchain technologies.
> Bullish is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are fast evolving and striving towards being a globally-diverse community. With integrity at our core, our success is driven by a talented team of individuals and the different perspectives they are encouraged to bring to work every day.

8+ years' experience working within investment management technology, front-office change or product delivery roles.

teaser: We operate as a lean, autonomous team: each trader owns a dedicated account and runs their own strategy, supported by shared capital,...
jd:
About Us
XINXIAMEN CAPITAL MANAGEMENT, founded in 2016 and headquartered in Singapore with a Hong Kong office, is a single family office with a quantitative core, investing across global markets. In the secondary markets we run a dual engine of discretionary and systematic strategies — with particular depth in US equities and crypto assets — spanning market-neutral, CTA and multi-factor approaches at mid-to-low frequency. Our edge is research- and data-driven: rigorous backtesting, disciplined risk management and continuous strategy development, complemented by external allocations and selective primary-market opportunities across industries worldwide.
We operate as a lean, autonomous team: each trader owns a dedicated account and runs their own strategy, supported by shared capital, infrastructure, data and execution. We are now expanding our quantitative trading desk in Hong Kong and looking for independent quant traders who already have a proven strategy of their own.
The Role You will run your own systematic trading book end-to-end — from signal research and strategy design through backtesting, live deployment, execution and risk management. This is a high-autonomy, P&L-owning seat for a self-sufficient trader who can independently build, run and improve profitable mid-to-low frequency strategies in crypto market.
Key Responsibilities Independently own and trade a dedicated account, taking full responsibility for strategy P&L and risk.
Research, develop and deploy mid-to-low frequency systematic strategies — market-neutral, CTA / trend-following, statistical arbitrage, multi-factor equity, funding-rate and cross-exchange arbitrage — across crypto (spot, perpetuals, derivatives) and US equities.
Manage the full trading lifecycle: data pipelines, factor research, backtesting, parameter optimisation, live execution, and real-time risk and inventory monitoring.
Continuously improve strategy capacity, Sharpe and drawdown control as market conditions evolve.
Maintain rigorous risk discipline and operate within firm-wide risk limits.
Requirements 3+ years of mid-to-low frequency systematic / quantitative trading experience, gained at a top-tier quantitative trading firm — a leading quant hedge fund or proprietary trading firm.
A demonstrable, attributable live track record running your own strategy, with clear metrics (returns, Sharpe, maximum drawdown, capacity).
Hands-on expertise in market-neutral and/or CTA / systematic strategies, ideally in crypto and/or US equity markets; experience with statistical arbitrage or multi-factor models is highly valued.
Strong programming skills in Python (and/or C++) covering the full pipeline: research, backtesting, execution and monitoring.
Solid foundation in mathematics, statistics, probability and/or machine learning.
Proven ability to work independently, and self-manage with strong risk awareness.
Preferred Live trading track record in crypto / digital-asset markets (CEX and/or DEX) and/or US equities.
Experience with multi-factor models, alternative data, NLP / sentiment signals, or machine-learning-driven research.
Advanced degree (MSc / PhD) in a quantitative discipline — mathematics, statistics, physics, computer science, financial engineering or similar.

Design, develop and iterate end-to-end frontend modules for AI-native web application platform, centering on AI algorithm visualization, intelligent data analysis and automated operation workflows.
Architect and build high-performance real-time AI dashboards to visualize robot status, sensor telemetry streams, AI model inference results, anomaly detection alarms, intelligent quality analysis reports and predictive maintenance metrics.
Craft intuitive UI/UX workflows for AI-powered scenarios: intelligent monitoring, offline/online AI data analytics, AI anomaly alert dispatch, model effect review and intelligent operation audit.
Seamlessly integrate frontend with IoT service backends, AI inference APIs, model training pipelines and real-time streaming data interfaces; design data interaction logic tailored for AI algorithm output.
Translate massive multi-dimensional AI sensor data, computer vision outputs and machine learning metrics into concise, interactive visual interfaces for operators, AI engineers and business stakeholders.
Develop standardized, reusable AI visualization component library: real-time data charts, AI inference panels, anomaly alert widgets, model comparison views and industrial monitoring modules.
Partner closely with AI algorithm engineers, backend developers and product managers to define API specs, AI data rendering logic and front-backend data interaction standards.
Continuously optimize frontend performance for heavy AI data rendering, boost page loading speed, real-time stream refresh efficiency, interface accessibility and long-term code maintainability for AI product iteration.
Participate in unit testing, joint debugging, cloud deployment and post-launch iteration; collect end-user feedback to optimize AI interface interaction experience and intelligent operation efficiency.

Minimum 1 year professional frontend development experience; outstanding fresh graduates with AI/IoT related internships, capstone projects or complete portfolio/GitHub projects are welcome.

Proficient in core modern frontend stack: React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3; solid hands-on experience building production-grade AI web applications.
Proven track record of developing responsive cross-device web interfaces for industrial AI monitoring scenarios (desktop + mobile adaptive).
Skilled in integrating RESTful APIs and processing structured/unstructured AI algorithm return data for frontend rendering.
Practical experience building complex data dashboards, multi-dimensional AI data visualizations, real-time status panels and intelligent alert management pages.
Solid grasp of user-centric UI/UX design thinking, able to design operation-friendly interfaces for AI analysis and industrial monitoring scenarios.
Familiar with Git version control and standardized modern frontend engineering workflows.
Cross-team collaboration capability: communicate efficiently with AI algorithm, IoT, backend and product teams to align AI product iteration goals.

title: Agentic Engineer - Voice AI
teaser: In this role, you will develop the systems that allow AI agents to listen, think, and speak in real time over WhatsApp voice calls. This includes...
jd:
>
About the Role
>
We are looking for an Agentic Engineer – Voice AI to build and scale Wati's real-time voice AI capabilities on WhatsApp.
In this role, you will develop the systems that allow AI agents to listen, think, and speak in real time over WhatsApp voice calls. This includes building and optimizing the real-time media pipeline (WebRTC, LiveKit), integrating frontier AI models (OpenAI Realtime API, Google Gemini Live), and engineering the cascade architecture that connects speech recognition, language models, and speech synthesis into a seamless conversational experience.
You will work on latency-critical infrastructure where every millisecond matters — from audio transport and voice activity detection to model inference and text-to-speech delivery. You will also contribute to the broader AI agent stack, including tool calling, context management, and multi-turn conversation orchestration.
This role sits at the intersection of real-time communication systems, AI model integration, and conversational voice experiences.
What You Will Do
• Design, build, and optimize real-time voice AI pipelines — from WebRTC media transport to LLM inference and speech synthesis
• Integrate and orchestrate frontier AI models including OpenAI Realtime API, Google Gemini multimodal live, and cascade architectures (ASR → LLM → TTS)
• Build and maintain the media infrastructure: LiveKit-based audio routing, Opus codec handling, RTP/RTCP transport, and voice activity detection
• Develop agent capabilities for voice interactions — tool calling, function execution, context engineering, and multi-turn conversation management
• Optimize end-to-end latency across the voice pipeline, from audio capture to AI response playback
• Collaborate with product and platform teams to deliver production-grade voice AI experiences on WhatsApp
• Ensure reliability, performance, and scalability of voice AI infrastructure serving customers across 190+ countries
Requirements
• 3+ years of software engineering experience, with strong backend development skills (Go or Python preferred)
• Experience with real-time communication technologies: WebRTC, RTP/RTCP, audio codecs, or media server infrastructure
• Familiarity with AI/LLM integration — model APIs, tool calling, prompt engineering, or agent orchestration
• Experience with or strong interest in speech technologies: ASR, TTS, voice activity detection, or audio processing pipelines
• Understanding of distributed systems, microservices, and cloud-native architectures (GCP preferred)
• Comfortable working with PostgreSQL, Redis, and pub/sub messaging systems
• Strong problem-solving ability and ability to work in fast-paced, ambiguity-rich environments
• Ability to debug complex, latency-sensitive systems by reading code, traces, and real-time metrics
Nice to Have
• Hands-on experience with OpenAI Realtime API, Gemini multimodal live, or similar real-time AI model APIs
• Experience with AI agent frameworks (Dify, LangChain, CrewAI, etc.)
• Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or other agent integration standards
• Contributions to open-source projects in the AI or real-time communication space
Behavioural Expectations
• Strong ownership and bias for action in a fast-moving environment
• Proactive, self-driven, and comfortable working across teams to drive outcomes
• AI-native mindset, actively using AI tools in daily engineering workflow and experimenting with agent frameworks and emerging technologies
• Curiosity-driven — eager to push the boundaries of what voice AI can do in real business contexts

title: 高级产品经理
teaser: Build cross-border OTC derivatives products and data systems, bridging mainland China, Hong Kong and international markets.
jd:
About the role
As Hong Kong's role as a pivotal hub connecting Chinese assets with global capital continues to grow, demand for OTC derivatives, structured products, and volatility trading linked to mainland China, Hong Kong, and global underlying assets (equities, indices, interest rates, FX, commodities, etc.) has surged. However, the cross-market OTC derivatives ecosystem — including over-the-counter trade structures, implied volatility surface / roll yield fitting, OTC option valuation and risk control, buy-side and sell-side specific trading and risk workflows, as well as regulatory and liquidity differences across mainland China, Hong Kong, and international markets — presents significant professional barriers and cross-border complexities.
Professionals in Hong Kong who combine "comprehensive cross-market OTC derivatives ecosystem knowledge" with "B2B product implementation capabilities for international financial institutions (buy-side / foreign investment banks)" are extremely scarce. This role seeks to hire a versatile financial product expert capable of bridging information gaps between domestic and foreign institutions, buy-side and sell-side participants, and cross-market structures.
>
Key responsibilities
1. Cross-Border OTC Derivatives Product and Data Infrastructure Development
Industry ecosystem translation: Decompose OTC derivatives trading and risk management scenarios across mainland China, Hong Kong, and international markets, transforming complex cross-market ecosystems into standardized, scalable B2B data platforms and terminal functionalities.
Market data, pricing, and risk control productization: Lead product design covering the end-to-end workflow from underlying data ingestion and daily quote fitting to portfolio valuation and pre-trade / intra-trade risk control modules.
Structured product research and risk indicator development: Systematically research cross-market structured product design logic, pricing characteristics, and historical performance using a data-driven approach. Integrate daily quotes, implied volatility surfaces, and roll yield / basis data to build and continuously iterate derived market risk indicator systems (e.g., knock-in / knock-out concentration, scenario drawdowns, hedging costs, roll sensitivity, etc.), and productize these analytics through standardized data pipelines and quantitative modeling into monitorable risk analysis modules.
2. International Client Data Solutions (Buy-Side & Sell-Side / Foreign Institution Engagement)
Foreign institution and buy-side data enablement: Lead pre-sales technical presentations, product demos, and differentiated solution design for leading global investment banks, foreign hedge funds, Chinese asset managers expanding overseas, and Hong Kong-based institutions, supporting their decision-making, pricing, and trading workflows through data product capabilities.
Buy-side research support: Deeply understand the actual workflows of buy-side research and risk management teams (public funds / private funds / hedge funds), embedding products into their daily decision-making processes including structured product screening, performance scenario stress testing, and counterparty credit exposure monitoring, ensuring product stickiness and rigid usage.
Deep workflow and data requirement penetration: Gain in-depth understanding of real buy-side and sell-side workflows and data needs, drive product adoption across institutional valuation, risk control, and research use cases, and increase customer renewal rates and PV through data-driven closed-loop value delivery.
3. Data Engineering and Quantitative Model Collaboration
Data pipeline and architecture collaboration: Work closely with underlying data engineering and quantitative teams to define cross-market data pipeline logic (Python/SQL/API). Lead end-to-end design from multi-source data ingestion, cleaning, and standardization to service delivery, ensuring a data architecture that delivers high throughput, low latency, high accuracy, and horizontal scalability.
Quantitative and time-series modeling: Collaborate on building high-quality quantitative and time-series models (parameter fitting, structured product valuation, risk indicator calculation, etc.), driving model delivery from research prototype to production environment and continuous iteration.
Data governance and model validation: Establish data quality monitoring, reconciliation consistency validation, and model back-testing / verification logic to ensure cross-market data credibility and risk indicator robustness, providing a reliable data and model foundation for the risk control and research modules described above.
4. Institutional-Grade Product Lifecycle Management
Own the end-to-end product lifecycle, including: market research and competitive analysis → product roadmap planning → PRD writing and revie1. Business Background (Must-Have)
>
Requirements
1. Business Background
5–8 years of B2B product experience in fintech / financial data, with at least 3 years focused specifically on OTC Derivatives, including hands-on project delivery experience in Total Return Swaps (TRS), option-embedded products, and structured notes such as Snowball / FCN products. Familiarity with product structures and trading mechanisms across mainland China, Hong Kong, and major global markets is preferred.
Deep understanding of OTC derivatives ecosystem differences across mainland China, Hong Kong, and international markets, including but not limited to: differences in trading varieties (e.g., Hong Kong warrants / CBBCs vs. mainland OTC options), differences in trading hours and settlement mechanisms, differences in regulatory reporting requirements, and differences between ISDA master agreements and NAFMII master agreements.
Data-driven product thinking, with the ability to clearly articulate how implied volatility surface construction and roll yield / basis curve fitting impact portfolio NAV in OTC derivatives valuation processes, and to drive product iteration through quantitative analysis.
2. Product and Data Engineering Capabilities (Hybrid Skill Set)
Product hard skills: Proficiency in Axure RP, Figma, and other prototyping tools, with the ability to translate complex quantitative logic into clear, intuitive, and user-friendly B2B product interfaces. Proficiency in JIRA / Confluence for agile project management and product documentation.
Data / quantitative orientation (strongly preferred): A master's degree or above in Financial Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, or other quantitative disciplines is preferred. Proficiency in Python or SQL is required, with the ability to independently conduct data analysis, data quality validation, and basic quantitative model back-testing. Candidates must be able to engage in technical dialogue with Quant teams on model assumptions and parameter calibration logic.
3. Language and Communication Skills
Native Mandarin Chinese, capable of seamless complex business communication and requirement discovery with mainland institutions (including Chinese securities firms, bank wealth management subsidiaries, and fund companies).
Fluent English listening, speaking, reading, and writing, able to independently lead English-language product demonstration meetings, write English PRDs and client delivery documents, and conduct professional, fluid business and technical exchanges with overseas institutional clients.
Strong communication and influencing skills, able to effectively coordinate internal R&D teams, Quant teams, and external client requirements to drive complex project delivery.
4. Preferred Qualifications (Nice-to-Have)
CFA, FRM, or CQF certification is a plus.
Familiarity with options market-making systems or quantitative trading systems (understanding of trade execution logic) is preferred.
Experience working in buy-side / sell-side roles at Hong Kong or offshore financial institutions is preferred.
>
Position Highlights
1. Unique and irreplaceable positioning: Fill the talent gap in the "cross-market OTC derivatives ecosystem" within Hong Kong's fintech market, becoming a key bridge between domestic and foreign institutions and cross-market participants.
2. High impact and strategic influence: Directly engage with global Tier-1 institutions (foreign investment banks, top hedge funds), leading the design and delivery of high-ticket, high-retention institutional-grade financial products.
3. Multidimensional capability growth: Spanning four dimensions — Financial Engineering, Data Engineering, Agile Product Management, and International Commercial Solutions — with a highly competitive compensation package and clear career development trajectory.
>

jd:
岗位职责​ ：1、战略规划：主导共晶机/固晶机设备研发战略制定，结合行业技术趋势、市场需求及公司业务目标，明确研发方向、技术路线及阶段性目标；​ 2、团队管理：负责研发团队（机械、电子、软件、工艺等方向）的搭建、培养与激励，合理分配工作任务，协调内部资源，提升团队整体研发效率与专业能力；​ 3、项目管控：全程统筹共晶机/固晶机设备从需求调研、方案设计、原型开发、测试验证到量产转化的全流程研发项目，把控项目进度、成本、质量及风险，确保项目按时交付；​ 4、技术攻坚：聚焦共晶机/固晶机核心技术（如温度精准控制、精密运动控制、共晶工艺优化、真空 / 惰性环境控制等），组织技术攻关，解决研发过程中的关键技术难题；​ 5、技术创新：推动共晶机/固晶机设备的技术迭代与产品创新，主导专利（发明、实用新型）、技术成果的申报与转化，提升公司核心技术竞争力；​ 跨部门协作：协同生产、销售、市场、质量等部门，提供技术支持，参与产品市场推广、客户技术对接及售后技术问题解决，确保研发成果与市场需求匹配；​6、行业对接：跟踪共晶机/固晶机相关领域的前沿技术、竞品动态及行业标准，开展技术交流与合作，整合外部技术资源，为公司研发决策提供依据。​
任职资格要求​：
>1、学历背景：本科及以上学历，机械工程、电子工程、自动化、材料科学与工程等相关专业；​
>2、核心经验：5 年以上共晶机/固晶机设备研发经验，3 年以上研发团队管理或项目负责人经验，具备完整的共晶机从研发到量产的全流程项目主导经验；​
>3、技术能力：​精通共晶机/固晶机设备的核心工作原理、结构设计、关键部件选型及共晶工艺（如金锡共晶、银锡共晶、焊料共晶等）；​掌握至少 1-2 项核心技术领域（精密运动控制、温度闭环控制、真空系统设计、PLC / 嵌入式软件编程等）的专业知识与实践经验；​熟悉研发项目管理流程与方法（如 IPD、敏捷开发等），具备较强的项目风险识别与管控能力；​
>4、资质要求：拥有共晶机相关核心技术专利（发明优先）者优先，熟悉半导体封装、光电子器件封装等相关应用领域者优先。​
>5、具备出色的团队领导与组织协调能力，能有效激发团队积极性，带领团队攻克技术难关。

Engage in collaborative discussions with engineering, product, and clinical teams, contributing to project planning, progress tracking, and solution optimization.
Establish and nurture research collaborations with clinical partners and research institutions, particularly with clinical experts and hospitals in mainland China, to understand their research needs in orthopaedics, medical imaging, biomechanics, and simulation, and facilitate the application of our technologies in scientific studies.
Independently conduct clinical scientific research, managing the full cycle of projects from initiation to publication, with a preference for candidates with first author publications in relevant SCI Q1 journals or patents.
3. Technical Expertise & Innovation
Leverage understanding of regulatory frameworks (e.g., NMPA, FDA 510(k)) to guide R&D strategies and ensure developed solutions meet regulatory standards for Software as a Medical Device (SaMD).
Provide feedback from R&D activities to product development teams, contributing to product enhancements and new feature development based on scientific findings.

To lead regular proactive thematic reviews or strategic data analysis to identify emerging financial crime risks, fraud risks and new modus operandi. Provide recommendations on control enhancements to minimise fraud losses or exposure to money laundering risks for the Bank
To conduct root cause analysis for fraud or financial crime risk incidents; design and implementation of preventive and mitigating measures; prepare relevant Management Information report to ensure timely and proper escalation and to evaluate the performance of risk control measures
To lead and drive FCC related projects and regulatory initiatives across the Bank
Lead the FCC Controls team and manage a team of investigators to perform case investigations and prepare investigation reports on transaction monitoring alerts, external fraud incidents and Law Enforcement Agency (LEA) referrals; identify unusual customer behaviours and refer such unusual transactions patterns to the JFIU through filing of Suspicious Transactions Report (STR)
Ensure sufficient resources are available to support the business and operations; Regularly look into existing process for streamlining opportunities including the use of data analysis, challenge the status quo and initiate changes to achieve better efficiency through exploring the development of advance analytics capability
To cooperate with LEA closely for the sharing, analysis, dissemination and action on intelligence.
Work closely with CDD Operations and Fraud Operations team (1LOD), regularly challenge and provide feedback to the teams and ensure the quality of investigations are up to the standards and expectations; smoothen and streamline the escalation process between 1LOD to FCC
To provide support to the Head of FCC on any ad-hoc matters as required

title: Ant International-Loan Growth Marketing Manager-Bettr
teaser: • Monitor core operational metrics: credit approval rate, first drawdown conversion, repeat borrowing rate, customer retention, marketing campaign...
jd:
Job description 我们正在寻找一位经验丰富的客户增长与运营经理,负责现金贷和BNPL产品的全生命周期客户运营。您将主导香港个人信贷市场的客户获取、激活、转化和留存策略,通过数据驱动的方法提升客户价值和业务增长。
主要职责
客户生命周期运营
• 管理客户群体全生命周期运营,涵盖新客授信引导、首贷激活、持续互动、复贷增长、客户留存和流失挽回,以提升客户LTV和业务成果
• 设计并优化用户转化漏斗：从体系内流量入口访问 → 授信申请 → 首贷支用 → 复贷循环的完整链路
• 针对现金贷(短期周转)和BNPL(先买后付)两种产品形态,制定差异化的运营策略
数据分析与洞察
• 分析客户行为、借款模式、还款表现、消费场景等,识别高价值客群、增长机会和优化空间
• 监控核心运营指标：授信通过率、首贷转化率、复贷率、客户留存率、营销活动ROI、在贷余额增长
• 进行营销活动后分析(Post-campaign Analysis),评估AB测试效果并迭代策略
营销活动策划与执行
• 制定并执行精准营销活动：新客免息券、老客利率折扣、沉默客户召回、站内Banner/Push/短信多渠道触达
• 针对现金贷强调"极速到账、灵活周转",针对BNPL强调"0息分期、消费自由"
• 设计符合香港持牌放债人合规要求的营销文案(含繁体中文、英文版本)
• 管理优惠券策略、利率折扣活动的发放节奏和成本效益
跨团队协作
• 与风控团队紧密合作,优化授信策略与客户分层准入标准
• 与产品团队协作,推动体系内流量入口、优惠券系统、客户标签体系的产品优化
• 与BI/数据团队合作,建立客户运营报表、实时数据看板和预警机制
• 与合规团队配合,确保营销活动合规
Key Responsibilities
Customer Lifecycle Management
• Manage end-to-end customer lifecycle operations covering new customer credit onboarding, first disbursement activation, ongoing engagement, repeat borrowing growth, customer retention, and win-back campaigns to improve customer LTV and business outcomes
• Design and optimize the user conversion funnel: from internal ecosystem traffic entry → credit application → first drawdown → repeat borrowing loop
• Develop differentiated operation strategies for Cash Loan (short-term liquidity) and BNPL (Buy Now Pay Later / installment payments) product lines
Data Analysis & Insights
• Analyze customer behavior, borrowing patterns, repayment performance, and consumption scenarios to identify high-value segments, growth opportunities, and optimization areas
• Monitor core operational metrics: credit approval rate, first drawdown conversion, repeat borrowing rate, customer retention, marketing campaign ROI, and outstanding balance growth
• Conduct post-campaign analysis, evaluate A/B test results, and iterate strategies
Marketing Campaign Planning & Execution
• Develop and execute precision marketing campaigns: new customer interest-free vouchers, existing customer rate discounts, dormant customer reactivation, and multi-channel touchpoints via in-app Banners, Push notifications, and SMS
• For Cash Loan: emphasize "instant disbursement, flexible周转"; for BNPL: emphasize "0% installment, spending freedom"
• Design compliant marketing copy in Traditional Chinese and English that adheres to Hong Kong Licensed Money Lender requirements
• Manage coupon strategies, interest rate discount campaigns, and cost-effectiveness
Cross-functional Collaboration
• Work closely with risk control teams to optimize credit strategies and customer tiering admission standards
• Collaborate with product teams to drive optimizations for internal traffic entry, coupon systems, and customer tagging infrastructure
• Partner with BI/data teams to establish customer operation reports, real-time dashboards, and alert mechanisms
• Coordinate with compliance teams to ensure marketing activities comply with Hong Kong's Money Lenders Ordinance and HKMA guidelines
Job Requirement
教育背景
• 商业管理、市场营销、数据分析、统计学、经济学或相关专业学士学位
工作经验
• 5-8年客户增长运营、CRM管理、生命周期营销、用户运营或增长营销经验
• 具有现金贷、BNPL、信用卡、消费金融产品运营经验者优先
• 具有香港本地金融、金融科技、持牌放债人或消费金融公司经验者优先
专业技能
• 精通客户分层、LTV管理、生命周期营销和用户增长方法论
• 具备端到端营销活动管理能力：从策略制定、文案创意、AB测试到效果评估
• 熟悉现金贷和BNPL两种产品形态的运营特点和商业逻辑
行业知识
• 理解香港个人信贷市场、持牌放债人业务模式和合规要求(含APR披露、警示语规范)
• 了解BNPL行业趋势和竞争格局(如Atome、Fave Pay等)
Education
• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Data Analytics, Statistics, Economics, or related fields
Experience
• 5-8 years of experience in customer growth operations, CRM management, lifecycle marketing, user operations, or growth marketing
• Experience with Cash Loan, BNPL, credit card, or consumer finance product operations preferred
• Experience with Hong Kong local financial institutions, fintech companies, licensed money lenders, or consumer finance firms preferred
Technical Skills
• Proficiency in customer segmentation, LTV management, lifecycle marketing, and user growth methodologies
• End-to-end marketing campaign management: from strategy formulation, copywriting, A/B testing to performance evaluation
• Familiarity with both Cash Loan and BNPL product characteristics and business logic
Industry Knowledge
• Understanding of Hong Kong's personal lending market, licensed money lending business models, and compliance requirements (including APR disclosure and warning statement regulations)
• Knowledge of BNPL industry trends and competitive landscape (e.g., Atome, Fave Pay, etc.)

Job Duties:
>
Work closely with the Senior Manager – Customer Experience to drive customer experience strategies, CRM initiatives, service enhancement projects and business development initiatives for premium service offerings.
Develop customer insights through feedback analysis, service data review, customer profiling, market intelligence and movement pattern analysis, with particular focus on Mainland Chinese clients and premium service users.
Identify customer needs, service gaps, business opportunities and improvement areas across key customer touchpoints, and recommend actions to enhance customer journey, service quality and revenue opportunities.
Support the development of tailor-made service offerings, personalised service approaches, upselling opportunities and cross-selling initiatives for key customer segments, including VIP customers, frequent travellers, corporate clients and aircraft operators.
Maintain and strengthen relationships with customers, aircraft operators, business partners and internal stakeholders to support long-term customer engagement and service development.
Coordinate with internal departments to ensure smooth implementation of customer experience initiatives, new service offerings and related follow-up actions.
Prepare management reports, presentation materials, customer insights and market analysis to support service planning, performance review and decision-making.
Perform ad hoc duties and projects as assigned.
Requirements:
>
Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Hospitality Management, Aviation, Marketing, Communications or related disciplines.
Minimum 5 years of relevant experience in customer experience, customer relations, account servicing, hospitality, aviation, luxury services, CRM, sales support, business development or related customer-facing functions.
Good command of spoken and written English and Chinese; fluent Cantonese and native-level Putonghua proficiency
Good understanding of Mainland Chinese clients’ preferences, expectations, business etiquette and service habits.
Strong customer service mindset with excellent interpersonal, communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
Good business sense and analytical capability, with the ability to interpret customer feedback, service data, market information and usage trends.
Proactive, detail-minded and well-organised, with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently and coordinate with cross-functional teams.
Familiarity with CRM practices, customer segmentation, customer profiling, market analysis and service personalisation would be an advantage.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
Candidates with more experience will be considered as Manager – Customer Experience.

title: Payment Owner - Greater China
teaser: We are looking for a Payment Owner for ZFX Greater China region, responsible for the selection, evaluation, and continuous optimization of Payment...
jd:
Role Overview
>We are looking for a Payment Owner for ZFX Greater China region, responsible for the selection, evaluation, and continuous optimization of Payment Service Providers (PSPs) in the GC market.
This role is data-driven and judgment-oriented. The ideal candidate should be able to assess both existing and potential PSPs based on actual payment performance, make informed decisions and trade-offs, and clearly identify the current and future payment needs of the GC region.
This is a role that emphasizes ownership and decision-making capability, rather than a purely execution-focused Payment Operations position.
>
Responsibilities
>
Select, evaluate, and recommend suitable Payment Service Providers (PSPs) for the GC region based on data and actual operational performance.
Conduct systematic analysis of existing PSPs, including but not limited to:
Deposit and withdrawal success rates
Failure reason breakdowns
Withdrawal processing time
Cost structure and fees
Risk indicators and exceptions
Assess the real payment needs of the GC region by considering business scale, client behavior, and regional characteristics, and propose practical and actionable optimization solutions.
Work closely with PSPs, Payment Operations, Finance, and Customer Support teams to continuously improve and adjust payment channels.
Assist in establishing PSP evaluation standards, key metrics, and basic governance frameworks to enhance transparency and controllability of the payment system.
Follow up on payment-related issues, exceptions, and optimization initiatives within the GC region.
Requirements
Bachelor’s degree or above. Preferred academic backgrounds include (but are not limited to): Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Business Analytics, Engineering, Computer Science, Financial Engineering, or Information Systems.
2–3 years or above of experience in payments, fintech, or related fields, with hands-on exposure to PSP management, payment operations, or payment channel analysis.
Strong data analysis and logical reasoning skills, with the ability to draw conclusions based on data rather than relying solely on experience.
High sensitivity to key payment metrics such as success rates, costs, and risks.
Strong ownership mindset, able to take responsibility for regional payment outcomes rather than only executing assigned tasks.
Fluent in spoken and written Chinese; capable of basic professional communication in English.
Experience in FX / CFD / trading platforms is a plus, but not mandatory.

teaser: Participate in the architecture design and end-to-end functional development of the IoT cloud platform, covering key modules such as device...
jd:
Key Responsibilities / 崗位職責
IoT Platform Development（IoT平臺開發）
Participate in the architecture design and end-to-end functional development of the IoT cloud platform, covering key modules such as device provisioning, device lifecycle management, real-time data visualization, alert rule configuration, and historical data analytics.
Handle device-to-cloud communication protocol integration and optimization, implementing core features including high-frequency telemetry data ingestion, reliable remote command and control, and OTA firmware update pipelines with rollback and version management capabilities. Ensure the stability and reliability of data transmission.
Assist the hardware team with device provisioning workflow design, network debugging, and end-to-end communication stability optimization.
Web Development（網頁開發）
Responsible for front-end interface development of the company's official website, admin panels, and high-conversion landing pages.
Collaborate with designers to translate wireframes and mockups into functional, high-quality user interfaces.
Requirements / 職位要求
Education:
Currently pursuing or holding a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Technical Skills:
IoT Related: Understanding of common IoT communication protocols (e.g., MQTT, CoAP, HTTP/HTTPS), with hands-on project experience preferred.
Web: Proficient in HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript/TypeScript, and at least one modern front-end framework (React/Vue, etc.), with a basic understanding of Node.js on the server side.
Database: Proficiency in at least one database system, such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB.
Core Competencies:
Strong learning agility with the ability to quickly adapt to technological iterations and a genuine curiosity for emerging technologies like IoT.
Excellent teamwork mindset, transparent and efficient communication, and a strong sense of ownership.
Preferred Qualifications
Candidates with relevant project experience will be given preference.

title: Fund Accounting Associate/Vice President
teaser: The ideal candidate combines strong fund accounting and investment operations expertise with hands-on automation capabilities.
jd:
The ideal candidate combines strong fund accounting and investment operations expertise with hands-on automation capabilities, including advanced VBA development and AI-assisted productivity tools. You will play a key role in enhancing operational efficiency, improving data integrity, strengthening controls, and driving scalable finance and operations infrastructure.
>
Key Responsibilities
Oversee end-to-end fund accounting, NAV production, and fund reporting processes.
Coordinate month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close activities, ensuring timely and accurate reporting.
Review financial statements, investor reports, and deliverables prepared by fund administrators and service providers.
Monitor cash positions, liquidity, and cash flow forecasts to support investment and operational decisions.
Develop and implement workflow automation solutions using VBA, Python, AI-assisted tools, and other technologies.
Design and maintain automated data infrastructure and reporting pipelines to streamline data collection, aggregation, monitoring, and analysis.
Build scalable data-driven solutions to generate actionable insights, identify trends, and support investment, finance, and operational decision-making.
Streamline manual processes by building automated reporting, reconciliation, control, and data validation frameworks.
Identify process improvement opportunities to enhance efficiency, scalability, controls, and data integrity.
Lead system implementations, upgrades, workflow redesign, and digital transformation initiatives.
Act as a key liaison between Finance, Operations, Technology, and external stakeholders, translating business needs into practical solutions.
Support governance, risk management, compliance requirements, and other strategic operational initiatives.
>

Position Summary
The Hardware & Firmware Integration Intern will support the R&D team in testing, validating, and improving smart sensing modules used in animal health monitoring scenarios. The role will involve working with sensing hardware, embedded firmware, data acquisition workflows, prototype testing, and basic system integration.
This position is suitable for students or recent graduates with a background in electronic engineering, computer engineering, biomedical engineering, mechanical/electronic integration, IoT systems, robotics, or related fields.
Key Responsibilities
Hardware and Sensor Module Testing
Assist in testing radar, optical, IMU, environmental, and other sensing modules.
Support hardware bring-up, connection checks, signal acquisition, and prototype validation.
Record test conditions, abnormal readings, hardware issues, and environmental factors.
Firmware and Embedded System Support
Assist in firmware testing, version checking, basic debugging, and functional verification.
Support data transmission tests between sensors, microcontrollers, gateways, and software interfaces.
Help organize firmware test logs and issue records.
Software-Hardware Integration
Support integration between sensing modules, embedded boards, local gateways, and data platforms.
Assist in validating end-to-end data flow from device-side sensing to data collection and storage.
Help test prototype workflows under different usage scenarios, such as resting-state monitoring, active monitoring, and recovery monitoring.
Prototype Validation and Field Testing Support
Participate in prototype assembly, device setup, calibration support, and operational checks.
Assist with testing smart care mat, harness-based sensing modules, handheld screening devices, or other animal health technology prototypes.
Prepare structured testing records for internal engineering review.
Documentation and Engineering Records
Prepare test reports, issue logs, hardware configuration records, and firmware version records.
Help maintain traceability of prototype changes, testing results, and validation procedures.
Support internal technical documentation and cross-functional communication.
Requirements
Current student or recent graduate in Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, IoT, Robotics, Embedded Systems, or related disciplines.
Basic understanding of hardware systems, sensors, microcontrollers, embedded development, or IoT devices.
Familiarity with one or more of the following is preferred:
MCU / embedded systems
Firmware testing or debugging
Sensor data acquisition
UART / I2C / SPI / Bluetooth / Wi-Fi communication
PCB testing or hardware bring-up
Python, C, C++, Arduino, STM32, ESP32, Raspberry Pi, or similar platforms
Signal testing, data logging, or basic physiological signal analysis
Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain clear testing records.
Hands-on attitude and willingness to work with prototypes and early-stage devices.
Ability to communicate clearly with hardware, software, and product teams.
Experience in software-hardware integration, wearable devices, medical devices, animal health technology, robotics, or smart sensing systems is a strong advantage.
Preferred Qualifications
Prior experience with embedded firmware development or testing.
Experience with sensor fusion, IMU, radar, optical sensing, PPG, environmental sensors, or biosensing devices.
Familiarity with edge devices, gateways, cloud data upload, or IoT system architecture.
Basic understanding of signal quality, motion artifacts, calibration, or data validation.
Experience in prototype assembly, soldering, 3D-printed enclosures, or hardware troubleshooting is a plus.
Interest in animal health, veterinary technology, working dogs, equine health, or biomedical innovation.
What You Will Learn
Practical development process of smart sensing hardware and embedded systems.
How to validate prototypes from hardware signals to usable data.
Real-world software-hardware integration for animal health monitoring applications.
Exposure to non-contact physiological monitoring, IoT devices, edge systems, and AI-enabled health technology.
Experience working in a startup R&D environment with cross-functional collaboration.

We are looking for someone who is curious, hands-on, careful with engineering details, and interested in turning early-stage hardware prototypes into reliable systems. The ideal candidate does not need to know everything from day one, but should be willing to test, document, troubleshoot, and learn quickly.
Candidates with experience in both hardware and software will be strongly preferred.

title: Principal engineer – GPU Memory Systems & Scale-Up/Out Systems
teaser: We are seeking a highly motivated **Principal engineer** to advance the state-of-the-art in **GPU memory systems** and **scale-up/out computing...
jd:
**About the Role**
We are seeking a highly motivated **Principal engineer** to advance the state-of-the-art in **GPU memory systems** and **scale-up/out computing architectures**. This role involves designing and optimizing memory hierarchies, interconnects, and distributed systems to improve performance, efficiency, and scalability for next-generation GPU-accelerated workloads (e.g., AI/ML, HPC, and large-scale data analytics).
The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in **computer architecture, memory systems, parallel computing, and distributed systems**, with a strong publication record in top-tier conferences (e.g., ISCA, MICRO, ASPLOS, HPCA, SC, NeurIPS).
### **Key Responsibilities**
- Research and develop novel **GPU memory architectures** (e.g., cache hierarchies, near-memory computing, disaggregated memory, link/switch optimizations).
- Design and evaluate **scale-up and scale-out systems** for GPU clusters, focusing on **interconnect topologies, communication protocols, and load balancing**.
- Optimize **memory bandwidth, latency, and capacity utilization** for large-scale GPU workloads.
- Collaborate with hardware and software teams to prototype new architectures (e.g., using simulators, FPGA emulation, or real hardware).
- Publish cutting-edge research in top conferences/journals and contribute to patents.
- Engage with industry and academic partners to drive innovation in GPU-accelerated computing.
**Required Qualifications**
- **PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field** (or equivalent research experience).
- Strong background in **computer architecture, memory systems, and parallel/distributed computing**.
- Hands-on experience with **GPU architectures, CUDA, RDMA, or high-performance interconnects (CXL)**.
- Proficiency in **performance modeling and simulation** (e.g., GPGPU-Sim, SST, Gem5, NS3).
- Strong programming skills in **C/C++, Python, or SystemVerilog/HDL** for prototyping.
- Track record of publications in **ISCA, MICRO, ASPLOS, HPCA, SC, or related venues**.
**Preferred Qualifications**
- Experience with **disaggregated memory, cache coherence protocols, or memory-centric computing**.
- Knowledge of **AI/ML workloads and their memory/system bottlenecks**.
- Contributions to **open-source hardware/software projects** (e.g., LLVM, PyTorch, OpenMPI).
- Familiarity with **datacenter-scale systems** (e.g., distributed training, high-performance storage).
**Why Join Us?**
- Work on **cutting-edge research** with real-world impact in AI, HPC, and cloud computing.
- Collaborate with **world-class researchers and engineers**.
- Competitive compensation, equity, and publication/patent incentives.
This job description balances technical depth with broad applicability, attracting candidates with expertise in **GPU memory systems** and **large-scale computing**. Let me know if you'd like any refinements!

Upon successfully graduating from the Academy, you will have the opportunity to be placed in a role on a fundamental equity investing team.
As an analyst at Point72, you will benefit from our mentorship culture and ongoing professional development resources that are dedicated to your continued growth beyond the Academy.
>WHAT YOU’LL DO:

Learn the fundamental research and analysis skills needed to be an analyst at Point72 and apply intellectual curiosity in a role that values creativity, autonomy, and analytical rigor.

Upon the successful completion of the Academy, you’ll have the opportunity to interview for an equity research analyst role at Point72, where you’ll work closely with your portfolio manager and team to develop a deep understanding of companies across industries and around the world. Develop sophisticated financial models to help you understand the businesses you cover and how they are changing.

Conduct yourself with the highest levels of professionalism, integrity, and ethics.

jd:
Position Summary
The Manager, Asia Finance Operations & Systems serves as the regional techno-functional lead for the Finance Process & Operations (FPO) team across the Asia-Pacific region including offices in Hong Kong, Beijing, Shanghai, Tokyo, Sydney, Seoul, Mumbai, and Singapore. Based in Hong Kong, this role operates within a coordinated reporting structure, reporting directly to US FPO leadership while maintaining a collaborative reporting relationship with Hong Kong finance leadership to align regional operations with global standards. The role pairs deep regional process and systems knowledge with hands-on technology capability - spanning AI, low-code/no-code development, and scripting - to evaluate processes, deliver solutions, and modernize finance operations across the region. Unlike a single-function role, this position spans financial systems broadly, owning how Asia operations map to the firm's global platforms.
The Manager acts as the AI and technology champion for the region, identifying high-impact opportunities to apply emerging technology and building solutions directly - from generative AI workflows and Power Platform applications to scripted automations and integrations. A defining feature of the role is accounting for Asia-specific requirements, including GST, withholding taxes, multi-currency, cross-border, and local statutory and regulatory reporting nuances, when scoping and validating solutions.
Stakeholder management sits at the heart of this position. The Manager serves as the primary liaison and trusted partner between Asia end-users and US FPO/GTS, bridging time zones, facilitating alignment across geographically distributed teams, and influencing outcomes without direct authority. The role operates with a high degree of independence, owning regional requirements end to end and leading small-to-medium initiatives with limited oversight.
Primary Responsibilities:
Regional SME & AI/Technology Leadership (~35%)
>
Serve as the regional SME for Asia finance business processes across financial systems broadly, not limited to any single function, owning how regional operations map to firmwide platforms
>
Serve as the regional SME for the Asia technical landscape - systems, integrations, and data flows - and how it connects to the US/global environment
>
Act as the AI/technology champion for the Asia region, identifying high-impact opportunities to apply AI and emerging technology and driving adoption across regional teams
>
Apply AI tooling - generative AI, prompt engineering, agent workflows, SQL, and BI - to analyze data, accelerate work, and design more efficient regional workflows
>
Account for Asia-specific regulatory and operational requirements - such as GST, withholding taxes, multi-currency, cross-border, and local statutory and reporting nuances - when scoping and validating solutions
>
Solution Development & Delivery (~30%)
>
Design, build, and maintain low-code/no-code solutions and workflow automations on the Power Platform, and comparable platforms such as Appian, to solve regional process problems directly
>
Apply hands-on scripting and coding such as Python, SQL, and VBA where appropriate to build integrations, automations, or data transformations beyond what low-code tools allow
>
Create and maintain reusable components - prompt libraries, automation templates, and documentation - that scale across the region and back to global teams
>
Document business requirements, functional specifications, and user stories with clear acceptance criteria
>
Lead business-side testing, including UAT, for regional initiatives, validating that delivered systems meet documented requirements
>
Oversee small-to-medium regional initiatives end to end, from discovery through deployment and stabilization, participating in agile delivery and proactively flagging obstacles
>
Stakeholder Management & Regional Partnership (~20%)
>
Serve as the primary liaison and trusted partner between Asia end-users and US FPO/GTS, bridging time zones and translating regional needs into firmwide solutions
>
Build and maintain strong relationships with stakeholders across functions and seniority levels, from regional end-users to US finance and technology leadership
>
Facilitate workshops and working sessions with business owners and SMEs to drive requirements, alignment, and initiative outcomes
>
Manage stakeholder expectations across a cross-regional reporting line, proactively communicating status, risks, and trade-offs, and escalating with proposed solutions
>
Influence and drive consensus across diverse, geographically distributed groups without direct authority, acting as escalation partner for complex regional scenarios
>
Process Improvement, Support & Change Management (~15%)
>
Perform data analysis to support troubleshooting, reporting, process evaluation, and data-flow documentation
>
Identify process gaps and automation opportunities, recommending solutions that weigh risk, control, and business impact, and drive process standardization and modernization across Asia
>
Provide regional production support, triaging and resolving issues and escalating to US FPO/GTS with proposed solutions where needed
>
Support monthly and quarterly financial close cycles across the region, troubleshooting issues, validating data flows, and coordinating with US FPO/GTS to ensure timely and accurate closes
>
Drive change management across Asia through training, documentation, and communication to ensure adoption of new tools and processes
>
Train and enable regional business users on AI and low-code/no-code capabilities, supporting citizen-developer enablement

Job Overview
>We are seeking a highly driven, results-oriented, and multi-faceted Marketing Manager or Senior Marketing Specialist to play a pivotal role in our market expansion and brand-building initiatives.
In this role, you will lead data collection, analysis, and interpretation of customer and market trends to drive core brand strategies. You will also be responsible for expanding online acquisition channels, optimizing acquisition costs, and driving conversions for both affliates and C-end retail clients. Additionally, you will provide critical execution support for offline experiential events to strengthen brand equity and awareness.
Core Responsibilities
>1. Data Analysis & Project Management (50%)
>
Business Data Monitoring: Deeply monitor and analyze customer behavior, trading activity, and deposit patterns to provide robust data support and actionable business insights.
Strategic Output: Periodically deliver customer segmentation frameworks, annual operational strategies, and comprehensive event ROI analysis reports to back management decisions with data.
Value Optimization: Continuously track and optimize Customer Lifetime Value (LTV) and design tailored retention/growth strategies for high-value VIP clients.
Cross-functional Orchestration: Oversee and manage key projects within the Brand Marketing department, driving cross-functional collaboration to ensure efficient resource allocation and the realization of business goals.
2. Online Channel & Traffic Acquisition Operations (40%)
>
Channel Expansion: Identify and develop potential online acquisition channels, cross-industry partnerships, and affiliate network resources; establish standardized collaboration workflows and maintain long-term partnerships.
ROI Optimization: Perform real-time tracking of traffic, registration, and deposit data across various channels. Analyze channel effectiveness and implement optimization strategies to maximize overall ROI.
3. Offline Event Support (10%)
>Provide execution support for the company’s offline events (e.g., salons, product launches, VIP networking events), ensuring smooth on-site operations and crowd control.
Requirements
Experience: 3+ years of experience in data analysis, online marketing, digital traffic acquisition, or integrated project management. Background in Digital marketing agency, finance, CFD broker, or the Internet/FinTech industries is highly preferred.
Technical Skills: Proficient in mainstream data analysis tools; highly data-sensitive with a proven track record of translating complex data into sharp business insights and strategic recommendations.
Operational Capability: Familiar with online customer acquisition channels, partnership resource development, and digital campaign execution. Proven experience in independently planning online campaigns and leading cross-departmental projects.
Soft Skills: Exceptional cross-functional communication, robust project management skills, and high stress tolerance. Possess a keen eye for brand tone and user conversion aesthetics.
Language Proficiency: Fluency in Mandarin (spoken and written) is required to communicate effectively with stakeholders and cross-border teams.
